tei:div.tei:p: karma pa sku phreng dguu pa

dbang phyug rdo rje'i lo rgyus/ ༄༅/ /dpal karma pa chen po'i na rim dgu pa rje btsun dbang phyug rdo rje ste/ de yang rje nyid kyi sku'i skye phreng gong ma brgyad pa rigs kyi bdag po rgyal ba mi bskyod dga' ba'i dbyangs kyi zhabs dgung lo nyer brgyad pa'i dus kong por bzhugs pa'i tshe/ nga skye ba 'di'i 'og rol du// tre shod gangs kyi ra ba'i stod// dpal 'jig rten dbang phyug rang byon drung*// chu sgra bcas dam chos nyan pa yod// sa de dang ha cang mi ring bar// skye ba len pa'i mtshan ma mthong*// zhes gsung mgur du mdzad pa ltar sku bltams pa'i yul ni mdo khams tre bo'i yul gyi sa stod jo bo thugs je chen po rang byon dang ha cang mi ring ba tre smad kha ba glang ri'i zhol stag bzang zhes bya bar/ yab rus chen 'gru las rong po che 'khor gyi brgyud a rdor zhes bya ba dang*/ yum gling bza' a lod kyi sras su sprul pa'i sku 'dzin par mdzad pa na/ yum gyi rmi lam du pang par gser gyi maṇḍal zhig byung ba las 'od zer mtha' yas pa 'phro ba dang*/ dung dkar bus pa'i skad kyis phyogs thams cad du khyab pa dang*/ nam mkhar 'phur nas khrom mang po la yig drug bskul ba sogs dge ba'i mtshan ltas du ma dang*/ yab kyi rmi lam du'ang seṅge'i phru gu sngon po pang du blangs pa sogs byung zhing*/ lhums su zhugs pa nas grong gi nang du 'ja' 'od zug cing me tog gi char 'bab pa dang dri bzang gi ngad ldang ba*/ khang pa'i phyi nang kun tuu yig drug gi sgra rang grags pa dang*/ skabs skabs su rol mo sna tshogs kyi sgra grags pa nye 'khor ba rnams kyis mngon sum du thos la/ yum gyi lus sems bde zhing kha zas ma zos kyang bkres pa'i snang ba med cing zos kyang lus ras bal gyi 'dab ma ltar yang ba byung zhing*/ lhums su zhugs pa nas rgyal ba karma pa'i sprul sku tre shod du bltams so zhes dang*/

bltams par 'gyur ro zhes sa bla'i lha rnams kyis phyogs thams cad du bsgrags pa ltar me pho 'brug gi lo gro bzhin gyi zla ba'i tshes bdun gyi nyi shar lhag pa lha mtshams kyi 'grub sbyor dang ldan pa'i tshe mngal gyi dri mas ma gos par bltams te/ bltams ma thag phyag gnyis kyi zhal ras lan gsum phyis nas spyan mi 'dzum par gzigs te nga ni karma pa yin no zhes gsungs shing*/ zhag gsum gyi bar du skyil mo krung gcig gis bzhugs/ der yab kyis mjal bas bzhad mo mdzad cing bzhengs nas oṃ āḥhūm̐ dang ā li kā li sogs kyang gsungs/ skabs zhig yum gyis pang khebs sku la gsol bas a ma a kha gsungs nas rgyang du 'phangs/ dge ma spun gnyis kyis na bza' tsha ru gsar pa zhig phul bas dgyes pa'i tshul gyis bzhes nas sku drang por bsrangs te bzhugs pa dang*/ skabs 'gar gar dang phyag rgya'i rigs mi 'dra ba du ma'ang mdzad/ de'i tshe karma pa'i sprul sku 'khrungs so zhes nye 'khor gyi skye bo pho mo du mas gleng brjod byas par brten/ yab the tshom du gyur nas sprul sku'i drung du phyin pa na zhabs skyil krung dang phyag mnyam bzhag mdzad/ spyan nam mkhar gzigs nas bzhugs pa'i dbu thog tu 'od dkar po phub tsam zhig 'khor ba mthong*/ 'khrungs nas zhag bcu lhag lon pa na yum gyis nam mkha' rgyal po zhes pa'i mtshan gsol/ zhag bco brgyad tsam nas gzhan la ma brten par 'byon bzhud mdzad thub pa byung*/ sngon rje gong ma kong por bzhugs skabs nas lcags mo nang so chos skyong bkra shis par kwan ting gu shri'i las ka 'ja' sa shel tham sogs gzhan dang mi 'dra ba gnang zhing*/ phyis dbus su mjal bar byon pa na sprul pa'i sku phyi ma'i zhabs tog la dgongs nas phyir myur stabs su rdzong bar mdzad pa'i dgongs pa dang rjes su mthun par bltams nas zhag nyi shu tsam song thog nang so lcags mos ja zhus dang*/

bkra shis kha thags/ rten 'dus ril bu rnams 'bul bar dge 'dun 'ga' shas brdzangs pas sku'i dkyil 'khor mjal ba tsam gyis dad pa thob cing*/ ja zhus dang mjal rten rnams la dgyes pa'i tshul gyis bzhad mo mdzad/ de nas re zhig grong ltag bla ma grags pa'i dgon par spyan drangs te bzhugs pa las zla ngo gsum tsam bzhes pa'i thog lcags mo'i dgon lhun po rtser gdan 'dren zhus pa'i tshe yul lha gzhi bdag rnams kyis yul khams gang ba'i bsu ba dang rol mo la sogs pa'i mchod pa 'bul ba skye bo 'ga' zhig gis mthong zhing*/ nang sos mjal dar bkra shis kha thags phul ba phyag tu bzhes pa dang phyag dbang mdzad pas dad pa thob ste zhabs la gtugs/ dpon bsod bkras kyis nga su red thugs kyis e mkhyen zhus pa na lha dgon yin gsungs/ zla ngo lnga'i bar sku mtshams mus su bzhugs shing*/ de nas dgon pa spyi sos 'bul ba dang zhal mjal zhus/ tre stod smad kyi skye bo phal gyis kyang mjal/ gdan sa bar nas si tu rin po ches sprul pa'i sku gar 'khrungs kyi nyer len pa dge slong gnyis sbrel gnang ba dang*/ sgar chen nas rje thams cad mkhyen pa zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin pa'i zhal snga nas kyis dge slong bla ma rgyal mtshan sogs gnang ba rnams kyis kyang mjal te sgar nas phul ba'i bkra shis kha thags dang rje gong ma'i gsol khem phyag tu btang ba dgyes pa'i tshul gyis bzhes/ de nas rim gyis 'dzam thang chos rje/ bzhag bla ma/ ra ti nas karma rab 'byams pa rnams kyi ja 'dren dang*/ gzhan yang yul rigs so so'i dad can du mas mjal zhing*/ dbus gtsang mdo khams thams cad duu rje karma pa'i sprul sku 'khrungs nas ngo mtshar gyi snang ba ston to zhes grags pas khyab/ gdan sa bar nas dbus gtsang duu gtam snyan bsring bar mdzad pa 'byor ma thag sgar chen nas rje gong ma'i bla sman dang sku'i rim gro pa drung nas shangs dkar ba dang*/

sgom chen kun dgas gtsos pa'i dge slong bcu phrag tsam zhig 'phral gyi na bza' dang dbu zhwa zhwa nag rgyun bzhes/ gsol spyad phyag tham sogs nyer mkho 'bul ba dang zhabs 'bring du sbrul lo zla ba drug par rdzong ste gnang ba rnams sleb tu nye ba na/ gzhan gyis gleng brjod med par shangs dkar ba gsungs nas phyag mdzub la zhag grangs rtsi tshul mdzad pa dang*/ yang nyin gcig ha cang gsal po min tsam du zhwa dmar ba gsungs pa sogs bang chen rdzongs mkhan dang bang chen dus tshes sogs mngon par mkhyen pa'i stobs kyis gsungs pa ltar rta lo zla ba gnyis par zhabs drung du 'byor bas/ sgar chen nas rje zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin pa mchog gi zhu phrin sku'i nyer spyad dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ dbus gtsang gi sde dpon dang dgon sde kha shas kyi zhu yig rten bcas rnams phul zhing*/ mdo dbus kyi tshong pa dang khams 'grul ba rnams kyis kyang rang rang gi mnga' thang longs spyod dang 'tsham pa'i 'bul nod bgyis te/ rnam dpyod dang ldan pa rnams kyis legs par brtags pas dad mos ches cher 'phel ba dang*/ tha mal pa kun gyis kyang zhal mthong ba tsam gyis dad pa thob cing*/ gsol ba rtse gcig tu 'debs/ zla ngo bzhi bzhes pa nas bris sku sogs la phyag nas zhus pa'i tshe oṃ a:hūm̐ ces dang*/ bsngo ba zhus pa'i tshe/ sangs rgyas thob par gyur cig gsungs pas/ thams cad ngo mtshar du gyur cing*/ zla ba drug nas tshems kyang gsal por 'khrungs/ nyin gcig yum la a long gi thog na jo bo mai hripa 'dug gsungs shing*/ dgongs kha zhig dbon lha mgon la nyi ma'i steng na oḍyan bzhugs 'dug khyod kyis e mthong gsungs nas phyag mdzub kyis bstan/ yang nyin gcig thams cad kyis phyag phul/ sprul sku zhwa dmar ba byon 'dug gsung ba sogs kyi gzigs snang dang*/ sku 'khor 'ga' la drung na rim brgyad ka'i mtshan gsal por gsungs shing*/ nyin gcig mdzo mo mdzo mo mdzo mo zhar ma zhes gsung pa'i sang de rgan rgon gnyis kyis mdzo mo zhar ma cig phul byung ba sogs ched du ma zhus par thol rgyag tu gsungs pa dang*/

gal che ba'i rig la lung bstan zhus pa rnams la ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin thog tu bab pas gsung la nges shes 'drongs/ yang nyin gcig si tu pa gsung ba na de 'phral du snga mgyogs kyi bang chen 'byor zhing*/ de rjes drung pa nyid kyang phebs te 'bul ba mdzad cing*/ dbu zhwa zhwa nag gsol nas khrom la mjal kha gnang ba'i tshe nam mkhar 'ja' tshon gyi gur phub pa la sogs pa'i ltas bzang po'ang byung*/ de nas drung pa si tu pas tshe dbang grub rgyal ma phul tshe sprul pa'i sku tshe dpag med dkar po zhig du zhal gzigs shing tshe ril gsol 'phro tshur gnang ba la sngar med kyi ro mchog brgya dang ldan par byung gsungs/ gzhan yang rdor phreng dang rang byung bka' 'bum steng nas phyag chen chos drug sogs dbang lung 'ga' shas kyang chos skyes su phul/ skabs shig si tu rin po ches rje chos grags rgya mtsho'i phyag dril gzigs phul nas 'di mi bskyod rje dang chos grags rgya mtsho su'i phyag dril lags zhus pas/ chos grags rgya mtsho'i red gsungs pa dang*/ phyag phreng gi spos shel rje gong ma'i yin pa dang ri che'i chos rje'i yin pa gnyis la nyid kyi phyag phreng gang zhus par ngos 'dzin gnang bas thugs yid lhag par ches/ de nas lug lo'i nang du cha gar gyi dmag lhags pas 'di phyogs su gnod pa yong ngam mi yong zhus par mi yong gsungs shing*/ res 'ga' cha gar bzlog bsgyur gsungs nas phyag gi thal mo dang na bza' rdeb pa yang mdzad pa bzhin nye skor kun la gnod pa med cing cha gar gyi dmag kyang rang zhir song bas ji ltar gsungs pa thog tu babs/ dbus nas dge 'dun yang ri ba rnams rje bla ma zhwa dmar pa'i bka' bzhin phyir bteg pa la 'ga' zhig gis 'di na yong rgyu ma red zer ba'i sgros byung ba na/ yang ri ba yong yod nga'i mkhyen pa yin gsungs/ de nas lug lo zla ba drug par yang ri ba dpon slob zhabs drung du 'byor ba'i sgar la gzigs par ri ngos su phebs pa'i tshe rdo la zhabs rjes gsal por byon/

khong rnams kyis 'bul ba dang zhu yig rten bcas rnams phul ba na rin po che dpa' bo'i zhu yig phyag tu bzhes nas sku 'phrag tu bcug /bla ma dang dge 'dun 'ga' re la ming nas gsung pa dang ngos 'dzin mdzad/ lcags mo dang yang ri ba gzhi byes kyis dbus su sgar pa gdan 'dren gyi bang chen brdzangs par zhal ta gnang rgyu e yod zhus par/ zhwa dmar pa la mgyogs po byon/ khyed nga la rtsis med pa e yin zhus gsungs/ sku 'khor 'ga' zhig la sku rtsed kyi tshul du thugs rje chen po'i sgom lung rgyas par gnang*/ nyin gcig de ring rten 'brel bzang po yod/ rol mo dang bsangs mchod byed dgos gsungs pa phyis dus tshes bsgrig pas yangs can nas bzhugs sgar khams phyogs su 'degs grabs byed pa dang 'grig 'dug zer/ yang nyin cig de ring gtam snyan po yong ba yod gsungs pa na/ snga sor gyi bang chen gnyis 'khor nas bzhugs sgar 'bri chu khar phebs yod tshul zhus pas shin tu dgyes par gyur/ de skabs 'jang rgyal po'i ti shri byang bshes pas gtsos spo 'bor dang*/ spungs ri nang so yab sras sogs 'ba' la bzhi bar gyi lha sde mi sde kun gyi zhu yig dang ja 'dren gyi 'bul ba gtos che ba sleb/ slar sgar chen du phebs bzhud nye len btang bar/ da cha gar gyis gnod pa med pas ga ler byon gyis gsungs/ de nas bya lo zla ba gnyis par sgar chen lhun rtser phebs pa'i chibs rags la gzim khang steng nas gzigs mo mdzad/ phyir nyin dge slong dbu ma rig pa gnang ste/ nga sgar du nam gdan 'dren rgyu yin bka' phebs/ nyi ma de nyid du rje zhwa dmar ba sku 'khor nyung shas dang bcas pas phyag 'bul la phebs te/ de nyid kyis phal pa rnams la bya ba lta bu'i brtag pa sogs mi dgos shing*/ rje gong ma thams cad mkhyen pa'i gsung gi zur las kyang de 'dra 'gog tshul zhib mor gsungs nas/ thugs the tshom med par rje gong ma la ji ltar mdzad pa bzhin gyi phyag dang bkur sti mdzad/

nang so mdzod pa mched sogs sku 'khor rnying pa rnams kyang zhal mjal ba tsam gyis dad pa thob cing yid ches skyes/ de nas tshes bcu gnyis rgyal phur gyi 'grub sbyor dang ldan pa'i nyin sgar chen 'dzam gling rgyan du spyan 'dren mdzad nas sngon gyi seng ge'i khri chen por mnga' gsol te/ sgar chos sde dang bcas pa thams cad kyis 'bul ba dang zhal mjal phyag 'bul bgyis/ sang mdzod pa'i gur du phebs pa na gandho la'i lde mig rnams sku rked du bzhes/ de nas rten sgam sogs phyag rdzas rnams rim par rtsis 'bul mdzad pa'i tshe/ sku chos dang snam sbyar sogs la gzhan las thugs dgyes pa'i tshul gyis sku la bzhes shing*/ phyag shubs yod pa sogs phul kyang mi bzhes pa dang*/ phya'u 'gag bcad zhig dgos gsungs par rje de bzhin gshegs pa'i phya'u 'gag bcad la dar gyi yu ba byas pa gcig phul ba dang*/ sha ba yu mo'i rwa gzigs su phul ba'i tshe 'gag bcad yu ba can dang*/ yu mo'i rwa co gsungs nas bzhad/ de nas rje zhwa dmar pa'i drung duu bka' chos kyi thog ma grub rgyal ma dang lha dgu sogs tshe dbang gi rigs mang dag gsan zhing*/ dbu skra bsil ba la thugs rings pa'i zhal ta rim pas phebs par brten/ lhums dang shol zla rtsis pa'i dgung lo ngo bdun bzhes pa bya lo zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes bdun gyi nyin jo bo gandho la'i drung du rje zhwa dmar bas gtsug phud bzhes shing dbu skra bsil nas/ dpal ldan mi pham chos kyi dbang phyug tu mtshan gsol/ yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen dang smon 'jug sems bskyed kyi sdom pa bzhes/ bco lnga la tre shod shugs ri'i thang du yab sras lhan rgyas bzhugs sgar bsgrigs nas bzhugs pa'i skabs zhig nang so mdo rgyud pas rje gong ma'i zhal thang sogs bris sku 'ga' zhig la phyag nas zhus par phyag nas mang du zug/ de nas bzhag blas 'dra tsher lung mdor spyan drangs pa'i phebs lam shel khog ra ma sgang du dar mdo'i mi chen stag 'du dang bcas pa dang*/

rab sgang mkhas pa mi lnga'i dgon rnams kyi ja 'dren sleb/ lam du gzigs snang gi lo rgyus 'ga' shas gsungs shing*/ 'dra tsher lung dgon du phebs/ mchod yon thams cad kyis 'bul zhabs rgya cher bgyis te bzhugs ring dus mkhyen bka' 'bum na bzhugs pa'i dbang rjes gnang rnams rdzogs par gsan/ slar tre shod du phebs thog si tu rin po che gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs 'bul skyel ba byon zhing*/ dgun lhun rtse'i gzim khang dang bzhugs sgar res mos su bzhugs/ der lo gsar dang smon lam chen mo mdzad tshe/ mang ja'i ring thams cad du tshogs dbur bzhugs shing*/ bco lnga'i nyin thog thag bzhugs khri khar bzhugs/ dbu la zhwa khra bzhes phyag tu me tog bsnams nas 'thor ba sogs dgyes pa'i tshul dpag med mdzad/ khyi lo'i sos 'dzam thang chos rje'i spyan 'dren pa rim 'byor bzhin/ lnga par 'dzam thang phyogs su chibs kha bsgyur te/ shel khog nas brgyud gnas mjal mdzad cing snye rol tu phebs/ der sku 'khor rnams kyis yun ring mi bzhugs rtsis gzim gur ka gnyis ma las ma phub par/ gzim gur che ba nges par phub dgos gsungs pa la/ de ma thag ri bo dge ldan pa'i grwa rgyun a mdo ba mi mgo sum brgya tsam dang*/ 'jang rgyal blon bla ma rnams dang bcas pa'i 'bul skyel ba mang du sleb pa dang*/ der bzhugs yun ring du 'gor ba'ang mkhyen par 'dug/

de nas rdo rol brgyud 'dzi ka thang du bzhugs tshe rje mthong ba don ldan dang mi bskyod rje'i bka' 'bum nang gi dbang rjes gnang rdzogs par gsan/ dgu pa'i yar tshes la 'dzam thang dgon du phebs par bsu ba ser sbreng dang bcas chos rjes mjal/ dpon slob sde dgon thams cad kyis 'bul bsnyen rgya cher bsgrubs/ de nas la rgyab bzhag shod zhes par spyan drangs nas kyang 'bul zhabs mang du zhus/ slar 'dzam thang du phebs thog nas mgo log dpon rnams kyis smar stod du gdan 'dren zhus nas chen mo thang du bzhugs skabs sku 'khris pa rnams la gsung gleng mdzad par/ nga la bla ma bzhi yod gsungs pa dang*/ dbus suu dgon pa bdun yod/ dbus gtsang du lo bcu bdun song*/ sngon zhing brje skabs kyi bsnyun gzhi de dug yin zer te min gsungs/ der mgo log dang be ri rnams kyis rta khrab dang gos dar la sogs pa'i brgya 'bul du ma bgyis/ de nas tshur shel khog tu phebs thog rje dpa' bos dbu mdzad dbus gtsang dwags kong gi kar sde dang*/ sbyin bdag rnamasakyis dbus gtsang dang dwags kong du chibs bsgyur dgos pa'i zhu ba nan chags 'bul skyel dang bcas 'byor zhing*/ mi chen sogs dar mdo dang rab sgang pa yon mchod rnams kyis spyan 'dren du dpon mdo bkras dang*/ ka 'jug rtags ldan ser skya rnams brdzangs pa'ang 'byor bas shel khog nas ta'u brgyud de gdan drangs pa'i phebs lam du nang so mdo rgyud pa la rnam rtog chos sku yin gsungs pa'i gsung 'phros dang bgro gleng mdzad pa la/ nang so'i drung gis kyang sku rtsed nyams nyul gyi rnam par bgro gleng phul pas/ da de 'dra'i bgro gleng su'i lugs yin gsungs pas skrag cing zil gyis gnon pa byung gsungs/ ta'u mi mtshor lo gsar mdzad nas zla ba dang por dar mdor phebs/ mi chen gyis rgyal po'i lung gi che ba'i rgyan dang*/ rol mo la sogs pa'i bsu bkod rgya chen pos spyan drangs shing*/

rgya bod thams cad kyis sems rtse gcig pa'i dad pa'i gdung shugs kyis ja gos dar gser dngul rgya zog khyad mtshar gyi rigs la sogs pa'i longs spyod dang dngos pos sa steng khyab pa lta bu phul/ ling tshe dpon cu hud kyis gdan 'dren nan gyis zhus par phebs ma grub pas ja gos dar gser dngul na bza' gsol spyad gzim drel la sogs pa'i brgya 'bul gtos che ba tshur la brdzangs shing*/ sha bing dpon gyis kyang rgya'i zas sna shing thog sogs kyi bzhes spro dang ja 'dren gyi 'bul ba brdzangs/ der rje zhwa dmar pa'i phyag na drung gong ma'i dus ma phyi la dgongs te bzhengs pa'i rje dus mkhyen dang*/ pagshi'i rnam thar zhing bkod kyi zhal thang gnyis yod pa gzigs pas 'di ma dpe la med kha med yin gsungs nas ngos 'dzin mdzad/ yab sras bka' gros kyi thog nas la mo rtse'i sgrub sde gso ba'i thes dang*/ mdo pa shog gsum nas bu khral gyi tho btsun sum cu tsam 'jog pa mdzad cing zhabs kyis bcags/ mdo khams stod smad kong po dbus gtsang gi tshong pa kun gyis kyang rang rang gi tshong phud nas ci 'byor ba'i brgya 'bul rnams byas te/ gzhi byes kyi skye bo mtha' dag la zhal mjal chos 'brel smon lam bkra shis gnang*/ de nas yar rab sgang gi ra ti khos mo khri byams/ gsar stod mgo /bka' bzhi la sogs par phebs nas so so'i mkhan slob grwa 'bangs sbyin bdag dang bcas pa'i mos pa gang bar mdzad cing yab sras bka' gros thog nas kar sder gtogs pa'i bla ma slob dpon dgos pa rnams kyang so sor bsko bzhag mdzad cing*/ de nas drung byang chub bshes gnyen dang rgya bya bla ma sogs pa'i spo 'bor ba rnams kyis bla ma chos bkras pa spyan 'dren du mngags nas gsol btab bzhin/ kaṃ po gnas nang du phebs lam mgu log nas brgyud/ ngom sgang du bzhag bla dpon slob kyis 'bul zhabs yun ring du zhus shing*/

'ja' mo lar sman 'ji gdan sa pa dang 'jang shar phyogs ja kras kyang mjal/ zla ba bcu gnyis par gnas skor phebs te/ nang so spungs ri ba sogs gnas sgo dang gnas nang ba'i phebs bsu dang yul lha rnams dga' zhing gus pa'i mtshan ma nam mkha' 'ja' tshon gyis dkrigs pa sogs byung*/ gnas sgo'i gtsug lag khang rnams mjal bar phebs tshe bzhag bla dpon slob kyis lde'u mig 'dzin pa'i lha khang bkra shis gsar ma zer ba zhig na drung na rim gyi sku bzhugs pa'i na rim snga ma snga ma'i skus phyi ma phyi ma thog mar phebs pa la zhwa phud mdzad zer ba'i ngag sgros yod par brten/ bla ma dpon slob kyis mi phebs pa'i zhag gsum gyis gong nas mchod pa bzang du bshams/ sgo la dkon gnyer sogs kyi 'grim 'grul med par rgyas btab pa phebs pa dang mnyam du phye bas drung gong ma'i sku mi bzhugs pa 'dug kyang rje chos grags rgya mtsho'i sku de'i dbu zhwa thugs ka'i thad du phyag chos 'khor gyis brten pa ltar mdzad nas 'dug pas kun ya mtshan du gyur zhing*/ sku des sngon rje mi bskyod rdo rje phebs skabs kyang de ltar mdzad pa yin zer/ de nas gnas nang rnams su phebs tshe sku 'khor rnams la grub chen pakshi la sogs pa'i gzigs snang dang ngos 'dzin mang du gsungs/ der drung byang bshes pa sogs spo 'bor ba'i bla grwa phal mo ches mjal zhing 'bul zhabs bgyis/ 'jang la gser yig pa gnang*/ byi ba lo'i lo sar smon lam mdzad pa'i tshes bcu bzhi'i snga dro dge 'dun rnams la thugs rje chen po'i sgom lung sogs gnang*/ dgongs mo mtshur phu la sogs pa'i dbus phyogs su phyag nas gnang zhing gzigs snang dang sprul pa bstan tshul sogs kyi lo rgyus mang du gsungs/ bkra shis dang byin gyis rlobs pa'i rten 'brel mdzad/ smon lam grol rjes rje zhwa dmar pa'i drung du bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' 'gyur ro 'tshal gyi ljags lung gsan pa'i dbu thog mar rgyud 'bum nas brtsams te tshugs/

dbu mdzad bkras rgyam pas smon lam zhus par oṃ āḥhūm̐ bkra shis rgya mtsho'i bsam don chos bzhin 'grub nas phyi ma bde ba can du skye bar gyur cig /gnas sgo'i bla mar khyod rang dge sbyor byed pa dga' zhes gsungs/ der spung ri nas nang so sogs dang 'ba' la bzhi bar gyi grwa rigs rnams dang kong po'i tshong dpon rgod tshang pa rnams kyis 'ba' phyogs su spyan 'dren snga phyi rim 'byor bzhin 'ba' thang phyogs su chibs bsgyur nas stag shod du phebs thog bla ma yab gshegs pa la gshegs khar phyag dbang zhabs dbang dang gshegs nas rje zhwa dmar ba'i drung du bsngo rten 'bul ba dang*/ sgar chos sde rnams la mang ja rnam bzhag bsngo smon sogs mdzad/ gdung zhugs kyis sbyangs tshe me rang 'bar byung ba der yod kun gyis mthun grub tu mthong zer zhing sku gdung gi mchod rten yang brtsigs/ 'ba' rgya spang steng nas shar phyogs spung ri'i gnas mjal du phebs pa na 'khor lo bde mchog zhal gzigs gsungs/ 'dam chen rtser sogs mang por zhabs kyis bcags/ 'ba'i grwa yon rnams kyis bsnyen bkur dang 'bul zhabs rgya cher bgyis shing*/ der bka' 'gyur las bskal bzang sogs kyi lung gsan/ yab sras bka' gros nas 'jang kong bar gyi 'dun 'jags kyi bka' khyab mdzad/ khang gsar mgo gdan sa pas gtses 'jang rgyal blon gyi 'bul skyel gtos che ba'ang sleb/ slar gnas sgor phebs nas rgyud 'bum gyi 'phro mus rnams gsan skabs sku rtsed kyi zhar la nang so mdo rgyud par/ rgyal mchog rin po che yi gzhi// rgyal ba mchog gi sprul sku mchog/ longs sku rdo rje mchog gi mchog/ de bzhin gshegs pa chen po pa// de bzhin dbang phyug rdo rje nga*// mi bskyod rdo rje nga rang yin// zhes pa'i tshigs bcad gnang*/ skabs zhig dbyar gzigs la gnas nang na yar phebs te chos 'byung steng du tshogs mchod mdzad tshe rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog ljang gu rgyan mang po yod pa 'khor mkha' 'gro ma brgyad cu rtsa brgyad kyis bskor ba zhal gzigs gsungs/

yab sras zhal rgyas kyi spung ri nang so dang*/ bla ma la gnas sgo'i zhig gso sogs kyi bka' khyab mdzad/ de nas li thang pa rnams dang*/ khro tsha bla ma dang khrom gzhung gi sog po rnams kyis spyan 'dren dang bsnyen bkur bzhin khrom gzhung dang 'bom nyag brgyud/ slar lhun rtser phebs te/ bka' 'gyur las 'bum sogs gsan zhing*/ tshigs su bcad pa'i gsol 'debs 'ga' re yang mdzad/ de nas byi ba lo zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes gsum la dbus phyogs su gdan btegs/ rdza rgyud nas lam phyung ste gling bar tshang gis 'gu zi ri phug tu spyan drangs nas zhabs tog dang*/ der shing glang gi lo sar dang smon lam mdzad nas dran thang brgyud/ sangs rgyas mnyan pa'i dgon byang gling du phebs te/ 'bri rgyud kyi bla ma grwa rigs yon bdag rnams kyis mjal zhing phyag mchod dpag med bgyis/ de nas gdan sa bar nas drung 'jam dbyangs pas spyan 'dren ltar karmar phebs nas gtsug lag khang phan tshun gyi rten mjal zhing mchod phyag bgyis/ gzim khang bkra shis gsar mar bzhugs/ de skabs rje zhwa dmar pas dpa' bo rin po cher brtan bzhugs kyi smon lam zhig zhu ba mdzad pas/ sems can smin par mdzad pa yi/ /zhes sogs nas/ dgung lo brgyad cu thub par shog /ces pa gnang*/ nyin gcig zur ri'i tshogs gur du snam sbyar 'ga' la phyag nas zhus skabs sku rtsed kyi tshul du rje gong ma'i zhal thang chen mo la yang 'thor bar mdzad pas dbu'i 'od kor la phyag nas gcig gnyis zug pa dang*/ chab mdo ba'i gnas po gcig gis zhwa dmar nag gi zhal thang la phyag nas zhus par rje zhwa dmar pa'i sku'i dbu zhwa la phyag nas zug pa sgril ba dang phyogs su khyer na'ang mi 'brul ba kun gyis mthong bas ya mtshan par gyur/ lha steng du phebs/ 'gro mgon ras pa'i gzim phug la sogs pa mjal ba mdzad/ de nas zur mang du spyan drangs te/ dbon chos rje legs bshad sgra dbyangs pa dpon slob kyis bsu ba dang ser sbreng sogs kyis ri mor bgyis shing*/

'bul mchod rgya chen pos zhabs bsnyen bskur/ tshang gsar gu shri zhal ngo rnams kyis snying thang du spyan drangs/ ri khag bco brgyad dang 'brong pa la sogs pa'i lha sde mi sde thams cad kyis mjal zhing yul zog gi 'bul ba rgya cher spros/ slob dpon padma'i sgrub gnas spyi 'byams grag gi gnas mjal mdzad cing*/ sku 'bum mdun du nang chen pas kyang mjal te 'bul bsnyen zhus/ de nas gsal stong gi sgrub phug dang rje dus mkhyen gyi gnas re ne dgon rnams su phebs pa na phyag zhabs kyi rjes mang du byon zhing me tog gi char bab pas skye bo thams cad nges pa 'drongs par byung*/ de nas ri che'i chos rje mtsho skyes khu dbon dang mi dpon pa sde dgon rnams kyis gus pa chen pos spyan drangs bzhin ri cher phebs/ lha khang chen mo la sogs pa'i rten mjal mchod dang*/ bkra shis sgo mang du chos rjes mjal 'dzom mdzad pas bcos min gyi dad pa thob ste rim par phyag chen lnga ldan dang zab mo nang don sogs kyi chos 'brel zhus bzhin gnang*/ yang dgon du gdan drangs pa na zhal gzigs sogs byung tshul chos rje la lkog gyur du gsungs byung tshul mang du yod gsungs/ lho rong nas sde pa che tshang gi nang so gu shri pa yang 'bul zhabs rgya cher bcas mjal du byon/ gzhan yang bar lam lho ngos kyi skye bo'i tshogs mtha' dag gis mjal/ gling nas de bar sher phyogs kyi 'phro mus rnams dang rgya rol lung bcas gsan/ sog zam kha nas 'brong bu ta'i gu shri nyid spyan 'dren du byon pa dang*/ hor karma dpal dang nang chen stod pa'i ja 'dren kyang 'byor bzhin/ der zla gcig lhag tsam bzhugs nas rim gyis btegs pa'i lam du rgya ston chos rje mched kyis mjal zhing bsnyen bkur dang 'bul chen mdzad/ de nas sog zam bkra shis lhun gling du phebs tshe dge 'dun stong phrag tsam gyi ser sbreng la sogs pa'i bsu ba dang*/

sde dgon thams cad kyis 'bul zhabs bla lhag pa bgyis/ der rje dpa' bos ja 'dren dang rta 'bul sleb/ rim gyis byang lam brgyud phebs lam rnams su phyag chen rgya gzhung gi lung gsan zhing*/ byang ris kyi skye bo de kun thar pa'i lam du la bzud pa'i bka' drin bstsal/ stag lung chos rje phebs pas ja 'dren phul/ 'bab rom brag gi gnas mjal du phebs/ chos rje khag gnyis kyis gzhi len gyi zhabs tog zhus/ dbu ma ba dang kong pa rnams kyis kyang so so'i dgon par spyan drangs shing bsnyen bkur bgyis/ ban sgar ba dang rong po chen po mchod yon dpon g.yog rnams kyis 'bul zhabs bgyis te der bzhugs tshe/ snang ba sna tshogs kyi thang yangs la/ /nga rig pa'i khye'u chung rtsed mo rtse/ /zhes sogs kyi mgur mdzad/ de nas dgung lo bcu pa glang lo zla ba bcu gcig pa'i nyer bdun la yangs can du phebs te zla ngom dkar bar rtse ldeng du bzhugs sgar mdzad/ tshes gsum la gtsug lag khang du spyan drangs shing drung nas dbon gu shri sogs pas sna len gyi 'bul zhabs legs par bgyis/ der thogs shig bzhugs nas mtshur phur phebs pa la nang so dang dge 'dun rnams kyis bsu ba'i bkod chen dang 'bul zhabs bgyis shing*/ dbus gtsang gi kar sde so so'i bla dpon dang bcas pa kun gyis zhal mjal phyag 'bul zhus/ sde dpon che phra rnams kyi ja zhus kyang 'byor/ stag lo'i lo gsar dang*/ bde chen nas drung nas khu dbon gyis zhabs tog mdzad de gzhi byes kyi dge 'dun stong brgyad brgya tsam gyis smon lam mdzad/ rje zhwa dmar pas sprul pa'i sku khrir phebs kyi dga' ston brgya 'bul dang*/ dbu zhwa 'dzam gling g.yas bzhag bzhes nas tshogs par thugs rje chen po'i sgom lung gnang zhing bco lnga'i nyin dwags po chos bzhi'i chos 'brel kyang gnang bas thams cad yid tshim par gyur/ 'bri khung phag mor phyag nas dgos tshul zhus bzhin gnang bas nyin re las nyin re phyag nas mang bar phebs pas thugs kha rdzogs pa byung zer/

lho brag nas spyan 'dren zhabs bskul yang 'byor bzhin/ rgyal la brgyud phebs/ chu shul ba sogs dang smyug la ba dpon blon gyis spyan 'dren 'bul zhabs bgyis shing*/ legs gling du rje phrin las pa'i dngul gdung la phyag 'bul mdzad/ gzhis ka gangs dkar nas gong ma chen po'i gdung brgyud ngag dbang grags rnam pa las tshan gzabs shoms kyis phyag 'bul ja 'dren du phebs par phyag chen lnga ldan gyi chos 'brel gnang*/ de nas dpal de/ sna dkar rtse/ stag lung*/ lho stod pa rnams kyis spyan 'dren 'bul nod rim par bgyis te/ zla ba gsum pa'i yar tshes la sras mkhar dgyes rdor pho brang du phebs tshe nam mkha' shin tu legs shing 'byung ba gzhan yang mi 'khrugs par lham pa la/ bsu ba'i ser sbreng 'phan gdugs rgyal mtshan sku mkhar rtse nas bkra shis khra ring bro pa gar 'chams la sogs pa'i bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa mdzad/ sngon rje gong ma'i bkas gnang ba ltar gtsug lag khang rten mchod bcas rje dpa' bo'i dgongs pa bzhin nye gnas dge slong 'jam dbyangs pas phyag len du bstar pa dang*/ grwa tshang rig 'dzin grub mchog gling gi dge 'dun rnams lta spyod rnam par dag pa sogs yon gnas dam par gyur pa

la thugs dgyes shing rangs par gyur/ phebs nyin de ma thag dpon slob mjal 'phrad gnang zhing*/ de nas nyin bzhin mjal 'dzom dang gtsug lag khang steng 'og bar gsum mtha' gru khyab par phebs te phyag nas gnang*/ rje dpa' bo dpon slob nas 'bul ba dang bsnyen bkur rgya cher zhu ba mdzad/ tshes bcu dgu gza' skar legs pa la bstan pa'i gtso bo'i sku li ma khyad 'phags du ma bzhugs pa'i drung du rje zhwa dmar ba mkhan po dang*/ rje dpa' bos slob dpon gyi bya ba dang*/ dus go ba dge slong karma dpal sogs dge 'dun grangs tshang mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i dbus su dgung lo bcu gcig pa la rab byung gi sdom pa bzhes te/ mtshan dpal ldan mi pham chos kyi dbang phyug rdo rje gar dbang phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i snying po khyab bdag bstan pa'i nyi ma zhes gsol/ de tshe ched du ma bsgrigs par rab byung du gsol ba dang*/ dge 'dun gyi tshogs dung bus pa 'grig pas rten 'brel legs par go /zhes rje zhwa dmar ba gsungs/ de nas gza' skar sbyor byed bzang por rje dpa' bo'i drung nas sgrol dkar gyi rjes gnang gsan zhing*/ rim pas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma lha lnga'i dbang*/ nā ro chos drug /phyag chen lhan cig skyes sbyor/ oḍyan bsnyen sgrub/ sbyor ba yan lag drug gi khrid rnams kyi dmigs rim/ dud sol ma'i rjes gnang*/ byang pa'i lugs kyi smon 'jug gi sems bskyed rnams dang*/ rje zhwa dmar ba'i drung nas dus 'khor 'grel chen lung*/ rngog dkyil bdun gyi dbang yang gsan/ yab sras bka' gros nas zur ri'i bla ma gshegs pa'i gdan sar dbu mdzad bsko bzhag gnang*/ mon lhun grub chos sdings dang bkra shis dge 'phel sogs kyi bla ma dhi tshas 'bul nod bgyis/ de la sogs pa phyogs de'i skye bo du mas 'bul zhabs rgya che ba rgyun mar bgyis shing kun kyang thar pa'i lam du dkri bar mdzad/

zla ba bzhi pa'i bcu dgu la btegs/ gnas lha lung du lho stod pas zhabs 'degs dang*/ stag lung dang sna dkar rtser khri dpon mched/ na kha sbug tu smyug la ba dpon blon/ bzad pa dang dga' tshal ba sde dgon sogs so so nas spyan drangs pa dang*/ btegs shing bsnyen bkur ba/ 'bul chen rnams rim par bgyis/ de nas rdza dkar la nas gnam khog gi bsil snar phebs pa la hor stod pa'i dpon khag sde mang dang bcas pas mjal te 'bul bsnyen rgya cher bgyis/ stod klung bde chen nas zhabs 'degs te/ 'bri rdzi'i lha zhol du bka' 'gyur las dkon brtsegs dang phal chen sogs gsan/ yangs can dang bde chen du'ang phebs/ mtshur phur phebs/ dkon gnyer rje gong ma'i bka' ltar yang zur nas bzhi sde bsko bzhag gnang ba sogs mdzad/ slar yangs can du phebs/ sbyin bdag lha phu pas gtsang phyogs su spyan drangs pa'i lam zhor jo mo gangs kyi gnas mjal mdzad/ lha phur phebs thog zab phu lung gi gnas gzigs kyang gnang ste/ rin gling du gdan phebs pa na lhor rje dpa' bo zhi bar gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs 'bul mi sleb/ der zla ba kha yar gyi bar 'bul zhabs rgya cher bsgrubs shing shang rnam gling du phebs te/ sku mdun zhing shag pa tshe brten rdo rjes 'bul bsnyen dpag med bgyis shing*/ gsung rab gling dgon du yos lo'i lo gsar dang smon lam mdzad de/ tre bo sprul sku dang bsam rtse nas rin spungs pa'i sde pa rgyal bus kyang mjal du byon/ de nas sa skyong ngag dbang 'jig rten dbang phyug rgyal ba gong mas lung bstan zhing dbang bskur bas spyan drangs pa bzhin/ rin spungs su gdan btegs ste/ mthong smon du thub bstan gser mdog can nas mkhas dbang dpal mchog pa sogs mkhan slob rnams dang*/ 'dul grwa gling du thob rgyal ba mchod yon rnams kyis rab tu bsnyen bkur zhing mjal mchod bgyis/ de nas sha ri'i gru kha nas mi'i dbang po dpon blon 'khor 'bangs sde dgon dang bcas pas bsu ba'i bkod pa rgya chen pos spyan drangs te/

kha ru steng klu sdings su gdan phab/ pho brang tshoms chen du rigs ldan zhing khams rgya mtsho'i gos yol bre ba la sogs pa rgyal po'i dpal 'byor gyi bkod pa ngo mtshar ba bshams te spyan 'dren zhus/ li dmar las rgya gar yul dbus kyi bzo bos bsgrubs pa'i thub pa khyad chos sum ldan dang bkra shis pa'i rdzas dung dkar g.yas su 'khyil bas thog drangs pa'i 'bul chen dpag med mdzad/ zla ngo gsum tsam gyi bar du mchod dang bkur sti mtha' yas pas gus pas ri mor bgyis/ sgar chen dpon slob nas kyang dbon zhang bar sogs bde 'jags kyi bka' khyab gnang*/ de dag gi tshe 'bras yul skyed tshal nas chos rje gung pa dang slob dpon rab brtan pa mkhan slob dge 'dun rag rim dang bcas pas mjal zhing*/ byams chen pa rnams kyang spyi sgos so so nas 'bul ba bsnyen bkur yang dag pa bsgrubs/ de nas 'ong yug brgyud 'dzom thang dang snye skor du phebs par ci 'byor ba'i 'bul ba dang zhabs tog zhus shing*/ yab sras bka' gros nas 'brong bu dgon rnying du zhig gso dang bu khral gyi bka' bkod gnang nas slob dpon bsko bzhag kyang mdzad/ der chos sde byams mkhar nas rje dbon pan chen dpon slob rnams kyis kyang mjal/ lo chen ratna bhadra'i sku skye grwa rigs rnams kyis gdan drangs nas gtsug phud phul/ slar yangs can du phebs te de dag gi bar rnams su mdo mang gi 'phro mus rnams rje bla ma zhwa dmar pa'i gsan yig bzhin rdzogs par gsan/ hor stod smad kyi dpon khag rnams kyis gtsos byang ris kyi skya ser phal gyis mjal zhing 'bul zhabs bgyis/ yab sras bka' bgros nas yang ri bla ma bsko bzhag gnang*/ de nas dus gzings phran bur brten dbus phyogs su phebs dgos shar bas bzad smyug brgyud gong dkar du zhabs drung gis mjal 'dzom mdzad/ skyi shongs su phebs/ yang skur la sogs pa'i dmag thog gi sde dpon mi dmangs dang bcas pas mjal/

yab sras bka' bgros te dbus gzhung bde 'jags kyi bka' khyab gnang ba kun gyis spyi bos nod de chings don la 'khod/ 'brug lo'i lo sar dang smon lam mdzad/ yar rgyab dpon chen yum sras kyis tshal min du spyan drangs/ yun ring bsnyen bkur/ de nas rim bzhin dol mda' brgyud byams gling gi gnas mjal yang mdzad cing khra 'brug tu bzhugs pa'i tshe/ mkhar thog nas yum sras kyi dgongs rdzogs su nar ma'i zhabs tog dang khyad nor sna grangs su bkod pa'i 'bul ba bgyis shing*/ dge ba rgyun chags kyi mchod gzhis kyang phul/ der yar stod nas sde pa phun tshogs pa sogs sde dpon rigs dang*/ bla ma slob dpon kun gyis mjal zhing 'bul zhabs bgyis/ nyin re bzhin zhal mjal dang dge bskul la sogs pa mthong thos don ldan gyi phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i 'gro don dang*/ dus bzang kun la gtsug lag khang du rten mjal dang phyag mchod la phebs shing*/ pho brang yum bu bla mkhar dang*/ sne'u gdong*/ rtses thang*/ ras chung phug /shel brag rnams su phebs nas mjal mchod mdzad/ de rnams kun nas 'bul bsnyen rim par zhus shing*/ de dag gi tshe rje bla ma'i drung nas mdo sde rgyan dang spyod 'jug gi bshad lung gsan/ rje gong ma la mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob/ 'phyong rgyas sde pa hor bsod nams dar rgyas kyis thar po cher spyan drangs nas gus pa dang 'bul zhabs dpag med spros/ de nas gdan thel du phebs par spyan snga rin po ches rje gong ma dang khyad par ma mchis pa'i mos gus kyi gdung shugs chen pos bka' chos kyi 'brel pa gsan zhing*/ phyi nang gi rten gsum ma lus pa spyan lam du bstar ba'i rten mjal dang*/ zhag 'ga'i bar zhabs 'degs dang 'bul ba rgya chen pos bsnyen bkur ba mdzad/ brag kha brgyud bsam yas dang mchims phu'i gnas rten rnams zhib tu mjal ba dang phyag mchod mdzad/ sngags grwa rig 'dzin mkha' spyod gling du'ang zhabs pad bkod cing*/

'phreng po thub rgyal bas spyan drangs nas longs spyod kyi dngos po du mas yun ring por mchod cing bsnyen bkur zhing bzhugs skabs phar phyin zin thun gsan/ der 'bri khung khang gsar thog gis spyan 'dren nan zhu bzhin bsam yas phu brgyud mal gror phebs te 'bri khung rin po che rin rnam pa dang*/ chos rje khri thog pa dang*/ zur pa'i dbon chos rgyal phun tshogs kyis thog mar mjal zhing*/ bsu ba ser sbreng sogs pas spyan drangs nas bkra shis tshal du gdan phebs/ phag mo nas dpon sa yum sras rnams kyang phebs te/ thams cad kyis thugs mi 'phrogs pa'i dad pa dang gus pa chen pos bsten zhing zab mo nang don gyi ljags lung la sogs pa'i bka' chos gsan/ khang thog rtse sgril gyis zla ba gsum tsam gyi zhabs tog mdzad cing*/ thel gyi gnas mjal du yang phebs/ mkhan slob chos sgo ba sogs dge 'dun rnams kyis 'bul zhabs rgya cher bsgrubs/ de nas stag lung du spyan drangs nas chos rje rtse pa dang*/ grog kha ba mched kyis rim pas bka' chos gsan/ grwa mang khams bod kun gyis kyang rtse gcig dad pas mjal zhing 'bul zhabs spam cher zhus/ mchod khang gi rten rnams zhib mjal dang 'jag spyil dang rje mar pa'i gzim phug sogs su yang phebs/ de nas pu to'i gnas mjal dang bstun 'phan yul brgyud yangs can du phebs/ rtse sgang pas gtsos pa'i nyang long kong gsum spo bo stod smad dang bcas pa'i rta 'bul dang spyan 'dren pa rnams 'byor zhing*/ stag lung nas chos rje rtse pa yang phebs/ sbrul lo'i lo gsar dang smon lam gandho la'i rten shoms dang rten mjal rgyas par gnang*/ smon lam grol ba'i ser sbreng shis brjod kyi tshe 'brug skad yun ring grag pas kun gyi ltas bzang du gleng*/ hor dang tre dol bra rong sogs 'brog sde du mas nyi ma mang po'i bar brgya 'bul bgyis par zhal mjal byin rlabs chos 'brel dge bskul sogs kyis yid tshim par mdzad/

der bzhugs ring rje dus mkhyen bka' 'bum dang bka' brgyud gser phreng gi ljags lung gsan/ de nas mtshur phur phebs/ yab sras bka' bgros nas gtsug lag khang gi rgya phib zhig gsos kyi phal cher grub pa la phyag nas dang gser zho nyis brgya la sogs pa'i cha rkyen kyang bstsal/ de bzhin mtshur phu'i dkon gnyer yang zur res mos kyis 'dzin par mdzad pa'i bka' khyab kyis 'du khang chen mo'i bshu 'big shing rtsi dang bcas legs par grub pa'ang byung*/ de nas rgyal ba brgyud bander phebs/ rje dpa' bo'i sprul sku zhal bdag gnang ste chu shul du bzhugs thog nas gzhis ka gong dkar du spyan drangs te zhabs drung gdung brgyud rin po ches gtsug phud phul zhing zhal ngo thams cad kyis bka' chos 'brel pa gsan pa sogs gus 'bul rgya cher mdzad/ de nas smyug la bas zhabs tog yun ring zhus nas yar 'brog dpal der phebs/ der 'bras spungs sprul sku bsod nams rgya mtsho dpon slob phyag 'bul du phebs pa dang mjal 'dzom rten 'brel legs tshogs kyis phan tshun dgyes spro dang ldan par gyur cing*/ kha re gshar gyi gnas gzigs su'ang phebs/ de nas sna dkar rtser khri dpon mched kyis ring por zhabs tog zhus shing*/ mkha' ro'i gnas mjal kyang mdzad/ rje btsun ma auḍyan mtsho mo dpon slob kyis dzam gling chos 'khor du spyan drangs te phyag nas dang bka' chos kyi 'brel pa gsan zhing 'bul mchod cher bgyis/ de skabs chos drug gi bka' dpe gong 'og sogs dang*/ rngog pa'i man ngag phyag dreg ma pusti/ grub chen pakshi'i bka' 'bum yongs rdzogs rnams kyi lung gsan/ rim pas lho stod brgyud sras su phebs/ rje dpa' bo'i dngul gdung la phyag nas dang*/ sprul sku khri 'don gnang*/ der sbyong dkyil bcu gnyis kyi dbang rnams gsan/ dbu ma brag dkar ba'i sku skye byang du rdzong ba dang dbu 'don cher mdzad/

slar lho stod gang mdor phebs thog tshogs chos lung gi mkhan chen dang lho stod pa'i sde pa mched sogs phyag 'bul dang dad 'dus rnams zhal mjal chos 'brel sogs pas tshim par mdzad/ de nas 'brog smad du phebs te khri dpon pas lhun rdzong nas zhabs 'degs dang*/ 'brog stod smad kyi ser skya kun nas mjal zhing gus mchod spros/ rim pas rgyal gling du phebs par dpon chen pa yum sras mched rnams kyis gus zhabs zhus te/ lcags pho rta lo'i lo sar smon lam rten mjal dang*/ bka' chos kyi 'brel pa'ang ci rigs pa gnang*/ 'phyong rgyas su sde pa hor bsod pa zhal ngo rnams kyis spyan drangs nas gus 'byor rgya chen pos mchod cing gzhis kar phyag nas dang bka' chos mang du zhus/ der rje bla ma zhwa dmar lnga pa nyid kyi bka' 'bum pu ti dang po gnyis kyi lung gsan/ de nas yar stod du phebs thog nas gdan thel du spyan snga rin po che'i dgongs rdzogs su spyan drangs/ skyor lung nas gdung brgyud mched dang dge 'dun tshogs chen pa dpon slob mchod yon rnams nas rim pas mjal mchod dang gus pa chen pos bsten/ slar yang stod du phebs te sde pa phun tshogs pa dang lcam chos mdzad ma zhal ngos zla ba bdun tsam gyi bar nar ma'i zhabs tog dang 'bul nod rgya chen pos bsnyen bkur zhing*/ dad 'dus kyi skye bo du mas mjal zhing nor rdzas kyi dngos po ci rigs pa phul/ thams cad thar pa'i rgyur sbyor bar mdzad/ zla ba dgu par btegs nas/ g.ye chu tshan khar sde pa rgya ri bas mjal zhing 'bul bsnyen zhus/ spung dkar la thog tu sgo lcags kyis 'bul mchod dang*/ la rtsar sku rab nas sde pa khu dbon thab bsur byon/ de nas tsar sgam gyi ri pas gtsos pa'i dgon sde che phra thams cad kyis ser sbreng sogs bsu bkod chen pos sku rab bkras sgang du phebs/ gnas gzhir thog ma'i sgar ston zhus/ de nas kyang sgar ston gzabs shoms lan du ma dang*/

zla ba tsam gyi bar lung tshan so sos brgya 'bul dpangs bstod pa nyin re bzhin phul zhing*/ sde pa rang gi yang 'bul chen gyis sa yi khyon de dogs por bgyis/ zhal ngo dang dgon sar pa sogs la bka' chos kyi 'brel pa dang*/ gnas gzhir gandho la'i rten shoms dge 'dun gyi smon lam dang bcas pa sogs mdzad nas/ gdan bteg ste sgam po'i gnas mjal dang*/ sku 'dra rin po che la sogs pa'i rten rnams mjal mchod mdzad/ ri gnas rnams su'ang phebs/ sgom sder gzhi len gyis 'bul ba dang bsnyen bkur zhus shing tshogs pa rnams la bka' chos kyi 'brel pa'ang bstsal/ yom dgon du rin po che rnam rgyal ba dpon slob dang*/ ngo bo chos rdzong du nang so sgo pas kyang 'bul bsnyen bgyis te/ bshad sgrub gling du phebs par dwags po stod pa'i ser skya kun gyis mjal zhing 'bul tshogs spros/ lcags mo lug lo'i lo sar dang sgo pas zhabs tog zhus nas gzhi byes dge 'dun rnams kyis smon lam gandho la'i rten shoms dang bcas pa gnang*/ dgung lo bcu drug bzhes pa lo sar gyi tshes gcig nas mkhas dbang slob dpon rnam rgyal grags pa las phar tshad mngon pa sogs mdo phyogs kyi gsan pa'i dbu brtsams/ sgro skur gnyis ka nas zla ba 'ga'i bar zhabs tog dang 'bul bsnyen rim par sgrub skabs kong stod smad kyi ja zhus dang spyan 'dren rtse sgang sogs nas drung pa mched dang*/ mdo khams nas mnyan sprul yang ja sogs kyi 'bul chen bcas phebs/

de nas khra mo brag gi gnas gzigs dang*/ rab brtan gling gi dgon pa zhabs kyis bcags pa dang bstun sgo la nas sku rab tu phebs pa'i tshe sde pas yang zur cog grwa rnams la gnas gzhi'i tshoms chen du sgrub mchod zhag sbrel du btsugs par nyin re bzhin tshogs dbur phebs shing*/ gzim gur gyi yol ba'i nang du gzim khang chung ngu zhig mdzad pa'i rdo gcal du zhabs rjes gsal bar byon/ der zla ba tsam bzhugs nas la bar du phebs te zhag shas bzhugs skabs/ rang byung bka' 'bum las dkyil chog skor gyi dbang lung 'ga' shas gsan/ la thog zur mkhar du nang so blo gros rgyal po khu mtshan gyis 'bul ba dang bsnyen bkur zhus/ de nas kong po nga la nas dung brag tu phebs shing*/ bkra shis sgang du zla ba lhag tsam gyi yun du lding tsho ba rnams kyis 'bul zhabs dang*/ rkyen gnas rang du rgyal po rin chen sogs rkyen pa sgo gong 'og rnams kyis bsnyen bkur ring mor zhus/ der mchim blon gyi la khar ri gzigs su phebs nas phyag nas gnang ba zhol mo che'i gzim khang sogs grong kun tu phebs pa byung*/ de nas tsā ri rin phug gi gnas mjal mdzad nas mtsho dkar du phebs te mchod rten bkra shis 'od 'bar gyi rtsar phebs pa na/ nam mkha' dngas shing nyi ma gsal ba'i khor yug tu 'ja' tshon las grub pa'i bya dang 'brug gi gzugs sogs du mas bskor ba dang me tog gi char bab pa kun gyis mthong ba byung*/ slar skyen brgyud pa yor phebs thog bkra shis ljongs dang byin legs kyi gnas mjal la phebs shing tsā ri gsar ma'i gnas rnams su mchod g.yag tshogs khro la sogs pa'i gnang sbyin dang bla ma bsko bzhag dgos pa yab sras bka' bgros nas mdzad/ sog steng du dgon pa yon bdag dang bcas pas 'bul tshogs zhus/ de nas sle lung du dpon g.yu 'brug spun gyis 'bul zhabs dang*/ zur ru gdong grwa tshang rnams kyang mjal phyag 'bul ba zhus shing*/

de dag rnams su rang byung bka' 'bum las khrid skor sogs pa'i lung gsan/ 'or shod pa'i sde pa khag gsum gyis spyan drangs nas zla ba lhag tsam bzhugs ring*/ rtogs brjod dpag bsam 'khri shing dang*/ rje bla ma nyid kyi bka' 'bum las sgrub skor pusti'i lung gsan/ tshal bar nas brgyud zing po 'bum pa sgang du jo sgam po dar rgyas dang*/ dgongs 'dus pa sogs kyis 'bul zhabs kyis bsnyen bkur/ der mi bskyod rje'i bka' 'bum gyi lung gsan pa'i dbu tshugs shing*/ rje bla ma'i snyan du'ang gsol ba mdzad nas sgar chos sde'i drung 'khor dang grwa pa gzhon nu blo gsal ba kha yar bsdus te gsan sbyong gi phyags phyir sku gzhogs 'og min gling gi grwa tshang 'dzugs pa gnang*/ dpal ri dgon sogs kyang zhabs kyis bcags nas/ dga' ldan ma mor phebs te gser 'bum rin po che rnam gnyis sogs la phyag mchod dang*/ chu pho spre'u lo sar smon lam rten shoms dang bcas pa gnang*/ spyir kong yul du bya rgod mi yong ba la rje karma pa'i sprul sku phebs pa'i lo sar thog ma'i dus thams cad kyis mthong bar nam mkha' la bya rgod lding ba yod zhes zhus kyi rgan po'i ngag rgyun la gleng pa bzhin smon lam grol ba'i ser sbreng shis brjod kyi tshe nam mkhar rgod thang dkar gnyis 'khor zhing lding ba kun gyis mthong*/ 'jang rgyal blon dang zho nags sogs kyis 'bul skyel gtos che ba 'byor zhing*/ gzhan yang kong lung ral gsum gyi ser skya'i khrom tshogs dpag tu med pa 'dus par nyin re bzhin zhal mjal dang chos 'brel smon lam sogs gnang bas thams cad dga' spros dus 'da' bar gyur/ der yab sras bka' bgros nas zur tho ba rnams thab sgril te sgom grwa chen mor 'dogs pa dang bca' yig gnang zhing*/ snang srid zil gnon padma 'byung gnas kyis/ /zhes sogs pa'i gsol 'debs la sogs pa thugs rtsom 'ga' zhig kyang mdzad/

dpon tshang gong 'og sogs kyis bsnyen bkur dang ri mor bcas zla ba gsum tsam bzhugs nas/ hor zla gnyis pa'i nya skor nas bteg ste rtse lha sgang du phebs/ zhol thang du zla gnyis tsam bzhugs pa la karma nang sos gtsos kar srid rgya 'og dang bcas pas gus 'byor cher bsgrubs shing*/ tshal 'brug rnying ma sa dge la sogs pa'i bla ma grwa rigs dang bcas pa kun gyis mjal zhing 'bul rlabs spros te chos 'brel pas tshim par mdzad/ slar zur mkhar brgyud rdza ra'i sgrub sde yang zhabs kyis bcags par pha bong gi ngos la zhabs rjes byon/ de nas phrag yul du zur gdong grwa tshang rgya 'og dang bcas pas spyan drangs te nags yul spang du zla ba bzhi lnga tsam bzhugs nas dge 'dun rnams kyis dbyar zhal bzhes mdzad/ yab sras bka' bgros pa'i sgo nas chos rgya gso ba sogs spyi dgos su zhal tas legs khyab mdzad/ skyer pa bas rtsa gong du'ang spyan drangs/ cha pa nag brgyud rtsa nang gi gnas mjal dang bde yangs nas rgya la'i gnas gzigs la'ang phebs nas/ slar rnam thos kyi ri bor chu mo bya lo'i lo sar dang smon lam bkra shis dga' ston dge 'dun snam sbyar can bzhi brgya tsam gyi ser sbreng rgyal srid sna bdun gyi bkod pa dang bcas pa mdzad cing*/ de'i tshe 'brug grags pa dang char bab pa'i ltas bzang po yang byung*/ sku rim chen mo'i thog nas mdzod nag zhal 'byed gnang ste smon lam gyi ring mdzod nag dang byes kyi rten gsum mchod rdzas rags rim gyi mjal kha gnang*/ der karma nas drung pa gdung brgyud pa dpon slob dang kho ba bla ma/ 'jang rgyal blon gyis mngags pa'i spo 'bor ba'i 'gron tshan la sogs pa mdo khams stod smad kyi 'bul skyel ba du ma dang*/ dbus gtsang gi sde dpon so sos spyan 'dren gyi snyan gsan 'bul mi'ang rim par 'byor/ zla ba gnyis pa'i nang du btegs nas lta ba rgyal 'dzin du zla sbrel tsam bzhugs par rgya bdag rnams kyis 'bul ba dang bsnyen bkur dpag med bgyis shing*/

'brog lam sogs dgon rnams kyang zhabs kyis bcags/ g.yu ri dgon pa sogs spo bo kar srid stod pa'i rta 'bul gtos che ba 'byor/ de nas rgyal ba nyid dpon slob nyang kha phyogs su phebs nas zho kha dang nags phu'i dgon gnas rnams zhabs pad kyis rag par mdzad de/ de rnams kyi bla slob grwa mang yon bdag dang bcas pa kun gyis bsnyen bkur dang 'bul dpangs bstod/ gang du 'tsham pa'i rnam pa thams cad pa'i bka' yis legs khyab mdzad de/ rim gyis rtse sgang brgyud dga' ldan ma mor phebs te/ der rje bla ma'i drung du mjal skyes 'bul nod rgya cher mdzad cing*/ rje bla ma'i zhal snga nas kyang de'i mdzod nag zhal 'byed gnang ba'i rten mjal dang gzhi len gyi ston mo dgyes spro gzabs par gnang*/ der bzhugs skabs nas dbus su sngags grwa'i lha chen la phyag nas gnang ba phebs/ lhan rgyas phrag yul du spyan drangs te phrag thang spang du shing pho khyi'i lo sar smon lam rten mjal sogs mdzad cing 'jang gi 'bul skyel dang phyag phreng rgyal thang pa sogs kyi grwa rgyun gtos che ba'ang 'byor/ slar kong smad du chibs bsgyur te rim pas gsang dang lta ba rgyal 'dzin du phebs nas yab sras bka' bgros pas spo bo chu rub rdo rje'i gur khang*/ zar pe ba'i mi rgyud kyis 'dzin bkod dang de'i rgyab gnyer rgya bdag rnams kyis byed pa'i bka' khyab mdzad/ 'brog lam dang lkog 'phrang sogs dgon che phra mang dag gi bla slob bsko bzhag gnang zhing*/ grwa rgyun 'thus btsun sogs sbyor ba gnang*/ rtse sgang du phebs nas karma stod smad kyi yon bdag rnams la bka' khyab dang*/ sgrub sde gong du rab rgyas kun gling gi grwa tshang 'jog pa gnang*/ de dag gi skabs su rje gong ma'i bka' 'bum las 'dul ṭīk ma gtogs pa'i lung rnams rdzogs par gsan zhing*/ tshad ma'i bstan bcos rigs gzhung snying po sogs kyi thugs rtsom mang du mdzad/

der yab sras bka' gros kyi thog nas dwags kong dan 'jags kyi mjug sdom gyi bka' khyab mdzad/ rgyal ba nyid dpon slob nyung bsdus kyis tsā ri ma chen gyi gnas mjal du phebs/ gcig car du phebs rgyu'i snga nyin gzim gur 'bubs sar bu mo rgyan ldan mang pos bro byed pa dang*/ phebs nyin chibs rags kyi sngon la mi nag rta nag dar nag bzung ba gnyis byung ba gcig car ba rnams kyis mthong zer/ gcig car ba dang skyen pa sku rab pa sogs kyis tshogs 'khor dang 'bul ba bgyis shing*/ phar la'ang gnang cha gya nom pa stsal/ de nas la ba phug tu phebs pa'i tshe/ nam mkhar 'od gyi gur khang ngo mtshar ba byung zhing*/ sgrol ma la nas dag pa shel ri'i gzigs snang rgyas par gnang*/ dmar nag raktar phebs pa'i tshe sngon med pa'i dri bzang gi ngad bzang po yang byung*/ de nas pho brang chen mo g.yu mtsho khar phebs te/ der 'dus pa rnams la sku gsum ngo sprod kyi bka' chos gnang zhing zhabs rjes kyang byon/ rim gyis yul smad du phebs par ma chen gyi rdor 'dzin 'gron mgon las tshan rnams kyis 'bul zhabs bzang du bgyis shing*/ phar yang mang 'gyed sogs kyi gnang cha rgya cher mdzad/ ar gi rong dang zil chen sogs gnas phran rnams kyang zhabs kyis bcags/ de dag gi tshe sgrub gnas dang mtsho zhal phal che bar tshogs 'khor tshe ngo mtshar ba'i ltas bzang mang du byung*/ de nas chos zam gdong du phebs pa'i la thog tu zur mkhar bas tshogs mchod dang brgya 'bul bgyis/ de nas dgon che phra'i ser sbreng sogs bsu ba'i bkod chen gyis sku rab bkra shis sgang du phebs/ rje bla ma yang der phebs nas zhal rgyas par sa skyong sku rab pa khu dbon gyis gser kha gsar rdol gyi gser phud zho stong dang bzhi brgyas gtsos pa'i 'bul chen dang zhal ngo skye rgyal dman so so dang mnga' zhabs rnams kyis bsnyen bkur dang 'bul ba yang zad pa med pa lta bur bgyis te/

der bzhugs ring snyan dngags me long gi bshad pa gsan nas rtsom rgyugs kyang gnang*/ kha ba dkar nang sos gtsos grwa rgyun dang 'bul skyel mang du 'byor/ dwags stod nas bteg ste lam bar nas dpon ris dmangs bcas kun gyis gus mchod dang bcas bshad sgrub gling du phebs nas/ lo mjug sku rim dang shing mo phag lo'i lo sar smon lam bco lnga'i nyin ston pa grong khyer ma'i sku brnyan la gnas brtan bcu drug /dharma tā hwa shang rgyal chen bzhis bskor ba'i zlos gar dge 'dun gzhi byes kyi ser sbreng dang bcas pa'i shis brjod rgyas par mdzad/ sgo karma rab brtan gling du spyan drangs pa'i phebs lam du lcang ra bas kyang chos ston dang 'bul chen bgyis/ rab gling gi gtsug lag khang rten dang brten bcas gsar bzhengs la rab gnas dang dge 'dun rnams kyis smon lam bcas mdzad/ bsnyen bkur dang dga' ston gyi 'bul rlabs cher bsgrubs/ chos grwa rtse thang gi phyi nang zhal 'dzin sgar chen nas gnang dgos pa'i zhu bcar bzhin mgron gnyer rnams mi snar gnang*/ slar bshad sgrub gling du phebs/ der kun gyis 'bul mchod dang mdo khams stod smad nas 'bul skyel mang du 'byor/ zing po sle lung dwags kong ching mtshams kyi bka' bkod zhib tshag rnams kyang gnang nas/ tshar gu'i phu brgyud kun gyis bsnyen bkur rim bzhin chos kyi dga' ston stsal/ khrom sar du phebs/ lugs gnyis kyi bsu bkod dang gus 'byor rim par zhus shing chos bkas khyab par mdzad/ der dom tshang rdor 'dzin mchod yon gyis spyan 'dren ltar/ rgyal ba nyid dge 'dun gyi sde rnams kyis zham ring dang bcas lho rgyud du chibs bsgyur/ lam bar du mi sde yul 'brog dgon sde so so'i 'bul zhabs rim par bgyis shing*/ rnam dkar gyis khyab par mdzad/ dom tshang du phebs te gnas gzigs rnams mdzad cing*/ rdor 'dzin grwa rigs mon bod kyi yon bdag dang bcas kun gyis bsnyen bkur dang 'bul mchod cher stobs/

nang so 'bog kong pas mi 'phrog pa'i dad pas yun ring bteg cing*/ mi ngos gtsos pa'i grwa pa brgya dang brgyad mchod gzhis dang bcas pa phul ba dang*/ longs spyod kyi 'bul bsnyen gzhan dpag tu med cing*/ de nas lho stod du tshur phebs lam bya yul nas dpon sas gus mchod ches cher bcas/ khrom sar du phebs te yab sras zhal rgyas/ mdzod kyi ṭīk'i thugs rtsom kyi dbu tshugs/ der 'bras spungs sprul pa'i sku dang sde ba lha skur mchod yon gyis rtse 'phyong rgyas bar sogs kyi chings 'jags la yar klungs su spyan 'dren byung ba dang bstun btsan thang du phebs nas 'bras spungs ba mchod yon dang sgar chen yab sras bka' bgros te rtse 'phyong rgyas bar gyi chings dang*/ de zhor dbus phyogs tshang mar lo gsum gyi chings lugs bsdam pa'i bka' khra gnang*/ 'bras spungs nas dpon slob rnams kyis bsnyen bkur dang 'bul ba rgya cher mdzad cing phar yang gnang skyes bzang po bstsal/ ras chung phug sogs yar klungs kyi dgon dang dpon rigs so sos kyang bsnyen bkur zhus/ slar yar stod du phebs pa'i lam zhor/ thar gling grwa tshang gi gtsug lag khang rten gtso sar bzhengs kyi rab gnas sogs mdzad nas rim pas khrom sar du gdan phab nas/ me pho bya lo'i lo sar dang*/ lhun sgang tshoms chen du smon lam chen mo'i rten shoms dang bcas pa gnang ba'i shis brjod nyin phyogs bzhir bum gter 'god pa sogs gnang*/ sde bas 'bul chen dang mdo khams smad pa'i 'bul skyel grwa rgyun gtos che ba'ang 'byor/ gdung brgyud rin po che dang*/ thugs gling pa dpon blon gyis sne'u gdong rtser spyan drangs pa dang*/ gzhan yang yar lung rong ris g.ye sogs kyis mjal mi ser skya mang du 'dus pa dang*/ 'brong bu mched bcas kun nas 'bul dpangs bstod/ rtse thang gi chos khri chen mor ngo sngon pa dang*/ rtses thang tshogs pa'i 'bul chen dang*/

'du khang du yar stod chos mdzad mas gdugs tshod gsol/ gtsang khang rtse sogs kyi rten mjal phyag mchod gnang*/ slar 'du khang du legs bshad gling pa dang sgar gyi chos sde rnams tshogs pa'i mang ja smon lam dang*/ rtse thang gzhi par yang sgar gyi mdzod pa khag nas gser 'gyed dang ja 'gyed gya nom pa bstsal zhing*/ nyang po'i gru nas gdan sa dpal gyi phag grur phebs nas phyag chen lhan cig skyes sbyor nyams khrid kyi tshul du gsan zhing*/ rje dpa' bo'i sprul sku dpon slob dang dge 'dun sngags grwa ba rnams la dgongs gcig sngags tshoms kyi rnam bshad chen mo'i lung gnang*/ rje bla ma zhwa dmar pa bder gshegs phag gru'i seng khrir zhabs pad bkod pa'i mnga' gsol 'bul mi dga' ston dang ka phibs chen mo'i steng nas dge 'dun phyag brgyud kyi bkra shis pa'i rdzas rnams 'bul ba la sogs pa'i shis brjod rgyas par gnang zhing*/ thel gzhi pa'i tshogs par yang 'gyed chen gyi dga' ston bstsal/ gos 'phan chen mo bshams pa sogs phyi nang gi rten mjal zhib par gnang*/ gtsug lag khang chen mor gandho la'i rten shoms dang bcas dge 'dun rnams kyis smon lam kyang mdzad/ rje bla mar phyag bzo dang zhal bkod zhus nas 'og min gling grwa tshang du dgongs pa gtad pa'i mgon sku bzhengs pa gnang*/ zur mang sprul sku 'bul ba gtos cher bcas 'byor zhing*/ der gtsang phyogs su dus gzings la brten pa'i rong gtsang gnyis kas spyan 'dren btud mar byung bas rje nyid dge 'dun gyi sde rnams dang bcas snga 'gros su phebs/ byang kha brgyud de bsam yas dang mchims phu'i gnas mjal dang*/ sngags grwar lha chen la phyag nas sogs gnang zhing*/ lam bar 'phreng so ba dang*/ yab rgyal ba yum sras/ tshogs dge 'dun sgang gi mkhan chen/ chos rdzong 'phags pa sogs so so'i bsnyen bkur 'bul zhabs dang*/ gong dkar du zhabs drung zhal ngo rnams kyis gus pas bsnyen bkur shing phyag chen chos drug la sogs pa'i zab khrid kyi bka' 'brel stsal/

snyug lar phebs thog si tu sprul pa'i sku byon pa'i gtsug phud bzhes nas/ karma chos kyi rgyal mtshan dge legs dpal bzang po'i mtshan gnang zhing*/ sgra mi snyan pa'i tshe sgrub dang phyag chen chos drug gi khrid lung bstsal/ mnga' gsol shis brjod kyang mdzad/ sku 'khor nyung shas dang bcas lha sar jo mjal du phebs shing rten mjal gnang tshe sngar med kyi 'od dang dri bzang gis khyab pa byung zer/ rten rnams zhib mjal dang phyag mchod smon lam rgya cher mdzad nas/ smyug lar bzhugs sgar du tshur phebs te/ rdza dkar gyi la brgyud/ bsil snar drung nas khu dbon

dang*/ hor stong pas gzhi len sogs dang*/ gtsang nas sku mdun shing shag pa'i ja 'dren sogs 'byor zhing*/ de nas jo mo gangs su phebs/ tshogs mchod btegs nas/ 'brong bu dgon rnying du'ang 'bul cha bstsal/ 'o yug tu dam can la spyan gzigs dang gtor gsos gnang zhing rgyal bstan bsrung ba'i phrin las gzhol bar mdzad/ sde pa lha phu bas yun ring bsnyen bkur bas btegs/ de nas sku mdun shing shag pa dpon g.yog rnams kyis thab 'dzin rta bsu dang dge 'dun che phra kun gyis ser sbreng sogs bsu ba'i bkod pa du ma dang bcas te rnam gling du phebs par 'bul zhabs bla lhag tu bsgrub shing*/ bka' bkod dang bstun nas gtsang gi dpung grwa rnams kyang re zhig gyes su bcug ste/ bar chings zla grangs la 'byon pa zhus/ de tshe jo mo gangs la sogs par dben pa ring du bsten par dgongs kyang*/ gdul bya spyi dgos rtse rgyang gis mi 'dor bar gsol btab bzhin re zhig de nyid kyi yang dben dkar po brag tu sku mtshams la bzhugs pa'i khog nas sgar phyi nang dge 'dun sde rnams dang bcas par bca' yig gnang ba sogs gyi legs khyab mdzad/ slar sku mtshams grol nas gsung rab gling du phebs shing*/ ngam ring chos sder mang bskol dang rje bla ma'i drung du'ang spyan 'dren dang lo sar 'bul mi sogs rim par gnang*/ de phyogs kun gyis mjal 'bul dang*/ rim pas lo mjug sku rim chen mo dang me mo glang lo'i lo gsar smon lam rten shoms dang bcas rgyas par gnang*/ der mdo smad dang lho rong*/ byang ris sogs phyogs kyi 'bul chen pa mang du lhags shing*/ mngon mdzod kyi 'grel pa thugs rtsom grub pa dang gser mdog can nas mkhan slob rnams phyag 'bul du byon pa 'grig pas chos mngon pa la sogs pa'i 'bel gtam rgya cher gnang*/ zla ba gnyis par cog ro na khar bzhugs sgar gnang nas bzhugs skabs thel nas rje bla ma chibs bskyod gnang ba la/

phebs bsu dang thab 'dzin/ dge 'dun gzhi byes kyi ser sbreng*/ rgyal ba nyid kyang sgar gsham du zhabs bsur phebs pa la sogs pa'i bsu bkod mtha' yas pa mdzad de yab sras zhal rgyas te/ gsung gling lha chen gzungs bzhugs dang rab gnas bskyar ma gnang zhing*/ zhar du 'og min gling par gnang rgyu mgon sku yang rab gnas mdzad/ der sde pa zhing gis gsol mchod 'bul chen dang*/ gzhan yang phyogs kun nas mi chen bla dpon mang rab 'dus shing 'bul chen tshan mang 'byor/ yab sras chibs rags nyung bsdus kyis rin spungs su phebs par/ ding phon gsang 'dus rgyab yol gyis gtsos pa'i 'bul ba dang bsnyen bkur mtha' klas shing*/ rong gtsang dan 'jags kyi bka' khra gnang ste dpung grwa rnams kyang so sor gyes/ re zhig dus kyi 'khrug long zhi bar mdzad cing*/ mkhan chen lung rig pa phyag 'bul du phebs par zab mo nang don gyi ljags lung bstsal zhing*/ stong nag chu 'phur 'byor bas kyang 'bul chen dang*/ byams chen pa rnams kyis dgon ma lag dang bcas zhal 'dzin du phul bzhin/ slar rin spungs dang byams chen du phebs skabs chos mdzad ma karma rnam grol gyis spyan drangs nas mchod gzhis sogs phul ba'ang 'og min gling par sbyor ba gnang*/ de nas lha phu bas spyan drangs shing sde pa zhing gis dga' gdong du kar lugs grwa tshang 'dzugs par zhus pa la mkhan po bsko bzhag gnang ba'i grwa rgyun rnams zhabs drung du 'byor/ lha phu rin gling du phebs thog nas 'bras spungs chos rje sog yul du phebs pa'i rdzongs kyi gnang cha'i gser yig pa gnang zhing*/ rim par zab phu lung gnas mjal sogs kyang mdzad nas/ sa pho stag lo'i lo sar smon lam rten shoms dang bcas pa mdzad/ sos snar sne skor thang du bzhugs sgar gnang skabs sog po bo shan pakshi sogs pa 'byor bas gser dngul gos dar rnga mo la sogs kyi 'bul chen bgyis shing yig drug bzlas lung zhu ba dang dge ba'i khas len ci rigs pa'ang bgyis/

de nas bsam rtser zhing gis rnyed dang bkur sti mtha' yas pas bteg ste bzhugs skabs/ hor stod smad pa'i gdan 'dren btud mar sleb pas byang ngos su chibs bsgyur/ lha phur dwags po bka' 'bum gyi lung gsan/ de nas gnam khog sogs brgyud/ 'dam ko khyim du phebs par hor dpon sde dmangs bcas kun gyis 'bul zhabs rgya che ba ring mor bgyis shing zhal mjal gsung chos la sogs pas skye bo mang po mngon mtho dang nges legs kyi rgyu 'bras la sbyor bar mdzad nas/ rwa sgreng rgyal ba'i dben gnas su phebs nas jo bo 'jam dpal rdo rjes gtsos pa'i rten gsum rnams la phyag mchod smon lam dge 'dun rnams la yang mang ja 'gyed bcas bstsal/ slar ko khyim las bye lung gi dge bshes ston pa dang*/ dpal mkha' spyod pa 'khrungs gnas sogs kyi gnas mjal mdzad cing*/ stod klung bde chen du thogs shig bzhugs nas mtshur phur phebs te me yos lo sar dang*/ 'du khang chen mor gzhi byes kyi dge 'dun tshogs che bar smon lam 'dzugs pa gnang ba'i cho 'phrul gyi dus chen la drung na rim gyi thugs dam rten gtso gandho la dang*/ gzhan yang thub sku li ma byin rlabs khyad can du ma'i rten shoms rgyas par mdzad pa'i drung du rje thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog 'bangs kyi zhal snga nas mkhan por gsol zhing*/ rgyal tshab sprul skus las slob/ mkhas dbang rnam rgyal grags pas gsang ston/ grib tshod pa dang las kyi kha skong tshogs dge 'dun sgang gi mkhan chen ston pa ba sogs/ dge 'dun grangs tshang mtshan nyid dang ldan pa las rgyal ba nyid dgungs lo nyer bzhi bzhes pas bsnyen par rdzogs pa mdzad de/ mkhan po'i drung du bka' drin gyi yon shel dang gser dngul gyi spyad pa/ na bza'/ sku chas/ ja/ gos/ gser/ dngul sogs sna grangs dngos gtsang sum brgya'i 'bul nod dang las grwa ba sogs dge 'dun spyi la'ang mang ja rnam gzhag gya nom pa bstsal zhing*/

mkhan po rje bla ma mchog gi phyag nas kyang dga' ston gyi 'bul bstod du rgyal ba rigs lnga ston pa dang bcas pa'i gos sku thog tshad ma drug gis gtsos pa'i 'bul tshan dngos gtsang grangs mang sogs sgar phyi nang dang phyogs kyis dga' ston legs ja 'bul mi yang mang du byung*/ byang nas hor dpon sogs dang*/ 'jang rgyal blon gyi 'bul skyel gtos che ba'ang 'byor/ bco lnga'i nyin gso sbyong dang ser sbreng shis brjod bkra shis pa'i rdzas rgyal srid sna bdun gyi zlos gar dang bcas rgyas par mdzad/ zla ba gnyis par 'dul ba lung sde bzhi'i ljags lung gsan pa'i dbu tshugs shing*/ zla ba bzhi par yab sras zhal rgyas kyis 'og min gling pas rgyal dbang nyid kyi dngul sku gsar bzhengs la rab gnas gnang*/ bla g.ye lho ma'i sa khul zhabs kyis bcags pa'i zhal bkod phyag nas dang*/ dbon gu shri pa la mchod gong gso ba'i zhal ta gnang*/ de dag gi bar du 'dul ba lung gi ljags lung yongs su rdzogs nas/ rje gong ma'i 'dul ṭīk chen mo dang*/ rang byung bka' 'bum 'phro mus dang*/ drung rol pa'i rdo rje'i bka' 'bum lung yang rim par gsan zhing*/ zur mang pa sogs lhags/ hor stod pas spyan drangs te mtsho srib sogs su dpon khag sde tshan so so dang bcas pas 'bul bsnyen rgyun ring du zhus shing skye bo de dag gi tshogs la zhal mjal bka' chos la sogs pa'i phrin las mtha' yas pas dge ba'i sa bon rgyud la 'jog par mdzad nas/ slar mtshur phu nyid du phebs nas/ 'du khang chen mo'i logs bris rnams grub pa'i zhal byang 'khrungs rabs don bsdus rje bla mar thugs rtsom zhu ba dang*/ ston pa gtso 'khor gyi sku 'bag dang*/ ma mgon mgar gsum 'chams sku/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i sku sar bzhengs/ 'du khang logs bris dang bcas par rje bla ma'i drung du rab gnas zhu ba gnang nas rab tu gnas pa mtha' rgyas sbyin sreg bkra shis dga' ston bcas rgyas par gnang nas/

de dag gi skabs su nā ro'i chos drug nyams khrid kyi tshul du gsan zhing*/ drung de bzhin gshegs pa/ mthong ba don ldan/ chos grags rgya mtsho/ dpal mkha' spyod pa rnams kyi bka' 'bum dang*/ bka' gdams glegs bam/ 'bri khung zab chos rnams kyi lung yang rim pas gsan/ de skabs kong stod smad kyi rta 'bul gtos che ba dang*/ sog yul nas 'bras spungs chos rje'i zhu 'phrin dang ja zhus kyang sleb/ de nas lcags pho 'brug lo'i lo sar gnang nas/ smon lam kyi thog skyi shod nas stag lung dpon sa byon pas brgya 'bul mdzad cing*/ rgyal rigs zol sras kyis gtsos pa'i 'jang gi 'bul skyel sogs mang du sleb/ zla ba gnyis par o rgyan bsnyen sgrub kyi skor ljags lung gsan pa'i dbu tshugs shing*/ bar skabs rje bla ma mnyel bab lci ba zhig byung bar sku rim dang brtan bzhugs gnang bas bsnyun dngas pa'i dgyes spro'i 'bul nod rgya cher nga mdzad/ mchod khang chen mo'i sgo khang gzabs bcos dang sgo srung dpal lha mo dang rgyal chen bzhi'i sku rnams bzhengs pa brtsam/ yar rgyab nas sde pa mched sogs pas 'bul chen bstar/ hor smad pas yab sras byang du spyan 'dren gyi pho nya rim 'byor bzhin/ chibs bsgyur te 'dam ko khyim dang*/ dkar po sgo la sogs par phebs pa la dpon karma dpal sde ris dang bcas pa rnams kyis 'bul zhabs rgya cher bgyis shing*/ zhal mjal gsung thos kyi 'brel pa sogs thabs mkhas thugs rje'i phrin las kyis skye bo mang po mngon mtho dang nges legs kyi rgyu 'bras la sbyor bar mdzad de/ slar yangs can du phebs pa na/ gtsang rong dus gzings kyi dum la spyan 'dren pa 'byor bas dam gdams du rgyal tshab sprul sku rdzong ba gnang*/ rgyal ba nyid mtshur phu dang*/ rje bla ma gnas nang du phebs/ slar rje bla ma'i drung nas gnas nang du spyan drangs te zhal rgyas kyi byams khang sgo khang gi logs ris kyi rab gnas gnang zhing*/

rje bla mas gzhi len gyi bsnyen bkur 'bul dpangs bstod pa dang*/ phar yang legs ja'i 'bul nod gzabs pa gnang*/ re zhig rgyal ba nyid mtshur phur phebs/ slar zhal rgyas kyi snang rtse dga' grong du phebs nas chos gzhis pa dang shun zhabs drung yan phyin lugs legs kyi bka' gnang bstsal/ rje bla ma thel sogs su spyan 'dren bzhin phebs/ rgyal ba nyid mtshur phur phebs skabs nas rgyal sprul pas gtsang phyogs kyi chings lugs grub nas sde pa lha rdor ba mched kyis spyan 'dren zhu ngor gtsang phyogs su gdan btegs lam nas lha phu ba sogs kyis zhabs bsnyen rim bzhin/ gsung rab gling du phebs nas lo mjug sku rim dang lcags sbrul lo sar gnang*/ bsam rtser phebs par rta bsu ser sbreng sogs kyi bsu bkod rgya cher bcas bsam rtse klu sdings su gdan phab/ der smon lam btsugs pa'i bco lngar rgyal ba nyid tshogs su phebs pa'i gso sbyong gnang*/ de nas rim pas tshoms chen du dkar dro gzabs shoms dang 'gro mgon 'phags pa'i thugs dam rten bde mchog drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil thang hor dus kyi spras thags 'dom 'khor gyis gtsos pa'i 'bul chen rgya che ba bgyis te bsngo ba smon lam gyi rgyas 'debs pa mdzad/ bkra shis lhun po/ chos sde brag dmar ba/ gser mdog can pa rnams kyi mkhan slob dang dge 'dun rags rim 'bul ba dang mjal phyag tu byon par yang so so'i mos pa dang 'tshams pa'i bka' chos kyi 'brel pa ci rigs pa gnang*/ gzhan yang der 'dus kyi skye bo ji snyed pa mthong thos don ldan du mdzad nas/ slar rnam gling du phebs thog 'jang rgyal blon spo 'bor ba'i 'bul skyel 'byor zhing*/ grwa tshang yan phyin sogs der 'khod kun chos dang zang zing gi bka' drin legs khyab mdzad de/ lha phu ba dpon blon sogs nas bteg ste zhabs bsnyen/ de nas rim gyis gzhu gru bzhi'i gnas mjal du phebs par brag la chibs pa'i zhabs rjes byon/

slar mgo thon nas brgyud zla ba bzhi par bsu ba'i bkod pa dpag tu med pa dang bcas gdan sa mtshur phur phebs nas mchod khang gong 'og gi mkhar las rten bzhengs 'phros mus rnams la gzigs rtog dang*/ tre sprul dpon slob kyis a sa ri khrod gzim khang gsar bcos dngul 'bum dang bcas par rab gnas mdzad/ sgrub sde skyid mtsho gling gsar 'dings dang gzim skyil sogs rim pas mdzad de bsam gtan yid 'ong gling du 'dogs pa gnang*/ mchod gong gi dbu rtse dang*/ dngul sku rdor 'chang*/ rgyal chen sogs grub par rgyal sprul la rab tu gnas par bka' gnang bstsal/ slar yang mchod gong gzabs bcos gtsang khang du rdor gdan byang chub chen po'i sku tshad kyi ston pa gtso 'khor dang dbu rtser ston pa rdor 'chang gi dngul sku bzhugs pa sogs rten brten pa dang bcas grub pa'i rab gnas su rje bla ma spyan 'dren par gnang nas bsu ba'i bkod chen dang bcas pas 'du khang chen mor gdan 'dzom pa la rje bla ma'i zhal snga nas sku skyos kyi 'bul nod dpangs bstod mdzad cing*/ de nas chu pho rta lo'i cho 'phrul chen po'i thog mtshur gnas yangs can rnams kyi dge 'dun mang bsdus kyis dpal dus kyi 'khor lo sogs rgyud sde mang po'i chog grwa dang*/ dge 'dun zur ri dang cog grwa'i bde mchog pa rnams kyi dbur rje bla ma bzhugs pas rab tu gnas pa legs par gnang ba'i rjes dga' ston gyi tshe rdo rje slob dpon gyi yon du gser zho brgya dngul srang brgyas gtsos pa'i 'bul chen dang*/ rje bla ma'i phyag nas kyang rten bzhengs kyi legs ja'i 'bul nod dpangs bstod pa gnang*/ khams nas tsher lung sku skye 'bul skyel du 'byor zhing*/ 'bri khung khang thog nang 'khrogs pa'i dum la gdan 'dren byung bar bka' gros thog nas mdo rgyud pa dpon g.yog snga 'gros su gnang*/ rim pas rgyal ba nyid dpon slob kyang gdan btegs nas/

bzhugs sgar tshal spror phebs te zhag shas bzhugs skabs/ 'jang du rgyal pos bka' 'gyur gsar bzhengs bgyis pa la phyag nas gnang ba pho brang du phebs pas rgyal blon 'bangs bcas mi phyed pa'i dad pa dang dga' spro dpag med thob par gyur zer/ de nas nang sos khang thog bar chings thon pas re zhig sgar chen phebs ma dgos par slar mtshur phu nyid du phebs shing*/ nam bkras pa la mchod gong gi khyams su gnas brtan bcu drug gi logs bris bgyid du bcug /gnas nang byams khang khyams kyi logs bris rnams rje bla ma'i zhal snga nas legs par grub pa'i rab gnas su bsu ba'i bkod pa chen pos spyan drangs te phebs/ phan tshun 'bul skyel gya nom pa'i dga' ston dang phyag nas mdzad cing*/ slar mtshur phur phebs nas lho stod pas yab sras lhan cig spyan 'dren zhus ngor rim pas phebs lam rnams su 'bul mchod kyis zhabs bsnyen rim bzhin/ mkha' ro'i gnas gzigs kyang mdzad/ zhwa mdar byang bdag po bkra shis stobs rgyas byon nas mjal phyag dang 'bul ba sogs mdzad/ de nas lho stod pa dpon g.yog sde dgon rnams kyis bsu bkod rgya cher bcas mon thang gnas su gdan phebs par rim gro dang bsnyen bkur zhus te bzhugs ring*/ oḍyan bsnyen sgrub ljags lung 'phro mus/ zhang gi bka' 'bum/ khro phu brgya rtsa/ yang dgon bka' 'bum rnams kyi ljags lung gsan/ sras mkhar dgyes rdor pho brang du phebs nas sku gsum ngo sprod nyams khrid du gsan/ gnam stong la gzhi byes kyi dge slong gi dge 'dun grangs mang po'i tshogs su yab sras zhal rgyas kyis phebs nas gso sbyong gnang*/ skabs der rje bla ma dpon slob mon yul du spyan drangs nas skor tsam phebs song*/ rgyal ba nyid kyang spel chung bas chos rdzong du spyan drangs nas bsti stang cher bgyis/ slar sras su yab sras zhal rgyas nas re zhig bzhugs/

de nas tshur phyags btegs ste/ rje bla ma dpon slob dgun bzhugs lho stod du gnang rgyu dang*/ cung zad bsnyun pa'ang dngas skabs nas sgar chen sngon du sman thang brgyud/ 'brog smad rom por chu mo lug lo'i lo sar gnang zhing*/ yul gru de dag gi sde dgon ji snyed pas dad 'byor dpag med bsgrub cing*/ rim pas phebs te/ dol mdar yar rgyab pa'i 'bul zhabs kyi yun ring btegs/ tshogs dge 'dun sgang gi mkhan chen dang*/ dge 'dun 'phags sde dang*/ sngags grwa ba sogs par chos sbyin ci rigs pa dang*/ skye bo gzhan la'ang zhal mjal gsung chos kyi legs khyab bstsal zhing*/ 'phrang po dang 'jang chu smyug bzang rnams rim brgyud kyis mtshur phur phebs shing*/ sog yul nas stong nag chu 'phur ba spun sogs 'byor bas/ rgyal po dal jing gi zhu lan dang bcas pa'i 'bul chen bgyis/ bde chen nas drung nas dpal 'byor bas tshal spror spyan drangs te 'bul mchod cher bgyis/ byin rlabs sogs blo kha tshim par bstsal/ slar mtshur phur phebs te/ mchod gong tre po'i las tshan gyis 'dzin pa dge slong bzhi sde rnams la rtsis sprod gnang zhing*/ snang rtse rig 'dzin pa gshegs pa'i rjes sgrub tu dbon kar bstan pas bde chen du spyan drangs te bsngo ba smon lam gyi rten rgya che ba dang*/ sgar chos sde rnams la'ang mang ja 'gyed bcas sogs bsnyen bkur gya nom pa zhus/ de nas gdan sa nyid du phebs skabs rje bla ma mchog sku bro la brten pa'i sku khams bde rgyu med pa zhig la lho stod nas dol mdar phebs pa'i zhu 'phrod 'byor bas brtan bzhugs 'bul mi gnang*/ rim pas phyag mdzod nas gzhi byes ri klung kun la mang ja 'bul 'gyed rim 'byor ltar 'du khang chen mor tshogs dbur phebs te/ thams cad kyi 'dun pa rtse gcig pas sku rim brtan bzhugs drag tu bsgrubs shing*/ sku gzhogs su'ang snga mgyogs rnam 'joms sgrol dkar gyi khrus chab dang bcas pa'i brtan bzhugs 'bul

mi dang*/ de nas rgyal ba nyid kyang dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi sku'i rim gro dang*/ sri zhur chibs rags hrag bsdus kyis phebs te/ rnam sras pho brang du sku mtshams kyi khog tu zhal rgyas par mjal skyes bzang po dang brtan bzhugs 'bul ba gnang*/ tshur yang mjal skyes dang gsol ja bzhi lnga'i bar gsung gleng dang dgyes dgyes dpag tu med pa gnang*/ de nas nyin ri bzhin dang skabs su gnang cha cags kyis sku gzhogs su phebs nas mjal 'dzom gsung gleng gnang zhing brtan bzhugs 'bul ba dang*/ sgar mang chos sde gzhi byes la sku rim gyi mang ja rnam gzhag tshogs 'gyed rgya che ba gnang ste/ gsung sgrogs la sogs pa'i sku rim dar drag tu sgrub pa gnang yang sku khams dngas bskyed med pa'i tshul bstan te rje bla ma de nyid dgung lo lnga bcu rtsa dgu pa chu mo lug lo gro bzhin gyi zla ba'i nyer gsum la sku mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul bstan pas/ sku gdung rin po che dri bzang gis bgos pa'i dar zab dang ras zung gis dkri ba la sogs pa'i bkur sti dang phyag mchod mdzad de/ gsang khog nas yangs can du spyan 'dren pa dang*/ gsang brtol dang bstun sgar chos sde rnams su sprul sku myur 'byon gyi gsol 'debs 'dzugs pa/ sku mchod thog ma'i mang bskol sogs gnang sde/ legs gling nas gdan btegs/ yangs can du phebs/ gdung mjal dang phyag mchod rgyas par gnang zhing*/ yangs/ mtshur/ gnas nang*/ zur ri/ cog grwa sogs gzhi byes kyi dge 'dun mang pos mchod 'bul gyi chog mang 'dzugs pa dang*/ de nas rim pas rgyal ba nyid mgon du bzhugs nas phyag rdzas kyi dngos po phal che ba phyogs mtha'i gdung 'bul rnams dang bcas rje gong ma rnams kyi dgongs rdzogs kyi deb bzhin dbus gtsang la stod dwags kong yan phyin gyi dge 'dun phyogs dang ris su ma chad pa kun la/ mang ja spyi 'gyed bla slob rnams la mchod bsngo'i rten gyi rnam gzhag dang*/

lha sa'i jo bo rin po che'i drung du gser zho phyed dang nyis brgya las grub pa'i maṇḍal gyis gtsos rten gsum rnams la mchod sprin gyi dngos po rgya cher bstsal zhing*/ phyag dpe rten mchod sogs sprul pa'i sku phyi ma'i sku'i nyer spyad du 'os pa 'ga' shas bka' rgya'i tshul du yang 'jog pa gnang*/ de dag gi skabs su rgyal ba nyid kyi phyag nas kyang mchod 'bul gyi cho ga ba rnams la mang ja rnam gzhag sogs gzhan yang dgongs pa rdzogs thabs rgya cher bsgrubs pa mdzad cing*/ zla ba bcu pa'i tshes gnyis la gdung chog grol ba'i ser 'du'i grwar dbur klu sdings su phebs pa la/ phyag mdzod gzhi byes nas mchod bsngo rten gyi 'bul 'gos su dngos bdog mang du bstar zhing*/ dge 'dun spyi la chog yon dpangs bstod/ bla slob dpon rnams la rnam gzhag dang bcas pa phul zhing mchod bsngo rgyas par gnang*/ de nas sku gdung gi mchod rten rin po che bzhengs pa'i rgyu dang 'bad pa gang ci'i thugs khur rgyal ba nyid nas bzhes pa'i phyag g.yog lag len pa kha dkar dbon gzim dpon pas bgyis shing*/ bkod pa dang mgo lung bzo rig pa nam bkras sogs sprel por bkas bkos te 'dzugs ston gnang nas nar ma'i yo byad dang mthun rkyen sbyar te/ bal po bdun sogs kyis bde chen du bzo gra btsugs shing*/ dngul gdung bzhugs yul mkhar las kyi zhal ta'ang gnang*/ de nas yangs can nas gdan btegs/ bde chen tshal spro sogs su zhabs tog bsnyen bkur bcas mtshur phur phebs/ rim pas lo mjug sku rim dang*/ shing pho spre'u lo sar gnang*/ mchod gong 'du khang logs bris sogs par rab gnas mdzad/ sog yul nas 'bras spungs chos rje dang*/ rgyal po a dpal gyi zhu phrin dang mi sna/ 'jang rgyal blon gyis 'bul skyel gtos che ba/ yang ri ba khams nas byon pa rnams rim 'byor so so'i 'bul chen bgyis/ de nas hor dpon karma dpal dus las 'das pa'i 'dren dpon don du spyan 'dren nan gyis 'byor pa bzhin gdan bteg ste/

yangs can du rje bla ma'i sku gdung rin po cher phyag mchod smon lam gnang nas rim pas phebs pa'i lam bar du dpon tshang dang stag lung chos rje mched kyang 'dren don du phebs pa'i ja 'dren sogs pa 'byor ba dang bcas ru ba spar sgam mdar yod par phebs pa la dpon tshang nas sgar chos sde dang bcas par gsol phog sogs nar ma'i zhabs tog byang bzhus bsngo rten gyi 'bul ba gtos che ba grangs mang du bgyis pa dang*/ byang ris kyi skye bo mang du tshogs pas kyang 'bul zhabs dpangs bstod cing kun la 'phral yun du bde legs 'byung ba'i thugs rje'i 'jug pa rgya cher bstsal zhing*/ stag lung chos rje mched kyang 'bul mchod bcas gus 'dud du byon/ 'bal rom gnas mjal bcas gnang nas gdan bteg ste/ 'dam du dpon tshang stod pas bsnyen bkur zhus nas/ yang stag lung chos rje mched thang 'brog tu phebs pas gzhi len gyi zhabs tog dang 'bul dpangs bstod pa mdzad/ rgyal ba 'brom dang dpal mkha' spyod pa bltams pa'i sa dang*/ phu chung ba'i sgrub gnas rnams kyi gnas mjal mdzad tshe/ rgyal ba zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin pa'i dus gsum gyi rnam thar ji snyed pa thams cad gsal bar mkhyen cing gzigs/ de nas glang gdong gi gu ru'i sgrub phug la sogs pa'i gnas mjal mdzad nas yangs can du phebs pa na lho brag nas sprul sku dpon slob zhabs drung du byon pas rje bla ma'i dgongs rdzogs kyi gdung 'bul dang*/ rgyal ba nyid tshogs dbur spyan drangs pa'i mang ja 'gyed rnam gzhag dang bcas pa mdzad/ der gdung mjal phyag mchod smon lam sogs gnang nas bsil snar chab tshan la phebs thog zho nags nas rje bla ma'i dgongs rdzogs su dmigs pa'i 'bul skyel 'byor/ stag lung chos rje rtse pa'i zhu phrin rje bla ma'i dgongs rdzogs su dmigs pa'i 'bul nod dang bcas pa'ang 'byor/ de nas zab phu'i gnas mjal du phebs/ 'o yug sding ma'i sgrub chu sogs kyang mjal/

phebs lam gyi gter lung rnams rim pas mjal ba mdzad nas/ zab phu mthil du phebs/ lha phu bas phebs bsu thab 'dzin nar ma'i zhabs tog rgyas par zhus te gnas gzigs zhing par mdzad de/ tshes bcu'i mchod pa rgyas par gnang ba'i tshe lho stod nas sde pa tshos nye bar bskul ba'i rkyen gyis gu ru lha khang bas chos dbang gi gter skal gyi padma gu ru 'bul du mngags pa 'byor ba'i rten 'brel legs tshogs su gyur pas dgyes pa chen pos gsol 'debs bsam pa lhun grub ma yang 'dzugs pa gnang*/ de nas lha phu bas zhabs bsnyen zhing*/ dgra 'dul spang du bzhugs skabs gu ru lha khang par rten tshab padma gu ru'i 'dra bshus rten 'dam las grub pa phyag bzor mdzad nas gnang zhing*/ rim par phebs/ jo mo gangs kyi gnas gzigs dang yangs can du dngul gdung bzhugs pa'i mkhar las la gzigs rtog sku gdung mjal mchod sogs gnang nas mtshur phur phebs thog /spo bo ba'i 'bul skyel dang shun zhabs drung sogs kyi 'bul chen bcas lhags/ bar skabs gzhu gru bzhi'i dgon par phebs te mkha' phug tu phag mo sgrol dkar phyag rdor rnams kyi sgrub pa'i sku mtshams zhag shas zhig gnang zhing*/ zla ba bdun pa'i nyer gsum rje bla ma'i sku mchod chen mo'i thog yangs can du sku gdung rin po che'i thog drangs rten gsum rnams la mchod 'bul/ dge 'dun rnams la chog mang gi cha rkyen sogs bstsal zhing*/ sgar gyi chos sde rnams su yang tshogs mang du sgar pa rnams la ja sogs 'gyed chen bstsal/ de nas slar gdan sa nyid du phebs nas bsam gling du sgrol dkar gyi ljags bsnyen 'phro mus dang*/ mgon po'i sgrub pa'i sku mtshams la bzhugs shing*/ dngul gdung rten dang brten pa dang bcas bzhengs pa'i sgang ston rnam gzhag dang bcas rgya cher bstsal/ sku mtshams grol nas gtsug lag khang du phebs pa na/ gling zur mang rgyal rong pa sogs khams phyogs kyi 'bul skyel mang du 'byor bar so sor chos sbyin ci rigs pa'ang bstsal/

rje dpa' bo'i sprul sku dang mtshur phu rin po ches gtsos pa'i don gnyer mang por khro phu brgya rtsa dang mi bskyod rje'i bka' 'bum dgongs gcig 'grel chen sogs kyi ljags lung gnang zhing*/ bskang ba khang du rten gtor 'dzugs pa gnang*/ de nas rim pas shing mo bya lo'i lo sar smon lam bcas gnang ste/ stag lung nas dpon ngag bsod pa khrir phebs pa la legs skyes shis brjod dang*/ rin po che ma chen khams phyogs la thegs par gshegs skyes kyi gnang cha mi sna bcas gnang zhing*/ 'jang dang spo 'bor ba'i spyan 'dren 'bul skyel ba mang du lhags/ dge tshul bsgrub pa la sogs pa'i mkhan po'i bya ba yang rim pas mdzad/ rgyal sprul la mtshur phu'i phyi rgya'i khur len bgyid dgos pa'i bka' stsal dang*/ khams phyogs su lho rong nang so dang zur mang sku skye la yang so sor kwan ja gu shri'i las ka dang bcas gnang*/ de skabs lha phu bar gtsang phyogs bde gzar gyi nang lhung bar brten spyan 'dren nan 'byor pa'i zhu ngo bzhin phebs nas/ bka' stsal gnang ba dang du blangs te phan tshun gnod med kyi gtan chings la 'khod/ der dga' gdong grwa tshang ba rnams phyag 'bul du 'byor ba'i gsar bu ba rnams la dge tshul gyi bslab pa dang*/ kun la bca' yig kyang gnang stai gdan sar chibs bsgyur ba'i phebs lam bra skor nas thab 'dzin tshogs 'khor dang bcas rgyal ba gong mar grub chen gling ras zhal gzigs pa'i mchil phu yang zhabs kyis bcags shing*/ yangs can du dngul gdung bzhugs yul gyi shing rtsi logs bris pa rnams la sgang ston dang*/ rnam gzhag sogs stsal te/ gdan sar phebs nas bde chen du bal po rnams la gser ston rnam gzhag dang bcas pa gnang zhing*/ gos sku khams gsum mdzes rgyan gyi bzo mgo 'dzugs pa'i sta gon gnang ste rim pas bzo bkod dang mgo lung sku rgyu rtsis sprod sogs gnang nas bla g.ye chen mor rgyab ras la ston pa'i sku brnyan skya ris kyi tshang thig gnang ba'i tshe 'ja' 'od sna lnga lha sa'i thad kyi nam mkha' dang*/
