shar gyi thub pa rang byon gnyis sprel ba'i mu la 'ja' 'od de nyid tshangs thig gi steng du zug pa'i ltas khyad par can yang byung*/ de'i tshe/ gtsang rong zhod 'jags kyi slad du gzhis ka rin spungs nas spyan 'dren nar mar 'byor ba la brten gdan bskyod de/ bde skyid gling nas sa skyong ngag dbang 'jig rten dbang phyug yab sras rnams kyis bsu ba'i bkod pa khyad par du 'phags pas spyan drangs te/ thog mar ra lngar gdan phab pa las rdo gcal gyi ngos la zhabs rjes gsal por byon pa phyis kyang pho brang chen mo'i mchod gral du bzhugs/ de nas zhal ngo rnams la ji ltar bzhed pa'i dbang chos thugs ka tshim pa gnang zhing*/ gtsang pa dang thob rgyal bar zhod 'jags dang sa 'byed sogs kyi bka' stsal gyi mi sna gnang bar so so nas spyi bos blangs pa'i dan bzhag dang*/ sku ngor sa 'byed kyang ci rigs pa phul/ de nas mi'i dbang pos gsol btab ngor/ chos skyong gi bskang sgrub rgyas pa yang gnang nas/ pho brang rin spungs nyid du'ang spyan drangs te/ gzhu'i 'brong dkar rdzong la gtogs pa rnams lha 'bangs su 'bul ba sogs 'bul ba dang bsnyen bkur bla na med pas mchod cing rgyal ba nyid nas kyang rgyal srid kyi rten 'brel la dgongs pa'i dbang lung ci rigs pa dang zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gnang*/ slar ra lngar phebs nas rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg kyang gnang ba sogs lugs gnyis kyi bka' drin bzang pos dpal mi dbang btsun mo sras bcas kun gyis thugs bzhed gang bar mdzad de/ gtsang pa nas sde pa sku mched rnams kyis mos 'dun rtse gcig pas spyan 'dren dang bstun phebs/ tre sprul dpon slob kyang phyag 'bul du byon cing*/ sde pa lha rdor ba mched bcas rnams kyis phebs bsu thab 'dzin bsu ba'i bkod chen bcas lhun rtser gdan phebs shing*/ nar ma'i zhabs tog dang bsti stang phun sum tshogs pas bteg cing*/ ji ltar gsol ba btab bzhin bde mchog gi sgo nas zhi rgyas dbang gsum dang mgon po'i sgo nas drag po'i sbyin sreg gnang zhing*/

zhal ngo rnams la 'dod chos kyi dbang bka' dang mos gus bdun ma'i zab khrid gnang*/ gser mdog can nas mkhan slob rnams dang rje btsun sprul sku dang*/ nyang stod smad nas ngang snar thang rnam gling tshun gyi skye bo phal mo che zhal mjal phyag 'bul du 'byor bas 'bul chen grangs mang bgyis shing*/ so sor chos kyi sbyin pa dang zhal mjal gsung thos kyi 'brel pas kun kyang thar pa'i 'jug ngog tu mdzad nas sga gdong grwa tshang gis spyan drangs te 'bul mchod spros pa na/ rje byams pa'i drung du snyan dar dang phyag mchod smon lam dang mgon khang du 'dzin gtor dang bcas pa'i bka' bsgo dam bzhag /dge 'dun rnams la spyi thes su brgya 'bul gsum gyis dngos spyad ji snyed pa mang ja rnam gzhag dang bcas pa gnang*/ sde pa mched rnams kyis 'gro mgon 'phags par se chen rgyal pos phul bar grags pa'i hor jus ar lhas kyi yol ba che legs kyis gtsos sna grangs spus ldan brgya 'bul mang po'i 'bul chen bgyis te der skye bo dpag med 'dus pa rnams la zhwa mthon mthing gi cod pan bzhes bzhin thugs rje chen po'i bzlas lung gi bka' 'brel gnang bar de dag kun gyis kyang yig drug dung phyur 'don pa sogs rang rang gis mkhos 'tsham gyi sdig spong dge sgrub kyi dam bca' phul te gnas skabs mthar thug gi legs spel gnang nas rim pas bla 'bring grwa tshang sogs rab byung sgrub pa'ang mang du byung*/ stod nas lo chen sprul sku dpon slob byon pas 'bul chen dang*/

de nas sde pa mched rnams la grub pa'i mtha' ris su ma chad pa'i dgon sde che phra gang la yang gnod 'tshe med cing chos mthun gyi legs cha mdzad pa dang*/ rong gtsang bar sogs 'jig rten bde thabs dgos pa'i bka' stsal dang*/ gnang cha gya nom pa bcas mdzad ltar spyi bos nod de slar yang gtsang phyogs su mi 'gyang bar chibs bskyod par gsol ba btab ste/ sde pa dkar bsod sde dgon rnams kyis spyan drangs nas phung po ri che'i gnas gzigs kyang gnang nas thob rgyal bkra shis khri brtan du phebs/ der nar ma'i zhabs tog bsnyen bkur 'bul chen rnams dang*/ khri brtan chos sde yang 'dul grwa gling dang ma bu'i tshul gyi bshad grwa bgyid par zhus shing*/ zhal ngo rnams la dbang dang 'dod chos bka' drin bstsal/ 'dul grwa gling dang brag nag pas kyang so so'i dgon gnas su spyan drangs te 'bul bsnyen dang chos 'brel mang du zhus shing*/ grwa tshang gnyis kyi spyi thes su brgya 'bul gcig gi dngos spyad ji snyed rnams gnang*/ de dag gi skabs su bod khams yongs kyi bde skyid kyi rten 'brel la dgongs nas gtsang pa mched la g.yas ru gtsang 'gram gyi lha khang sogs dang*/ byang bdag por grom pa rgyang gi lha khang gi zhig gsos bgyid dgos pa'i bka' gnang bstsal zhing*/ lhan stag par gyi dri med mchod rten zhes pa slob dpon padmas mdzad par grags pa yang zhig gsos bgyid du bstsal te phyag nas kyang gnang*/ de nas rim pas lo mjug sku rim dang me pho khyi lo'i lo sar sogs gnang nas gdan bteg /'o yug gong sngon du gsol ka spyan gzigs sogs gnang ste phebs par dgon rnying grwa tshang la sogs pas gus pas sri zhu rim bgyis bzhin/ 'brong mkhar rdzong du phebs nas dge legs rab brtan gyi ming 'dogs dang rtsis bzhes phyag nas gnang*/ der bye mkhar nas chos rje paṇa chen dang*/ snye mo ba sku mched mchod yon rnams byon nas 'bul chen dang*/

snye mo bas mnga' bdag stod smad ban grong shar nub dang gnyen grong bye rdzing rnams kyang lha 'bangs su phul zhing*/ mchod yon rnams la dbang chos bka' drin bstsal/ gzhan yang do bo ri pa dang dgon pa dkar po ba/ gzhu stod smad kyi skye bo yongs kyi mjal te gus pas 'bul spungs gtib par so sor 'dod chos kyis tshim par mdzad/ de nas gdan sa mtshur phur phebs/ kong po nas dbon gu shri 'byor ba dang*/ spo bo g.yu ri dgon gyi rta 'dul ba sogs 'byor bas rim par 'bul chen bgyis/ de'i tshe rje bla ma'i sku gdung gi mchod rten rgyu dang phra rgyan bzo bkod phun tshogs rten brten par bcas pa legs par grub pa'i rab gnas su yangs can du phebs/ gzungs gzhugs 'bul ba'i phyag bzhes bcas gnang nas/ 'du khang phan tshun du/ yang zur/ cog grwa/ mtshur yangs/ gnas nang ba sogs gzhi byes kyi dge 'dun stong sum brgya tsam gyis dpal dus kyi 'khor lo la sogs pa'i chog tshan brgyad kyi bsgrub mchod dang*/ dngul gdung rin po che'i drung du rgyal ba nyid rdo rje slob dpon du bzhugs pa'i zhabs 'breng rgyal tshab sprul sku/ dpa' bo sprul sku/ yang zur cog grwa'i dge 'dun bde mchog pa rnams kyis bgyis te nyer sdog dang*/ bco lngar dngos gzhi'i nyin snga char rje dpa' bo sprul sku bsnyen par rdzogs pa gnang zhing*/ bcu drug gi nyin sku gdung gi mchod rten dam par lha rnams kyis mchod pa'i mtshan ma mig gi bzod mtshams kyi nam mkha' la bya tshe ring zung cig bskor ba byed cing me tog gi char 'bab pa skye bo phal gyis kyang mthong ba dang*/ 'jang rgyal blon ti shri dang bcas pa rnams kyis dngul gdung rin po che'i drung du snyan dar mchod rdzas 'bul rgyu dang bcas pa'i 'bul skyel gtos che ba sogs mang du 'byor zhing*/ gzhan yang gtso bor rgyal ba nyid kyi phyag nas bstar bas thog drangs dbus gtsang*/

dwags kong*/ mdo khams sogs kyi bla ma mi chen dang thob du mas phul ba'i 'phan bla re snyan dar mchod rdzas kyi dngos spyad sogs pas lha dang mi'i 'jig rten kun gyi bsod nams kyi zhing rab tu gyur pa'i mchod rten dam pa mdzes par brgyan zhing*/ mar me'i phreng ba tshar du dngar ba sogs mchod pa nar ma'i yo byad bzang po dang*/ der 'dus kyi bla slob dpon cho ga ba bzo bo mgo lung ba dang bcas pa rnams la rnam gzhag dang chog yon gya nom pa gnang*/ de dag gi skabs su lho nas dhi tsha sku skye/ skyid shod nas stag lung dpon sa/ byang nas hor dpon karma g.yul rgyal dpon g.yog mang po rnams 'byor bas 'bul chen rim par bgyis pa la dam pa'i chos kyi bka' drin bstsal zhing*/ spo 'bor ba'i 'gron tshan dang yangs can pa sogs gzhi byes kyi sdom pa don gnyer mang por rab byung dang bsnyen rdzogs ci rigs pa gnang*/ de nas bal po mgo lung pa dang bcas yon rdzongs kyi dngos po bzang dgus mgu zhing rangs par mdzad nas/ gdan sa mtshur phu nyid du phebs nas/ lo gcig gi bar/ phal cher thugs dam gyi lha du ma nye bar bsnyen cing sgrub pa'i sku mtshams la bzhugs shing*/ skabs skabs su phyogs tha dad pa nas rgyal ba nyid kyi zhal dkyil mjal ba dang*/ gsung gi bdud rtsi don du gnyer ba rnams mos pa bskang ba yang mdzad/ lho nas bla ma dhi sprul la bsnyen rdzogs dang*/ phyag chen chos drug sogs bka' chos bstsal zhing*/ lho mon gyi dgon rnams kyi kwan ja dang*/ ras chung phug nas rje rgod tshang ba'i sku skye/ ri che'i padma rgyal po'i sku skye sogs la yang bsnyen rdzogs dang khrid lung mang du bstsal/ bya yul nas dpon sa chos rgyal gling pa/ bla ma kham smyon pa sogs dang*/ spo bo'i 'bul skyel/ 'jang rgyal blon/ bla khag rnams kyi 'bul skyel 'gron tshan snga phyir 'byor pa rnams la'ang rab byung bsnyen rdzogs ci rigs dang*/

mos 'dun so sor chos lung zab rgyas kyi bka' drin bstsal zhing*/ 'bri khung khang thog gi bar sogs dbu ru/ skyi shod/ stod klung*/ smyug la'i khog la sogs par nye 'khor phan tshun mi mthun pa'i zir bun byung ba rnams la'ang so sor zhi 'jags kyi bka' stsal mi sna dang bcas pa gnang bas bde 'jam du mdzad/ gzhan yang legs gling gi 'du khang gzabs bcos kyi cha rkyen gnang cha dang*/ yangs can du rje bla ma'i sku tshab 'dra sku lnga bcu grwa tshang ba rnams kyis do dam khur blangs nas bzhengs pa'i sku 'dra'i gser dang yon rdzongs dang bcas pa'ang bstsal/ dbyar ngo 'bras spungs mchod rten gyi steng thog la logs bris mdzad par phyag nas dang*/ slar gos sku chen mo yang legs par grub pa la gzigs rtog phyag nas gnang shing*/ rim pas lo mjug sku rim dang*/ lcags mo phag lo'i lo sar gnang nas cho 'phrul dus chen gyi tshes gcig nas bco lnga'i bar nyin re bzhin jo bo rin po che'i drung du mdo sde mdzangs blun las byung ba'i cho 'phrul gyi mdzad pa la bstod pa'i tshigs bcad re dang bcas pa'i snyan dar bkra shis kha thags re dang*/ dkar me rgyun 'bar 'bul ba gnang zhing*/ rten gsum gzhan gang du'ang snyan dar sogs mchod 'bul gzabs rgyas gnang*/ de skabs rnams su yang shun zhabs drung dang 'jang rgyal blon gyi 'bul skyel spo 'bor gyi grwa rgyun sogs rab byung bsnyen rdzogs sgrub pa yang mang du byung*/ 'bri khung khang thog gi bar legs spel gyi skor byang gnang ba gnyis thad nas dang du bzhes pa'i gung dpang du spyan 'dren snga phyir nan 'byor gyi zhu ngor/ zla ba gsum pa'i tshes bcu bdun la gdan btegs/ yangs can du dngul gdung rin po cher phyag 'bul dang sku tshab sku 'dra rin po che la rab gnas mdzad de/ rim pas snying drung nas 'dam brgyud ra sgreng rgyal ba'i gnas chen du phebs te/ rten gsum rnams kyi drung du mchod 'bul/

brgya phyag /smon lam sogs rgyas par gnang zhing*/ tshogs pa kun la'ang mang ja rnam gzhag spyi 'gyed dang bcas pa gnang nas rim par phebs pa'i lam bar du stag lung pa'i sde pa mi sde dang mkhar thog tu dpon sa chos mdzad mas 'bul zhabs rgya cher bsgrubs shing*/ chos rje rin po che dang*/ stag lung spyi so'i ja 'dren dang*/ bla ma ka drug pa dang sku rdzi ban dpon sogs grwa mang phal cher mjal bar sleb/ gzhan yang hor pa dang khrab kha sogs klung shod nang gi sde dgon kun gyis mjal zhing 'bul zhabs bgyis pa rnams so sor chos dang zang zing gis mos blo gang bar mdzad nas/ chos rje rin po che chos rgyal phun tshogs thel gyi khrir bzhugs pas chibs bsu thab 'dzin sogs bsu ba'i bkod pa mtha' yas pas spyan drangs te mal gro bkra shis tshal du gdan phebs/ phag mo nas dpon rin po che sras yum zhal ngo rnams kyang phyag 'bul du phebs shing*/ thog ma'i gsol phog phul ba sogs khang thog gnyis ga nas nar ma'i zhabs tog dang gzhi len bsnyen bkur 'bul chen rim par mdzad nas zhal ngo so sos 'dod chos kyi bka' dbang khrid lung mang du gsan zhing*/ phag mo nas dpon rin po che'i gtsug phud kyang bzhes/ rim pas khang thog nang 'jags kyi bka' gros skor byang dang*/ khra gzhi gnang ba rnams kyang don du 'khyol bas yan phyin 'khon med kyis rgyal ba'i drung du mjal 'dzoms la sogs pa'i legs tshogs kyang rim par mdzad/ de dag gi skabs su mnga' ri'i lha btsun dang byang bdag po bkra shis stobs rgyas pa sogs kyang gus mjal du byon/ lho stod nas sde pa gtsug rab pa sogs dang*/ tshogs chos lung pa'i mkhan chen e waṃ dgon la sogs pa'i bla mar bzhugs pas 'bul chen dang*/ gzhan yang dbu ru stod smad kyi sde dgon ser skya mtha' dag nas rang rang gi gus 'byor gyi 'bul zhabs dang phyag 'tshal skor ba la sogs pa dge rtsa bskrun par zhal mjal gsung thos kyi 'brel pa gang la gang 'tsham kyis byang chub kyi lam du dkri bar mdzad cing*/

thel pa dang ka tshal pa'i mtshams pa gzhi byes sogs dang gdan sa bar pa'i grwa rigs sogs rab byung bsnyen rdzogs sgrub pa mang du byung*/ skabs shig klu'i rgyal po ma dros gzi can skyes bu'i gzugs kyis sgar la phyag dang skor ba byed pa mthong snang can 'gar shar ba la brten nas dbyar ngo dar char zhod shin tu che zhing nye 'khor gy-i chu bo kun kyang cher rgyas pas rgyang ma nas bzhugs sgar chu'i dbus na yod pa 'dra bar snang zer ba kun klu'i mchod pa'i mtshan mar kha cig gleng*/ yar rgyab nas dbon sa yum sras nas spyan 'dren pa ched gnyer du mngags pa dang*/ sde pa lho stod pa dang*/ gtsang pa nas spyan snga kun spangs pa zhabs phyir 'god bzhin pas so sor spyan 'dren gyi zhu ba phul zhing*/ zho kha nags phu pa rnams kyi spyan 'dren kyang snga phyir 'byor ba las/ re zhig zho nag phyogs su phebs rgyur gnang nas/ khang thog zhal ngo rnams kyi chibs skyel dang bcas phebs/ spro lung du chos rje rin po ches bsnyen bkur dang 'bul nod rgya cher mdzad cing thel du yang thel pa rnams kyis 'bul zhabs dpag med bgyis par tshogs pa kun la thugs rje chen po'i sgom lung gi bka' 'brel dang rten gsum la mjal mchod/ dge 'dun la mang 'gyed sogs bstsal zhing*/ rim pas mtsho brang du phebs/ der hor smad pa'i dpon khag gnyis dang chos rje ka drug pa mchod yon rnams kyi zhabs tog dang*/ 'bul tshan mang du bstar zhing*/ skya ser du ma la bsnyen gnas dang*/ sems bskyed la sogs pa'i chos kyi bka' drin gyis khyab par mdzad/ de skabs kong po ja pa yar yong dang 'grig pas hor kong bar gyi zlos sel gtan 'chams kyi bka' khra yang gnang*/ de nas spyi mda'i tshal du phebs pa na mgu log byams mgon gyi bu spun la sogs pa kham kong gi ja pa mang pos 'bul chen bgyis shing*/ nags phu nang so sogs mang po'i ja 'dren kyang rim par 'byor/

mdo thang ri che'i sku skye rin po ches phyag 'bul zhus nas khams phyogs su thegs/ brag dkar lha chu'i gnas gzigs su phebs nas/ slar mdo thang nas rim pas chos khri thang du phebs/ 'phrul khang nang so sogs pas 'bul zhabs dang*/ nags phu ri pa lcags mkhar nang so dang bcas pa'i spyan 'dren ja zhus dang mdo khams stod smad kyi 'bul skyel yang mang du 'byor/ bar skabs brag dkar lha chur sku mtshams zhag bdun pa zhig la phebs pa las/ ri kha sang sing gi dgon khag so so nas 'bul chen bgyis par phyag chen lnga ldan gyi bka' 'grel rgyas par gnang ba sogs yul phyogs de'i 'gro ba du ma smin grol gyi phrin las mdzad de/ long po dpon gyis spyan 'dren bskyar nan ngor/ nga phod tshal du phebs te nar ma'i zhabs bsnyen bgyid skabs 'khrul khang nas kong po'i ja pa rnams 'byor bas tshong dpon rdo phrug bu sogs pas ja spob tse brgya dang bdun gyis thog drangs sna grangs lnga brgya'i 'bul chen bgyis/ slar nga phod nyid du phebs nas dge 'dun zur ri ba dang cog grwa pa gnyis khams su bsod snyoms la 'degs pa'i rdzong bkod gnang zhing*/ bar lam stod nas bla ma gcod pa 'bul skyel du 'byor bas dngul srang chen stong phrag bzhi dang drug brgya la sogs pa'i 'bul chen dang long po dpon mi ngo rnams kyis bsnyen bkur dang 'bul ba yang rim pas bgyis pa sogs nyang long sde drug gi skye bo kun la mthong thos don ldan gyi phrin las bzang pos legs khyab mdzad nas/ nags phu dpal gyi ri khrod du phebs nas nags phu ri pa nang so dang bcas pas mchod dang bsnyen bkur ba rim par bgyis shing ri pa'i bla gnyer bsko bzhag dang*/ lha khang dang 'bum pa gso ba'i cha rkyen sogs kyi dgon thes kyang gnang*/ gzhan yang lhun gling pa sogs snye bo'i dgon gnas gsum dad pa'i sbyin bdag dang bcas pa kun gyis 'bul chen rim pas bgyis pa la sogs pa kun la chos dang zang zing gis ngom par mdzad de/

nags mda' nas spang du phebs par/ yul phyogs de dag gi sde dgon rnams dang*/ ri dgon pa rnams kyang 'byor bas 'bul chen grangs mang dang*/ rab byung bsnyen rdzogs kyi bka' drin zhus/ gzim gur 'khris kyi pha wang gi ngos la ston pa sangs rgyas kyi sku brnyan phyag bris gnang ba bzhin yul mi rnams kyis bskos pas pha wang gi ngos nas srog chags grog ma'i rnam pa mang po dang*/ sbrang rtsi'i gong bu 'dra ba yang thon te de dag sdug bsngal de las gdon pa'i slad du sku phyag bris gnang par 'dug ces gleng shing pha wang gi steng na zhabs rjes kyang byon 'dug zer/ de nas lkog 'phrang dgon du phebs par dga' ldan ma mo'i sde dgon rnams kyi ja zhus kyang 'byor/ zho khar phebs thog rtse sgang pa dpon slob dang*/ 'jang rgyal blon gyi 'bul skyel rnams 'byor/ zho kha sde dgon dang bcas kun gyis 'bul chen rim par bgyis/ grwa rgyun rnams dang sle lung grwa tshang ba sogs gzhi byes kyi dge 'dun mang por rab byung dang bsnyen rdzogs ci rigs pa bstsal/ sgam po spyan snga zhi bar gshegs pa'i mchod bsngo'i rten 'bul mi sogs sleb/ der lo mjug sku rim dang sa pho byi ba'i lo sar cho 'phrul gyi dus chen bco lnga'i nyin gso sbyong dang bcas pa gnang nas mtsho chu ba sde dgon rnams kyis spyan drangs te so sos 'bul dpangs bstod/ dgu gtor gyi nyin 'brug grags pa sogs ltas bzang po dang*/ gnam gang la mdo chen dgon du phebs par zhabs rjes byon/ yul phyogs de dag gi ri rgya klung rgya sogs sdig spong dge sgrub kyi phrin las rnam par dkar bas khyab bar mdzad nas/ mtsho chu'i dog gzigs sogs kyang gnang*/ slar zho kha nyid du phebs nas/ nang so bsko bzhag dang chos sde'i bca' ba chos khrims 'thus btsun sogs kyi bka' khyab rim gnang skabs rtse sgang nas si tu sprul sku chos kyi rgyal mtshan pa phebs pas/
rab byung dge tshul gyi bslab pa bzhes nas zhabs phyir bsnyen pas dbang khrid gdams pa mang du gsan zhing 'bul chen tshan mang mdzad/

gzhan yang zu ru gdong lkog 'phrang yan gyi dge 'dun grwa tshang rnams dang yon bdag dang bcas pas 'bul chen rim par bgyis shing*/ dge 'dun gsar bu ba rnams la rab byung bsnyen rdzogs kyi bka' drin dang*/ so sor 'dod chos dang mkho dgu'i dngos pos 'phral yun kun tu dge sar mdzad nas/ nye 'khor gyi mkhon dang zlos pa kun kyang zhi bar mdzad cing*/ rgyal tshab sprul sku dbus phyogs su snga 'gros la rdzongs gnang*/ si tu sku skye rin po che gdan sa karma'i khrir kwan ting gu shri'i las ka dang bcas pa'i bsko bzhag dang*/ rgya'i mi dbon lis tsin si dang ni kan tshen gnyis dang rgya hang cu'u si rnams kyi rta 'bul zhing gi mi chen gyi gnyer pa dbang phyug brgyud nas byung ba'i zhu lan dang bcas khams phyogs su rdzong bkod gnang zhing*/ rim gro pa kha dkar dbon nad tshabs che bas mnar ba'ang thugs rje'i 'jug pas 'tsho bar gyur nas/ rje bla ma'i sprul sku'i don du slar dbus gtsang phyogs nyid la chibs bsgyur ba'i dgongs pas gdan bteg ste/ gnam tshal du phebs par kun gyis 'bul chen bgyis pa'i nas sogs de ka'i sgrub mchod kyi thes su gnang*/ rim pas snga sor gyi phebs lam bzhin/ nga phod sogs brgyud phebs par lam bar gyi sde dgon ji snyed pa kun gyis slar yang 'bul zhabs cher bsgrubs shing*/ so sor chos dang longs spyod kyis 'phral yun du dge ba'i bka' khyab mdzad nas/ lha mda' phyug po gzhung du phebs pa na chos rje spro lung ba thel pa spyi so dang bcas pa'i ja 'dren 'byor/ de nas 'tshol kha'i ljongs su 'bri khung thel pa'i mkhan slob grwa mang dang bcas pa'i phebs bsu ser sbreng dang*/ ja ril gzhung du chos rje rin po che yang chibs bsu thab 'dzin du phebs pa dang bcas gzho stong grog snar gdan phebs thog phag mo nas dbon sras yum gyi zhu 'phrin dang ja zhus pa 'byor/

rje bla ma mchog gi sprul pa'i sku rtsod pa dang bral ba 'bri khung skyu ra'i gdung rigs dri ma med par bltams pa la dpal gar dbang chos kyi dbang phyug mtshan gsol/ ngos 'dzin dang*/ de nyid kyi brtan bzhugs/ rgyal ba kun dngos dpal ldan bla ma mchog/ /zhes sogs dang bcas snyan par sgrogs pa'i mi sna bka' shog dbus gtsang kun tu gnang zhing*/ chos rje rin po cher yang gnang cha gya nom pa dang*/ yin lugs 'gab yul sogs kyi bka' stsal zhib rgyas rim par gnang ste/ de nas dbon gu shri karma bstan 'dzin dang nang so karma mchod sprin pa sogs kyis gtsos pa'i drung 'khor rnams kyis chibs bsu thab 'dzin dang*/ chos sde rnams kyi ser sbreng rgyas pa sogs bsu bkod mtha' yas pas rje bla ma mchog gi sprul pa'i sku bzhugs sgar du spyan drangs nas yab sras mjal 'dzom gnang bar mchog gi sprul pa'i sku rin po che nas mjal dar phyag 'bul sogs gzhan gyis bskul ba la rag ma las pa'i gus 'dud dang*/ rgyal ba nyid nas kyang bzhugs khri'i steng nas bzhengs te byin rlabs dbu thug gnang ba la sogs pa'i bkur sti cher mdzad de gdan 'dzom pa'i bkra shis dga' ston dang*/ sgar chos sde kun gyis mchog sprul rin po cher mjal dar phyag 'bul bgyis/ de skabs su 'bri khung thel ba sogs kyi rab byung bsnyen rdzogs zhu ba mang po dang*/ gzhan yang chos don gnyer gyi skye bo mang du 'dus par dbang lung gdams ngag ci rigs pa'i chos sbyin dang*/ thel pa rnams la nor phyugs la sogs pas gtsos pa'i spyi 'gyed rnam gzhag /skabs der bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i dge slong nyis brgya lhag tsam la sogs pa'i dge slong gi dge 'dun rnams la gso sbyong gi ja thes dang bcas pa gnang zhing*/ snyur gtsang sogs dbus gtsang gi sde ris phal gyi spyan 'dren pa dang*/ sog po a dpal dang bing thu'i 'bul skyel gser yig pa'ang 'byor/

de nas rje sprul pa'i sku rin po che chos rje zhal ngo rnams dang lhan cig gzhis ka rtse bar phebs shing*/ sgar chen yang rim pas bteg ste rtse pa'i klu sdings su zhal rgyas thog nas yab sras lhan rgyas yangs can phyogs su phebs pa'i rten 'brel legs tshogs kyi chibs rags gzab rgyas kyis klung shod bkra shis thang du phebs nas/ nang so mchod sprin pa sogs sngon gyi drung 'khor der yod rnams sprul sku'i phyags phyir so so'i las tshan du bsko bzhag gnang ste bzhugs sgar bsgrig pa gnang zhing*/ de'i dga' ston du chos rje rin po ches sgar chos sde dang bcas pa kun la bsnyen bkur gzabs rgyas zhu ba mdzad/ chibs rags nyung bsdus kyis sngon mi bskyod rje yun ring bzhugs gnas khrab kha'i yang dgon dang phyir lam dgon ma mor yang phebs te de dag gi gnas rten rnams mjal ba dang*/ dge 'dun rnams la dam pa'i chos kyi bka' drin gyis khyab par mdzad de/ kun gyis kyang 'bul mchod dpag med spros shing*/ slar bzhugs sgar du phebs nas/ thel tu mkhan po bsko bzhag gnang*/ phag mor yang gsol btab bzhin phebs par 'bul bsnyen cher zhus shing dbang chos kyi bka' drin kyang bstsal/ 'ol snar chos sde spyi pa dang 'bri khung rin po ches 'bul chen mdzad de dbu zhwa bsgron/ de nas yab sras lhan rgyas kyis bkra shis thang nas bteg pa'i phebs lam ra 'dzab kyi rje btsun byams pa mjal zhing phyag mchod smon lam mdzad nas stag lung chos mdzad mas mkhar thog tu spyan drangs te bsnyen bkur/ der sa mo glang lo'i lo sar gnang nas phod mdor sde pa mi sde'i 'bul ba dang stag lung gi mkhan slob grwa mang dang bcas pas mjal mchod dang*/ chos rje'i ja 'dren kyang phul/ snyan thog tu rje btsun sgrol ma'i sku brnyan byin can la mjal phyag bcas mdzad nas snying drung brgyud bkra shis mthong smon du bzhi sde'i ja 'dren dang*/

skyid de sbug tu dbon kar bstan pas gtsos zhal ngo dpon g.yog yangs can gyi mkhan po che bgres dang bcas pa'i phebs bsu thab 'dzin dang*/ grwa mang gi ser sbreng gzabs rgyas sogs kyi bsu bkod chen po dang bcas zla ba dang po'i tshes bcu la yangs can du gdan phebs thog dbus gtsang gi sde rigs phal gyi lo sar 'bul mi yang 'byor ba'i rten 'brel legs tshogs su gyur zhing*/ dngul gdung rin po che'i drung du phyag mchod gnang nas tshes bcu gnyis kyi nyin yab sras 'du khang du phebs par yangs can pa kun gyis mjal dar phyag 'bul zhus/ hor stod pa'i dpon mi ngo sde mang dang bcas pas kyang rim pas mjal te 'bul chen bgyis/ sog zas nas 'brong bu gu shri dang 'jang sogs pa'i 'bul skyel mang du 'byor bas 'bul chen rim par bgyis/ zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes gcig gi nyin rje sprul pa'i sku rin po che sngon gyi seng ge'i khrir mnga' gsol ba'i slad du 'du khang gsar ma'i bzhugs khrir bzhugs stan sku 'khor las tshan rgyas shoms kyis bzhugs shing rgyal ba nyid rgya mthong khar dbu gdugs khri'u dang bcas pas bzhugs pa'i phyag nas mchod g.yog dge slong dag phyag brgyud kyis bkra shis pa'i rdzas rnams 'bul ba'i shis brjod sku gsung thugs rten gyis gtsos na bza' la sogs pa'i nyer spyad/ ja/ gos/ dar/ chibs/ mdzo/ drel sogs sna grangs dngos gtsang grangs mang dang bcas pa phul zhing*/ sgar phyi nang chos sde kun gyis khri phebs kyi 'bul nod bgyis te zhwa dmar gyi cod pan gsol ba dang*/ de nyid kyi nyin bka' chos thogs ma rtsa gsum dril sgrub dang*/ grub rgyal ma'i tshe dbang yang 'bul ba gnang*/ yangs can pa'i mkhan po grwa mang sde pa zhal ngo dang bcas pas so so nas rje sprul pa'i sku khrir phebs kyi legs ja'i 'bul chen bgyis te yab sras gnyis char gyis dbu zhwa bzhes shing*/ sde pas dga' ston gyi mchod sprin rgya mtshos mngon par mchod de/

de nas rim pas 'du khang gsar mar rje bla ma mchog gi thugs dam rten mchod rnams rtsis 'bul dang sbrags pa'i rten shoms rgyas par gnang ba'i drung du zla ba de nyid kyi tshes bcu'i nyin rje sprul pa'i sku rin po che'i dbu skra gtsug phud bzhes nas yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa bstsal ba sogs rgyal ba'i bstan pa spyi dang bye brag la phan bde 'phel rgyas kyi sgo 'phar rgya chen po dbye bar mdzad de/ gdan sa chen po mtshur phur chibs bsgyur lam zhor du mkha' lung ri khrod kyang zhabs kyis bcags shing*/ bsu ba'i bkod chen dang bcas pas bde chen tshal sbro sgal po rnams su rim par phebs pa la 'bul bsnyen gyis bla nas blar btegs skabs/ rje dpa' bo sprul spu sogs phebs pas mchog sprul bzhugs sgar du phebs pa'i legs ja'i 'bul chen mdzad/ shun zhabs drung dpon g.yog kyang 'byor/ mtshur gnas/ shun pa/ chos gzhis pa dang bcas rnams kyi zlos rtsod zhi bar mdzad/ mchog sprul la rje gong ma'i bka' 'bum la sogs pa'i ljags lung kyang rgyun ma chad pa gnang*/ gnas nang dang*/ gdan sa mtshur phur phebs/ de dag gnas bsu bkod dang dga' ston gyis bsnyen bkur bcas gdan chags/ bla ma tre ho sprul sku dpon slob kyis sprul sku khrir phebs kyi dga' ston 'bul chen dang*/ mon pa bla ma chos dbang pa brgyud nas rgya gar shar phyogs kyi rgyal po ma ṇi ka rā dza'i zhu phrin 'bul chas dang bcas bsleb/ de nas dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i sgrub mchod zhag sprel mdzad nas/ bla g.ye chen mor gos sku khams su ma mdzes rgyan gyi rab gnas gnang ba na/ nam mkha' 'ja' 'od kyis gang ba dang me tog gi char bab pa sogs pa'i ltas bzang po yang byung*/ sbyin sreg dang dga' ston bkra shis bcas gnang*/ de nas mchog sprul rin po che dang dpa' bo sprul sku sogs la dus 'khor gyi bka' dbang dang 'bras spungs mchod rten thog gi logs bris la rab gnas kyang mdzad/

yar rgyab dpon chen pas spyan 'dren zhu nan ngor/ bzang smyug sogs brgyud nas lam bar so so nas sde dpon dang*/ dgon gnas che chung rnams so sor spyan drangs te 'bul ba dang bsnyen bkur rim bzhin grwa pa gsar bu rnams la rab byung dang bsnyen rdzogs kyi bka' drin dang*/ gzhan yang chos 'brel ci rigs pa gnang bzhin/ gong dkar nas zhabs drungs khu dbon gyis las tshan rgyas pa'i chibs bsu thab 'dzin dang*/ skyes bu rkyal gyi sgyu rtsal la byang ba mang pos mgo la dar gyi cod pan bcings shing lag tu rol mo'i bye brag thogs pa 'khrol bzhin/ gtsang po'i nang nas chu rtsed kyi gzigs mo yang phul/ pho brang du spyan drangs te 'bul ba dang bsnyen bkur rgya ched dpangs mtho mdzad cing phyag chen lnga ldan dang bla ma'i rnal 'byor la sogs pa'i bka' chos gsan/ gzhung du phebs/ jo bo'i gzim phug dang rje rngog pa yab sras kyi dgon gnas ri bo'i gnas mjal kyang gnang zhing*/ brag chen thang nas yar rgyas pa'i chibs bsu thab 'dzin sogs bsu bkod rgyas pa dang bcas pas sgo mang thang du gdan phebs/ sa skyong ba'i yum gyi dgongs rdzogs su dmigs pa'i nar ma'i zhabs tog bzang po dang bsnyen bkur 'bul chen bla lhag pas mchod cing bzhugs sgar du dbyar gyi sku tshad skyob phyir gzim khang yang bgyis/ dbon nam bzang sogs mang pos 'bul bsnyen dang*/ dge 'dun 'phags sde ba rnams kyis chos rdzong du spyad drangs nas rten mjal mchod rdzas spyan 'bebs 'bul mchod dang*/ tshogs dge 'dun sgang mkhan chen dpon slob rnams dang*/ gzhan yang dol phu mda' 'brog phyi nang gi skye bo kun dang*/ tshal min pa sogs dgon che phra kun dang*/ gtsang nas tre sprul sogs dang*/ khams nas mtshungs sprul sogs bla 'go mang pos gtsos phyogs phyogs nas dad ldan gyi ser skya dpag med pa 'dus pa la sogs pas nyin re bzhin 'bul chen dang*/

de rnams dang*/ gnyug mar gnas pa dge 'dun sngags grwa ba dang 'phags sde ba sogs pa bcas la so so'i dbang skal dang 'tsham pa'i dbang bka' khrid lung gi rim pa du ma stsal zhing*/ sde pa zhal ngo rnams la'ang 'dod chos dbang bka' ci rigs pa gnang zhing*/ mchog sprul rin po cher rang byung bka' 'bum dang phyag chen rgya gzhung*/ mi bskyod rje'i bka' 'bum las sku gsum ngo sprod dang dkyil chog skor gyi lung phul ba la sogs pa bstan 'gro'i don rlabs rgya cher spel bar mdzad de/ gdan bteg lam grwa thang ba dang byams gling pa kun gyis bsu bkod ser sbreng dang 'bul zhabs cher bsgrubs shing mchod rten chen mo'i gnas mjal kyang zhib tu gnang*/ thar gling du spyan drangs te kar bstan pas gtsug lag khang rten brten bcas bzhengs pa spyan lam du bstar bar dgyes pa'i thugs kyis phyag nas dang zhib gzigs gnang*/ khong rnams kyis 'bul zhabs cher bgyis/ tshong 'dus rgyal pos lcogs gsar bcos la yang phyag nas zhus shing*/ phebs lam bo dong chos 'khor bas zhabs tog dang bcas rim pas khra 'brug gi rten mjal mchod rnams mdzad cing*/ lam bar gang du chos sde mi sde kun gyis bsnyen bkur dang bsu ba'i bkod pa rnams rim brgyud kyis khroms gzim khang du gdan phebs/ dga' tshal dpon slob dang*/ lhun sgang du spyan drangs nas sde pas gzhi len gyi dkar dro dang 'bul mchod nar mar bgyis shing*/rim bzhin mi nag ja kwa dang 'jus nang so brgyud pa'i 'jang gi 'bul skyel sogs 'gron tshan mang du 'byor/ dpon sa nor 'dzin mas spyan drangs nas bsnyen bkur 'bul chen dang*/ de bzhin gri guu bas dang*/ byang chub sdings pa dang*/ dpal 'byor rab brtan pa dang*/ g.yam bzang pa sogs so sos spyan drangs nas 'bul mchod cher bsgrubs/ phyir phebs nas lo mjug sku rim dang lcags pho stag lo'i lo sar gnang zhing*/ sde pas nar ma'i zhabs tog mdzad de lhun sgang tshoms chen du gzhi byes kyi dge 'dun tshogs che bas cho 'phrul dus chen gyi smon lam tshugs/

dwags por sa skyong g.yul rgyal ba gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs kyi ser 'du'i gral dbur lhun sgang du spyan drangs nas smon lam rten rgya cher phul zhing tshogs bsngo gnang*/ bla ma lha bro ba dang*/ dung la ba sogs dgon che phra'i bla slob dpon dang*/ spel dmar shar nub sogs dpon rigs kun gyis kyang 'bul zhabs bgyis shing*/ ser skya'i tshogs spyir rim bzhin chos 'brel dang*/ sde pa zhal ngo rnams la 'dod chos kyi dbang khrid dang*/ rje mchog sprul dam pas gtso mdzad pa rnams la/ drung don ldan zhabs kyi bka' 'bum gyi ljags lung la sogs bka' chos smar ba byung*/ dbu ma 'jug pa'i 'grel pa thugs rtsom grub pa'i zhus dag kyang gnang*/ mi dbang stobs rgyas pa mched kyis 'phyong rgyas su chibs bsu thabs 'dzin dgon che phra kun gyi ser sbreng sogs bsu bkod rgyas pas spyan drangs nas/ nar ma'i zhabs tog rgya chen dang*/ ltag rtse tshoms chen du spyi sger nas dkar dro dang 'bul chen rim par bgyis/ tshes bcu'i nyin rtse lugs kyi tshes bcu rgyas pa'i 'chams kyi gzigs 'bul dang*/ bcu gcig la sde pa gzhung gi 'bul chen dung dkar g.yas 'khyil gyis thog drangs pa'i rgya che dpangs mtho mdzad cing*/ lcam chos mdzad mas kyang bsnyen bkur dang 'bul ba bgyis/ bde skyid gling du sde pa bgres pa'i sger gyi 'bul zhabs kyang mdzad pa de dag gi tshe sde pa zhal ngo sogs la 'dod chos kyi bka' dbang sogs mang du gnang nas sde pa phan tshun gyi phebs skyel phebs bsu dang bcas slar khrom sar phebs pa na/ lhun sgang du sa skyong srong btsan pas bcom ldan rin 'byung gi sku brnyan li ma khyad can gyis gtsos pa'i sna grangs dngos gtsang grangs mang gi 'bul chen mdzad/ lto rgyud nas sde pa 'bog mdong so so dang*/ sde pa gtsang pa mched gyi spyan 'dren pa rnams kyang lhags shing*/ gtsang pa mched kyi mos blo bskang par rgyal tshab sprul sku gnang nas/

khrom sa nas lho kong ngos su gdan bteg /chos rdzongs sogs brgyud skyil skyes pa dang sgo pa rnams nas 'bul zhabs dang*/ sku rab sde pas chibs bsu thab 'dzin dang*/ rtse le ba dpon slob kyis kyang 'bul bsnyen rgya cher zhus te skuu rab bkra shis sgang du phebs pa na/ sgam po chos rje ja 'dren du byon/ sa skyong g.yul rgyal ba'i dgongs rdzogs dwags por sgrub dgos kyi ser 'du'i grar dbur spyan drangs te gzhi byes kyi chos sde sgar mang dang bcas pa kun la bsnyen bkur gzabs rgyas kyi thog gser srang grangs mang gis gtsos pa'i bsngo rten rgya che dpangs mtho phul bar bsngo smon gyi rgyas 'debs gnang*/ yang dgon du slob dpon mkhas dbang rnam grags pa bzhugs pas gser zho brgya phrag lhag pas gtsos pa'i 'bul chen mdzad cing*/ de nyid kyi drung nas tshe dbang dang sgrol dkar gyi rjes gnang sogs gsan/ sgam po'i ri mjal kyang gnang*/

de nas la thog zur mkhar ba dang*/ grum lung dpon tshang*/ lding tsho dgon gsar pa dang bcas pa kun gyis 'bul zhabs rim pas bsgrubs/ sde pas kyang gnas gzhir 'bul chen mdzad/ de skabs rgyal nas 'bras spungs chos rje'i dgongs rdzogs mchod bsngo'i rten 'bul mi yang 'byor zhing*/ 'bri khung nas zhal ngo rnams kyis rje mchog sprul skor tsam phebs dgos pa'i zhu nan bzhin 'khor zhag gi tshul du dpon slob rnams gdan bteg /rgyal ba nyid gdan chags nas rin po che rnam grags pa'i drung du mgon po gur zhal gyi rjes gnang dang shangs chos kyi dbang lung phal che ba gsan zhing*/ sku rab dgon sar ba sogs gzhi byes kyi dge 'dun tshogs cher sman bla'i mdo chog dang*/ mi bskyod rjes mdzad pa'i blo sbyong chen mo la sogs pa'i lung khrid mang du bstsal/ sde pas sku rab gnas gzhir sgar gyi chos sde rnams la sgrub mchod zhag sbrel du btsugs pa'i tshogs dbur phebs shing phyags bskor dang shis brjod bcas gnang*/ rje mchog sprul dpon slob thel du phebs pa dang dus bsgrigs kyi gdan sa'i khrir phebs legs ja'i gnang skyes mi sna bcas gnang zhing*/ zla gcig tsam sku mtshams la bzhugs te sgrol dkar gyi ljags bsnyen kha skong gi sbyin sreg dang bcas pa gnang*/ sku mtshams grol nas tsā ri'i gnas gzigs su phyags bteg / gong lar rtse le ba dang sde pa'i thab skyel tshogs 'khor dang*/ de nas chos zam pa dang glo bo grong pa kun gyi yang 'bul zhabs dang bcas thog mar mtsho dkar du phebs par rdor 'dzin gyis gtsos pa'i ri pa rnams kyis bsu ba dang tshogs 'khor 'bul ba bgyis shing de'i gnas mjal rnams zhib tu gnang ste/ mtsho ngogs su sde pas tshogs 'khor zhus skabs nam mkhar 'ja' 'od bkra shis rtags brgyad kyi gzugs su snang ba phal gyis mthong ba byung zer/ de nas rje mi bskyod zhabs kyis bstsal ba'i lam yig dang bstun te phyag chen dpal 'bar dang tsā ri rnam rgyal zhes pa gnyis gnas gsar mar snga 'gros kyis bka' bsgo'i tshogs gtor 'bul bar gnang zhing*/

de rjes rgyal ba nyid phebs nas rgyal po ind+ra bhū ti la sogs pa'i sgrub gnas dang*/ yi dam chos skyong gi bla mtsho sku brnyan rang byon sogs drung gong ma'i gnas yig bzhin du phyag chen pa gnyis sogs la mtshan don brda sprod mdzad/ mtsho dkar du phebs nas rje bla ma'i dus mchod nyer gsum mchod pa gnang ste nyer lnga la ma chen gyi gnas gzigs su phebs te klo bo'i la nas lha mo sgang dang dmar nag rakta brgyud g.yu mtsho khar phebs pa na der tshogs pa kun la bla ma'i rnal 'byor phyag chen gyi dmigs rim mdor bsdus dang bcas pa'i bka' chos gnang*/ tshes gcig la der bzhugs nas rim gyi ka la dung mtsho nas lam 'phrang rkang 'gros kyis kyang thar dka' ba kun la'ang chibs g.yag ma gzhol bar phebs pa rdzu 'phrul gyis bgros pa lta bus yul smad du phebs pa na rdor 'dzin las tshan dang bcas pa kun gyis bsu ba ser sbreng 'bul zhabs yang dag pa bgyis shing*/ mkha' 'gro 'bum del du khong rnams la phag mo'i cho ga'i ljags lung la sogs pa'i bka' chos dang*/ gcig car ba dang bcas pa kun la mang ja/ ja 'gyed/ sa 'phan la sogs pa'i gnang cha rgya cher bstsal/ yul stod nas ri ba la dang chos zam brgyud gong la'i nang logs su sde pa'i thab bsu dang*/ rnam rgyal nas gzhi byes kyi dge 'dun rnams kyi ser sbreng la sogs pa'i bsu ba'i bkod pa dang bcas bkra shis sgang du phebs pa na/ sgom grwa pa khams phyogs su bsod snyoms la phyin pa 'khor ba dang stabs gcig spungs ri nang so dang zur mang blo gros pa'i sku skye sogs bla 'go dang grwa rigs mang du 'byor bas sgom grwa'i tshogs gur du zhal mjal phyag 'bul zhus shing*/ sgom grwa pa dang gzhan 'bul skyel ba rnams kyis rim pas 'bul chen bgyis/ rje mchog sprul drung nas mi sna 'byor/ spungs ri nang so dang zur mang sku skye sogs khams bod kyi bslab pa don gnyer nyis brgya lhag tsam la rab byung bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa'i bka' drin dang*/

gzhi byes kyi dge 'dun tshogs cher dwags po bka' 'bum gyi ljags lung la sogs pa'i bka' chos gnang zhing*/ sku rab tu sde pa g.yul rgyal bas gsar bzhengs kyi lha chen la rab gnas gnang*/ snga char nas spyan 'dren zhabs bskul rim 'byor ltar/ sku rab nas gdan bteg grub mda' ba dang sgyer pa rnams kyi 'bul zhabs dang*/ zhol steng du sgam po sku skyes gtsos pa'i bla mgo rnams kyi chibs bsu dang ser sbreng la sogs pa'i phebs bsu gzabs rgyas kyis spyan drangs te sgam po steng du gdan phab ma thag de skabs kyi spyan snga khri thog pa phyag 'bul duu phebs/ de nas sku 'dra rin po che'i drung du phebs nas dngul gyi maṇḍal dang bla re che legs la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas 'bul ba dang phyag mchod smon lam gnang*/ bco brgyad grwa tshang gi 'du khang du gzhi len gyi zhabs tog gzabs shos dang bla g.ye chen mor spyan snga sku gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs su dmigs pa'i 'bul chen mdzad cing*/ phyag mkhar ba sogs ri phan tshun gyi sgrub sde gsar rnying kun gyis kyang so so nas 'bul zhabs bgyis/ slar sgom sde gzim khang du spyan snga nyid gzhi len gyi tshul du bzhugs pa'i dpon slob drung 'khor la dkar dro gsol ston zhus nas rtsa gsum dril sgrub kyi bka' dbang yang gsan par mdzad/ rim pas rgyab skor du yang phebs pa'i gnas mjal rnams zhib tu gnang ste/ bla g.ye chen mo'i chos khri steng nas tshogs pa kun la dwags po'i chos bzhi'i bka' chos dang*/ mang ja 'gyed bcas sogs dpon slob spyi sger mtha' dag la chos dang longs spyod kyi phan pa rgya cher bstsal nas slar sku rab nyid du phebs pa na/ mdo khams nas bla ma chu tshul ba'i 'bul skyel sleb pas gser dngul/ ja dar/ rta drel la sogs pa'i 'bul chen bgyis/ 'bog kong ba sogs kyi spyan 'dren rim brtsegs kyi ngor rim pas gdan bteg

spung mkhar du sde pa'i thab skyel dang*/ la rgyab tu sgo pas thab 'dzin kyang zhus te dmar ror phebs tshe yar stod nas sde pa dpon g.yog gi chibs bsu thab 'dzin dang g.ye phyogs kyi ser skya mang po 'dus pas 'bul zhabs dang*/ de nas sde pa shel dkar ba dang skya rgyal ba sogs rnams ja 'dren phyag mchod rim 'bul bzhin/ mtsho snar 'bog kong pa'i gsol chas thab 'dzin dang*/ gzhan yang yul phyogs de dag gi dgon che phra skya ser kun gyis mjal nas 'bul zhabs bgyis shing yig drug dung phyur la sogs pa dge ba'i khas len rgya cher byed pa yang bgrangs las 'das pa byung bas thugs shin tu dgyes par mdzad/ mtsho snar 'bog kong ba'i mi ngo ser skya kun gyis mjal zhing gzhi len zhus/ sa phyogs de nyid dang sha 'ug tu phebs pa'i lam bar rnams su 'byor ldan mang pos gser la sogs pa'i 'bul chen brtsegs pa mang du byung zhing*/ de nas sha 'ug gi gtsug lag khang du phebs nas sde pas bsnyen bkur te tshes bcu'i mchod pa rgyas par mdzad/ khams stod nas bla ma yang dgon pa dang*/ ras chung pa'i 'bul skyel dang*/ rtse sgang pa sogs kong po kar srid rnams kyi spyan 'dren rta 'bul ba rnams btud mar sleb cing*/ slob dpon padma dang rje dus mkhyen gyi sgrub gnas dkar po gsang dang dom tshang gi gnas gzigs su yang phebs pa de dag gi tshe mon rgya mtshams tshun gyi skye bo bgrang du med pa dang*/ lhag par rje dus mkhyen gyi sbyin bdag mon gyi rgyal po ga thung gi brgyud pa yin zer ba kun gyis rang 'byor ci mchis pa'i 'bul nod bgyis pa de dag gang la ci 'tsham pa'i zhal mjal gsung thos bka' smon gyi 'brel pas thar pa'i sa bon thebs par mdzad/ dad can 'bog kong pa'i mi ngo gdan sa dbang grags pas gtsos pa rnams kyis gser zho stong phrag la sogs pa'i 'bul chen dpag med dang bcas rta rab bkra shis sgang gi lha khang dang grwa rgyun phul bar bstan pa 'phel rgyas kyi shis brjod gnang*/

mi ngo rnams la dbang dang 'dod chos ci rigs pa bstsal nas slar mtsho snar phebs pa na/ sde pa skya rgyal bas spyan 'dren ja zhus 'byor/ sde pa 'khor lo bas kyang 'bul zhabs bgyis/ de nas phebs lam mtsho sna ba bltams yul gzim khang la zhabs skor sogs gus mchod mdzad de/ mdo mkhar du phebs par nar ma'i zhabs tog dang gser zho stong phrag gis gtsos pa'i 'bul bsnyen grangs mang bgyis shing*/ gtsug lag khang gsar par phyag nas dang mi ngo rnams la 'dod mos kyi dbang dang khrid lung ci rigs pa gnang*/ gzhan yang yul phyogs de nyid kyi skya ser gus ldan spyi dang*/ ban pa zhing gsar bla mas sna grangs pa'i mon pa mang po dang*/ las 'phro gling pa lha zla ba rnams kyis kyang rang 'byor ma bsris pa'i 'bul zhabs bgyis/ gter ston bde chen gling pa'i sku skyer rab byung gi bslab pa bstsal ba dang*/ der 'dus kyi skye bo ji snyed pa smin grol du mdzad nas gdan bteg /sgo mdar gri gu ba'i thab 'dzin dang*/ lam gyi zhabs tog nar ma 'bog mdong gnyis kas zhus te phebs par yang dag rir yang spyan drangs nas 'bul bsnyen zhus/ der gnyal sde drug gi bla slob dpon grwa rigs kun dang*/ gnyal lo byar gsum gyi skye bo du ma 'dus shing bya ba dmag dpon pa'i ja 'dren pa'ang sleb/ dge 'dun padmo bkod pa dpon slob rnams byon pa bcas pas 'bul tshogs dang*/ 'bog kong bas kyang 'bul chen bgyis/ slar rab dga' bde chen du phebs/ sde pa dang rdzong dmar ba sogs sde dgon kun gyis 'bul zhabs cher bgyis shing*/ dpon sa chos rgyal gling pa mched kyi ja zhus dang*/ sgo nas nang so srid bral mched kyis spyan 'dren rim 'byor gyis rab brtan gling du phebs pa na/ don yod pa'i rjes su dmigs pa'i 'bul chen sogs bgyis shing*/ ston pa'i gos sku gsar bzhengs la phyag nas zhus/ de nas bteg pa'i lam du lcang ra bas 'bul zhabs dang bcas mkhar thog chos sde'i gtsug lag khang sogs par phyag nas zhus te/

chos grwa bshad sgrub gling gi karma lha khang du gdan phebs thog ri che nas sku skye grags rnam pa gtso bor gr+yur pa'i 'bul skyel dang*/ gzhan yang rgya ston pa dang dul mo ba sogs pa'i 'bul skyel mang du sleb cing*/ bshad sgrub gling pas kyang gzhi len gyi 'bul zhabs bgyis/ der lcags mo yos lo'i lo sar dang*/ sde pas bsnyen bkur nas gzhi byes kyi dge 'dun tshogs che bas smon lam tshugs shing*/ bco lnga'i nyin tshogs dbur bzhugs pa'i gso sbyong dang dge 'dun rnams kyis mchod pa'i bkod pa dang bcas pas ston pa grong khyer ma'i sku brnyan spyan drangs te ser sbreng shis brjod bcas mdzad/ rim pas spo bo phu lung pa sogs kyi rta 'bul kyang sleb/ smon lam grol nas bshad sgrub gling gi dge 'dun khams pa 'bul skyel ba rnams dang bcas pa kun la nang don dang kun rig gi khrid lung la sogs pa'i bka' chos tshugs/ spyan snga rin po che'i dbon rigs su gtogs pa chos rje kar phun la thel pa'i grwa tshang gi slob dpon dang tshogs chen gyi mkhan po sbrags pa'i kwan ja gnang*/ yar stod nas sa skyong srong btsan zhal ngo rnams kyang byon/ sgo pas do chos su spyan drangs te bsnyen bkur/ slar bshad sgrub gling pa sogs gzhi byes kyi rab byung bsnyen rdzogs bsgrub pa mang du byung*/ yom pa dang kar chen pas kyang 'bul chen bgyis pa sogs der 'dus kyi skye bo ji snyed pa mthong thos don ldan gyi phrin las bzang pos yang dag pa'i lam du dkri bar mdzad nas/ slar rab brtan gling du phebs par nang so srid bral bas nar ma'i zhabs tog dang 'bul nod rgya cher bgyis te/ de'i tshogs pa rnams la bka' chos mang du gnang ste/ sku rab tu phebs nas/ sa skyong karma mi pham pa khri thog tu che 'don gyi 'ja' sa dang tham ka shis brjod gnang cha gya nom pa dang bcas pa bstsal/ de nas zhal ngo sgar gzhung blon 'bangs dang bcas pa kun gyis 'bul zhabs rim pas bgyis te/

skabs su rin po che rnam rgyal ba'i drung du blo sbyong don bdun ma dang mtha' 'khob 'dul ba'i chos la sogs pa'i khrid dang rnam 'joms dkar po la sogs pa'i bka' dbang mang du gsan zhing*/ yul phyogs de nyid dang yul phyogs tha dad pa nas 'ong ba'i dad 'dus du ma la rab byung bsnyen rdzogs kyi bslab pa'i bka' drin dang dbang bka' khrid lung gi 'brel pa ci rigs pa'ang bstsal te/ kong phyogs su gdan btegs lam grum mda' ba sogs dang*/ rab thang khar gsar ba sde dgon/ lam bar phan tshun/ dmar mo ba sde dgon sogs kyi 'bul ba bsnyen bkur zhus shing*/ dgon de rnams la rten mchod dang*/ tshogs khro la sogs pa'i spyi rdzas dang*/ dge 'dun gyi bca' bsgrigs la sogs pa'i bka' khyab kyis 'phral yun kun tu dge bar mdzad/ byang khar sgam po pas phebs bsu thab 'dzin zhus nas zhol steng klu khang du zhag mal gnang ba dang rje sgam po ba'i dus chen tshes bco lnga 'grig cing gza' 'dzin yang byung bas sgam por sku 'dra rin po ches gtsos pa'i rten gsum la mchod me snyan dar la sogs pa'i mchod 'bul dang*/ ri gling kun la mang skol rnam gzhag rgya cher gnang*/ de nas sgo skur gyi zhal ngos thog drangs pa'i drag mgos rnams kyis zhabs skyel bcas phebs/ g.yung dar rgyas su phebs skabs dge 'dun 'og min gling pa'i dgon gnas 'debs pa'i bkod khyab do dam dang*/ zhar du thugs dam rten zung 'jug brgyud pa'i zhal thang dras mnyam bzhengs par sprul sku ba nam bkras dpon slob rnams rdzong ba gnang ste/ gzhol brgyud rim gyis phebs pa'i lam bar du nags phu ba sde dgon gyi ja zhus rim par 'byor zhing*/ dge 'dun ri kha sang sing ba kun gyis kyang phebs bsu 'bul ba zhabs tog dpag tu med pas mchod cing*/ nags phu ba sde dgon gyi phebs bsu'i bkon chen dang bcas/ lha khang steng gi gtsug lag khang gsar 'debs kyi phyi rgya grub pa la phyag nas gnang nas 'phrul khang chos khri thang du phebs thog sgam po a bo chos rje dang*/

'gru la'i mkhan po/ dpon zil gnon/ zho kha nang so rnams kyang rim pas phyag 'bul du 'byor ba la so sor 'dod chos ci rigs pa'ang bstsal/ long po rgyal po sogs pas gsol phog dang 'phrul khang nang sos gzhi len gyi dkar dro gzabs rgyas zhus/ rtse sgang pa sogs kar srid rnams kyi spyan 'dren kyang sleb/ brag dkar lha chur dge 'dun mtshan sgrog pa sogs kyis 'bul zhabs bgyis/ gnas su phebs nas dpon rgyal pos lha chu mdun gyi bzhugs khri khar tshogs mchod kyi gral dbur spyan drangs te bzhugs pa'i tshe nam mkha' 'ja' 'od kyis khengs shing me tog gi char 'bab pa kun gyis mthong ba byung zer/ zla gcig tsam sgrol dkar gyi sgrub pa'i sku mtshams la bzhugs/ sku mtshams grol te/ gnas de nyid kyi bla ma bsko bzhag dang tshogs pa rnams la mang ja/ dar 'gyed/ rgyal sras thogs med pa'i khrid yig gi steng nas blo sbyong don bdun ma'i khrid dang ljags lung sogs bka' drin bstsal te gdan bteg nas/ de nub drung de bzhin gshegs pa'i slob ma mi nyag grags rin gyi sgrub phug tu bzhugs/ phyi nyin rta rgyug thang du phebs pa na drung 'khor rnams la bsangs shing thus gsungs nas thang snar bsangs chen po mdzad cing*/ ming bkra legs pa gnyis kyis thang dkyil du tho chen po cig rgyob gsungs bzhin rgyab/

de nas rim gyis nyang ban ting 'dzin bzang po'i sgrub phug dang zhabs rjes yod pa'i gnas dang nye bar bzhugs te/ de nas 'phrul khang nas chos khri thang nyid du phebs nas bzhugs skabs sngags grwa dbu mdzad khams nas 'byor bas ja dngul sogs pa'i 'bul chen dang*/ gzhan yang kong po'i ja pa rnams dang 'jang rgyal blon mchod yon gyi 'bul skyel ba rnams kyis rim bzhin 'bul chen bgyis/ zur mang sku skye kar blo ba la kwan ting gu shri'i las ka dang*/ mnyan sprul la byang gling gi bla ma'i kwan ja gnang ba sogs khams pa'i bla 'go 'bul skyel ba mang zhig la chos dang zang zing gis rangs par mdzad/ mchog sprul dpon slob spyan 'dren pa yang gnang*/ de nas 'phrul khang bteg pa'i thab skyel gyi sar grub chen karma pa'i sku byin can bzhugs par phyag mchod mdzad de/ rim gyis sde nas gnam tshal bar gyi yul mi drag zhan dgon che phra kun gyis 'bul zhabs dang*/ nga phod du bzhugs thog 'ba' stag mgo ba'i 'bul skyel ba dang*/ glang mkhar du kong po'i spyan 'dren zhabs bskul ba'ang 'byor/ zho khar phyags phebs skabs snga sor ji skad bstsal ba'i grwa tshang gsar bsgrigs nang don la sogs pa'i gzhung 'ga' shas tshogs 'don du tshugs pa spyan lam du bstar bas dgyes par gyur/ rim gyis zho kha sde dgon sogs brag gsum phu mda' kun gyis 'bul ba bsnyen bkur rgya che grangs mang bgyis shing grwa tshang gsar pa sogs rab byung dge tshul gyi bslab pa zhu ba mang du byung*/ byang bdag po sngags 'chang bkra shis stobs rgyas pa kong por 'gro don du phebs skabs nas phyag 'bul du byon te khong rang gi sras phyags phyir 'bul ba sogs gus pa cher mdzad/ yang stod nas sa skyong srong btsan pas mchod sprin pa'i dgongs rdzogs dngos gzhi'i 'bul ba sogs 'byor bas/ rje bla ma'i dngul sku phyag nas ma dang phyag bris pustis thog drangs pa'i 'bul chen sgar chos sde kun la mang ja 'gyed bcas bgyis pa'i tshogs dbur phebs te bsngo smon gyi rgyas 'debs yang dag pa mdzad nas/

rim gyis nyang po gzhung nas chibs bsgyur bar nyang kha stod smad kyi yul gru dgon gnas ji snyed pa kun gyis so so nas 'bul zhabs dpag med kyis rim par bteg cing*/ bra tir rang byung rje'i sgrub chu zhabs rjes dang*/ gnas gzhir dge bshes shar ba'i gtsug lag khang na sle'i jo bo zhes ston pa'i sku brnyan ngo mtshar can bzhugs pa mjal te phyag mchod smon lam mdzad/ gsa' phur phebs te drung don ldan zhabs kyi gser 'bum dang gsa' phu'i jo bo zhes pa rje rol pa'i rdo rjes hor yul nas spyan drangs pa'i ston pa thub dbang gi hor sku bzo khyad can bzhugs pa'i drung du phyag mchod mdzad cing*/ rdza yig sgrub sder yang zhabs kyis bcags/ nyan khrir phebs pa na gter ston dri med kun dga'i sgrub gnas se mo rgyal zhes par kham bu'i me tog shar ba dang*/ nyang kha stod kyi chab dog por chibs 'do ba kun smon gyi zhabs rjes kyang gsal por byung zer/ nyan khrir rgya ston pa'i 'bul skyel gtos che ba sleb/ spang sna chu skor du phebs thog nas stag rtse'i dpal mkha' spyod pa'i sku 'dra rin po che yang mjal ba mdzad nas/ de nas kong stod smad kyi kar sde kun 'dus pa'i ser sbreng dang*/ bla ma rnams kyi chibs bsu thab 'dzin dang bcas dpal rnam thos kyi ri bo'i sgrub sde bsam 'phel dbang po'i tog tu gdan phebs nas/ grwa tshang kun gyi dge 'dun rnams la phyag dbang dang skye bo'i tshogs gzhan rnams kyang zhal mjal phyag nas sogs kyis sems rangs par mdzad/ rnam sras pho brang du las 'dzin rnams kyi gzhi len gyi dkar dro zhus skabs gser 'bum rin po cher snyan dar dang phyag 'bul yang gnang*/ drung pa 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal ba'i gdung chog grol ston gyi tshogs dbur spyan drangs te bsngo rten rgya cher phul bar bsngo smon gnang zhing*/ drung pa de nyid kyi dgongs rdzogs 'gyed bcas dgos pa rnams sgar gyi phyag mdzod nas gnang*/

rim gyis sku rim chen mo tshugs pa nas bzhugs yul kyang pho brang du gnang ste nyin re bzhin tshogs dbur phebs/ der sogs steng bla mas 'bul chen dang*/ phog rtsa nas bsam don pas dang*/ dpon rgyal chen sogs lta ba'i rgya bdag kun 'bul phyag tu sleb/ sku rim grol rjes sgrub sder bzhugs yul gnang nas chu pho 'brug gi lo sar gnang thog dbus gtsang dwags kong gi sde dgon 'gos che ba kun gyis lo sar dang brtan bzhugs phul ba na 'brug sgra ldir bas kun gyis ltas bzang por gleng*/ sku mtshams bdun phrag gcig pa zhig gnang ba grol nas smon lam gyi tshogs dbur phebs shing*/ bco lnga'i nyin ser sbreng shis brjod rgyas pa bcas mdzad/ de nas rim gyis rtse sgang pho brang mgon khang gi rten gtor gso ba dang*/ 'or shod phyin nas rong chu mdo tshun gyi kar dge sa rnying tshal 'brug sogs phyogs dang ris su ma chad pa'i bla ma slob dpon dge 'dun la sogs pa'i ser skya drag zhan kun mjal 'bul du 'ong pa thams cad la ji ltar 'tsham pa'i khrid lung sogs kyi chos sbyin dang*/ zhal mjal phyag dbang la sogs pa'i 'brel pa mkho dgu'i dngos po'i phan pa dang bcas so sor bstan pa spyi'i gsos dang*/ 'gro ba bde thabs kyi mdzad 'phrin rgya cher spel zhing*/ g.yung dar rgyas su'ang dge 'dun 'og min gling pa'i gtsug lag khang gsar 'debs kyi cha rkyen gyi gnang cha gya nom pa dang*/ rong gtsang gi zhal ngo kun la grogs 'gyur dgos pa'i bka' shog dang bcas gnang zhing*/ g.yam bzang gi spyan sngar snga srol ltar chos mdzad par kwan ting gu shri'i las ka dang bcas te bsko bzhag dang*/ rtse sgang gi nang sor gdan sa pa snga ma rnams kyi 'ja' sa'i las ka bzhin gyis kwan ja gnang*/ de skabs rnams su sde pa phu lung pas gtsos pa'i spo bo stod smad pa yongs kyis mjal zhing*/ ja dngul rta sogs pa'i 'bul chen rim par bgyis/

bu chu gter gyi lha khang gi jo bo thugs rje chen po'i drung du na bza' snyan dar 'bul ba dang phyag mchod 'bul bar phebs nas 'khor gyi rten phran dang spang thog zhig gsos dgos pa rnams rgyu dang bzo bo sogs gang ci'i dgos cha gnang nas 'phral gso'i bka' bstsal/ phyir phebs nas tre chen sku skye bshad sgrub gling bla mar bsko bzhag gnang ste/ sgrub sde'i skyil po bzhugs nyams spro ba zhig tu sku mtshams la bzhugs pa'i khog nas zing po sum mkhar gyi bar sogs kong stod smad kyi zlos sna yod pa kun bka' shog dang mi snas zlos med du mdzad/ sku mtshams khrol tsam mdzad nas nang so sgo ba srid bral ba 'das pa'i bsngo zhus su dpon sa smin grol ba dpon g.yog byon par mjal kha dang bsngo smon gyi rgyas 'debs gnang*/ des phul ba'i gos sku rab brtan gling du bzhugs par bstsal/ sgo pas phul ba'i 'bri phyugs mang po rnams dang*/ 'o yug nub sgang pas kho rang gi sa gzhis gang yod phul ba rnams rje bla ma'i sku gdung mchod rten rin po che'i mchod thes su sbyar ba sogs nyi ma bzhi'i bar du dbus gtsang dwags kong spo bo la sogs pa'i mjal mi kun gang la ci 'tsham pa'i thugs rjes 'jug pa bstsal nas/ slar sku mtshams su bzhugs/ dgongs pa ji lta bar bu chu'i zhig gsos dgos pa rnams grub/ de nas rim gyis rgya la'i nye logs su ri 'ur gyis gtsang po 'khyil ba la thugs dmigs gtad pa'i phyag nas dang*/ gtsang pa mched kyis sde pa zhing ma chen gyi don du/ karma rabs dgu sogs kyi sku brnyan bzhengs pa mtshur phur bzhugs par zhus nas phul bar/ sku gser du gser zho nyis brgya dang dngul chu dang bcas skyel mi gnang*/ spo bo phu lung pa'i sde bar dgon gyi gdan sa'i kwan ja gu shri'i las ka dang bcas gnang*/ gsa' phu'i gser 'bum rin po cher gser shog sgron pa dang*/ lha khang zhig gso'i rgyu dang bzo bo bcas rdzongs gnang*/

mchog sprul dpon slob spyan 'dren pa bskyar ma gnang zhing*/ sku mtshams khrol tsam gnang nas rngod so ri dgon pa'i 'bul chen pa rnams la zhal mjal dang*/ spungs ri nang so kar sgrub par de nyid kyi gdan sa'i kwan ja gnang*/ de dang rtse sgang nang so/ so ri bla ma sogs khams kong gi bla 'go mang zhig la 'dod chos kyi dbang lung ci rigs kyang bstsal te/ mtshams kyi bcad rgya snga mus bzhin gyi ngos nas/ rtse sgang pho brang la lcags ri'i mkhar las kyi zhal ta gnang nas las mgo tshugs/ rgya nag pho brang nas gong ma tā'i ming dban li rgyal po'i gser yig 'bul nod dang bcas pa/ rta 'bul ba rnams nyid kyi 'bul chas/ zhing gi mi chen sogs mdo pa'i dpon rnams kyi zhu yig rten bcas rnams dang*/ dge 'dun zur ri ba khams su bsod snyoms su byon pa rnams 'byor/ 'bri khung nas rje mchog sprul dpon slob bzhugs sgar du chibs bsgyur yod pa'i bang chen sogs dang zhu 'phrin sleb/ zla ba dgu par sku mtshams grol te/ dge 'dun zur ri ba rnams kyis mjal dar dang phyag 'bul bzhes/ de nas tshogs gur du spyan drangs nas 'bul chen bgyis pa'i phebs zhor/ rtse sgang pho brang gi lcags rir gzigs rtog dang phyag nas gnang zhing*/ sgar mang la mang skol dang 'gyed bcas gnang nas/ drag zhan kun gyis yig drug nyin stong mtshan stong chags med du 'don dgos pa'i bka' bkod bsgyur/ rgya gar nas dza ha bir gyi slob ma badzra nā tha zhes pa'i dzau gi ched btang mjal du 'ong bas bzang po'i yul chos kyi legs dgu'i 'bul skyel bla lhag pa phul zhing gus pa cher bgyis par chos 'brel dang*/ gser gyi gnang cha dang*/ rgya nag tu 'gro ba'i lam yig bka' shog bcas gnang*/ bu chur phebs nas zhig gsos grub pa rnams la gzigs rtog phyag nas mchod 'bul smon lam yun ring du gnang*/ rta rna ba sogs khams pa'i 'bul skyel ba rnams dang*/

chab nag nas lhun brag pa'i ja zhus spyan 'dren pa yang sleb pa kun la 'dod chos dbang lung 'ga' zhig gi bka' drin dang*/ dge 'dun yang zur gyi gsar bu sogs mang por rab byung bsnyen rdzogs kyi bslab pa bstsal/ khang dmar ba kun gyis 'bul bsnyen dang*/ 'o thang pa dang lta ba'i rgya bdag sogs pa'i spyan 'dren pa rnams lhags/ gong ma dban li'i zhu lan ston pa'i 'phel gdung gi gnang skyes bcas dang rta 'bul ba sogs kyi zhu 'phrin 'phrod lan rnams tshong dpon gu ru tshe brtan la brgyud de bstsal/ 'o thang du phebs par stod smad kun gyis 'bul zhabs rnams bgyis shing*/ rtse sgang sde nyid du phyir phebs nas dpon bzang ldan pa dpon g.yog rje mchog sprul drung du rdzong ba rnams 'byor/ bla ma tre sprul dpon slob khams su 'gro don du phebs par byin rlabs dang bkod khyab rdzongs skyes kyi gnang cha bka' shog rnams bcas bstsal/ de nas ston pa'i sku 'bag grong khyer ma dang ma mgon mgar gsum gyi 'chams sku gsar bzhengs rnams la rab gnas gnang ste/ rgyal khang lhun brag pa sogs kyi mos pa bskang phyir chibs bsgyur nas rgyal khang tshal du gdan phebs par chab nag pa kun gyis 'bul bsnyen rgya cher dang*/ ri bo dga' ldan pa dpon slob rnams kyis kyang 'bul zhabs dang*/ bshad pa 'bel gtam sogs legs bshad kyi mchod pas lhag tu mnyes par byas/ der 'dus kyi skye bo kun la zhal mjal chos 'brel mchod sbyin sogs pa'i legs khyab bstsal nas/ slar rtse sgang sgrub sde nyid du phebs thog mchog sprul rin po cher lo sar 'bul mi rdzong ba dang*/ rim pas lo mjug sku rim dang chu sbrul lo sar gyi dga' ston rgyas par gnang*/ gzhi byes kyi dge 'dun tshogs che ba la gzhi rgyun gyi zhabs tog phyag mdzod nas btang ba'i yang ri'i tshogs gur du smon lam 'dzugs pa gnang ba'i bco lngar gso sbyong dang bcu drug la shis brjod bcas mdzad/

lo chen ratna'i sku skye dpon slob phyag 'bul du byon zhing*/ rje mchog sprul dam pa dpon slob phebs par rtse sgang nang so dang*/ phyag mdzod pas gtsos pa rnams kyis chibs bsu thab 'dzin dang*/ dge 'dun gzhi byes kun gyis ser sbreng gzabs rgyas kyi bsu ba'i bkod chen gyis spyan drangs te/ rje mchog sprul dpon slob nas kyang phyag 'bul mjal skyes kyi 'bul nod gya nom pa dang bcas yab sras zhal 'dzom gyi dgyes spro ches cher mdzad/ dge 'dun cog grwa pa khams su bsod snyoms la byon pa yang 'byor bas mjal dar phyag 'bul zhus/ de nas rje mchog sprul dpon slob rnams la gzhi len gyi bzhugs gral dgyes ston dang*/ dge 'dun cog grwa ba bzhag bla dpon sogs pas zla bsdebs dang bcas pas 'bul chen bgyis/ de nas rim gyis dbon dkon mchog pa rje mchog sprul dam pa'i phyag mdzod du bsko bzhag dang*/ dbon kar bstan pa dga' ldan ma mo'i gdan sar go shri'i las ka dang bcas bsko bzhag gnang zhing*/ cog grwa'i dge 'dun gsar bu ba sogs rab byung bsnyen rdzogs kyi bka' drin zhu ba mang du byung*/ 'brug pa sprul sku rin po che gshegs pa'i mchod bsngo rten 'bul mi yang sleb/ de nas re zhig mgon po'i nang sgrub gyi sku mtshams la bzhugs pa grol nas yab sras bzhugs sgar lhan rgyas kyis kong smad la chibs bsgyur te thog mar lta ba g.yung drung 'dzin du phebs par/ lta ba stod pa dang bar tshigs pa sde dgon kun gyis 'bul zhabs zhus/ mchog sprul dam par rgyal ba gong ma'i bka' 'bum las rje btsun ngal bso'i ljags lung dbu tshugs shing*/ chu jo bor grags pa thugs rje chen po rang byon bzhugs pa'i gnas mjal la phebs te phyag mchod smon lam mdzad pas de skabs than pa chen po yod pa la yul gru kun la sman pa'i char chen po yang babs/ de nas rje gong ma'i zhabs zin dpon rgyal chen la sogs pa'i rgya bdag kun gyis thab 'dzin dang*/

rtsi gu steng pa rnams kyis ser sbreng gis phebs bsu dang bcas te tshal gung du phebs par rgya bdag rnams kyis gtsos pa'i lta ba smad pa kun gyis 'bul zhabs yun ring bgyis shing*/ dgon so sor spyan drangs nas 'bul bsnyen kyang bgyis/ mchog sprul dam par gzhi byes kyi bla 'go dka' bcu rab 'byams du ma'i zhabs 'breng dang bcas par dgongs gcig rgyas 'grel sogs rje gong ma'i bka' 'bum 'phro mus kyi ljags lung dang*/ mchog sprul rin po ches sku 'khris su gsan sbyong phyags phyi'i grwa tshang zhig 'dzugs pa'i dgongs pa zhu ba mdzad par/ thub bstan nyin byed gling gi ming dang 'dus pa thog ma bcu phrag gcig la mang ja dar 'gyed gnang*/ gzhan yang dge 'dun cog grwa pa sogs gzhi byes kyi chos don gnyer mang po la'ang tshogs chos dang zab khrid kyi dmigs rim sogs gang la ci 'tsham pa'i bka' chos shin tu smar zhing*/ zhal mjal/ gsung thos/ phyag dbang*/ dge bskul sogs 'brel pas skye bo dmangs kyi re ba yang gang bar mdzad nas/ rje rang byung pa'i bzhugs gnas bkra shis lkog 'phrang du phebs par de gong rje bla ma dang yab sras phebs skabs su 'dzugs pa gnang ba'i grwa tshang dar rgyas shin tu che ba bla ma gnyis kyis gtsos pa rnams kyis thab bsu ser sbreng la sogs pa'i bkod pa gzabs rgyas kyi spyan drangs te 'bul ba dang*/ bsnyen bkur cher bgyis shing grwa rigs yon bdag kun la zhal mjal phyag dbang chos 'brel la sogs pa'i bka' drin stsol bzhin pas der thogs shig bzhugs nas slar lta ba tshal gung nyid du phebs thog gdan sa bar nas drung pa gdung brgyud pa sogs 'bul skyel du 'byor ba dang*/ zhag sgom sku skye sogs pa 'byor pas 'phul chen rim par bgyis/ rgya bdag rnams sogs lta ba'i yul mi kun gyis kyang ston gyi dus ston phul ba la sogs pa'i 'bul zhabs rim par bsgrubs/

bla ma karma khyung chen la rje bla ma'i gsung rgyun ji lta ba'i mgon po'i gdangs dbyangs rnams yod pas drung skor rnams la nan tan gyis khrid gsungs pa'i bka' bstsal dang*/ 'bul skyel pa sogs par 'dod mos kyi bka' chos dang rab byung bsnyen rdzogs kyi bslab pa'i bka' drin mang du bstsal/

zla ba dgu pa'i tshes gnyis gza' skar shis pa la thub bstan nyin byed gling pa'i tshogs gur thog ma phub pa'i zhal dror rje sprul pa'i sku rin po che nyid kyis gtso mdzad pa'i ser sbreng dang bcas te spyan drangs par phebs nas shis brjod phyag nas gnang*/ dbon po phyag mdzod par mtshur phu nas rten sgam gyis gtsos pa'i sku chas phye bsal gyis 'di dang 'di rnams phul gsungs pa'i bka' shog sgam yig phyag deb dang bcas te rdzong ba mdzad/ spo 'bor ba dang bar lam khog gi 'bul skyel ba mang du sleb/ de nas lta ba ri dgon gyis bla ma grwa rigs yon bdag dang bcas pa kun la ja gral/ phyag dbang*/ phyag mdud la sogs pa'i gnang chas sems rangs par mdzad de/ gsang ba rnams kyis nan zhus ngor phebs/ slar lkog 'phrang du phebs par bsnyen bkur zhabs tog rgya che ba dang*/ dus 'khor/ kun rig /bskang gso rnams kyi 'don bsgrigs dang phyag len rim pas spyan lam du bstar bar dgyes pa'i thugs kyis bla ma grwa mang dang bcas pa kun la phyag dbang dang*/ rten bzhag dgon thes kyi gnang cha bzang po/ bka' bkod bslab bya dang bcas pa bstsal/ gsang du gdan phebs bar gsang ba kun gyis rang 'byor ma bsrin pa'i 'bul zhabs mang du bgyis te grong la phyag nas kyang zhus/ sa bcas bstsal nas/ bla ma kun rgyal bas la rtsa dgon du spyan drangs nas bsnyen bkur skabs/ gsang gi jo bor grags pa ston pa grong khyer ma/ dbus lha li dmar las grub pa ngo mtshar can bzhugs pa gzim gur du spyan drangs te phyag mchod/ zhal gser/ snyan dar la sogs pa'i bkur sti cher mdzad cing*/ dge 'dun khag rnams nas kyang phyag mchod mdzad du bcug /rje mchog sprul dam par rgyal ba gong ma'i bka' 'bum las dkyil chog skor sogs lung gnang*/ de nas rgya la'i gnas gzigs kyi dgongs pas gdan bteg nas thim gyi gu ru'i sgrub phug tu tshes bcu'i mchod pa dang*/

gtam gling gi 'bum sprul pa'i yig mkhan gyis bzhengs par grags pa yang mjal bar mdzad de/ rgya lar phebs pa'i lam gyi sde dgon so sos bsnyen bkur rim par chos 'brel bstsal/ phebs nas de'i gnas mjal gnang tshe/ gshin rje'i zhal rang byon yod pa'i brag las 'ja' 'od 'phro zhing slar de nyid du thim pa dang*/ rang byon de'i spyan g.yon ngos ha cang mi gsal ba yang de skabs shin tu gsal bar snang ba'i ngo mtshar yang byung*/ de nas seng gtam du phebs te der gu ru'i zhabs rjes bzhugs par dad can gyis gsol 'debs byas pa na/ sngon bdud rtsi 'bab pa la bar skabs gser chab gsol ba'i rkyen sogs pas mi 'bab pa la de skabs bdud rtsi 'bab pa sngon bzhin byung bas kun ngo mtshar du gyur zhing*/ gzhan yang gnas de'i gzigs snang rang byon sogs zhib tu mjal bar phebs pa'i tshe/ yab sras gnyis char gyi zhabs rjes dang rgyal ba nyid kyi phyag rjes kyang byon zer/ slar yar la phebs pa'i lam zhor du dong mo lung gnas gzigs rnams kyang mdzad nas rim gyis thim du phebs skabs/ 'jang rgyal blon rnams kyi zhu yig 'bul chas spo 'bor ba'i 'gron tshan gzhan yang 'bul skyel ba mang rnams sleb/ thim nas rgya la yan gyi yul dgon rnams phyogs gcig pas nas khal gnyis stong brgyad brgya/ mar zho ba dgu brgya la sogs pa'i 'bul chen mang du bgyis/ khams kyi grwa rgyun sogs par rab byung bsnyen rdzogs dang*/ mgon po'i cho ga'i lung la sogs pa'i 'dod chos ci rigs pa'ang bstsal/ rim gyis phebs par chab nag pa yul dgon sogs pas 'bul chen mang du bgyis shing*/ thams cad zhal mjal gsung thos kyi 'brel pa dang*/ yul gru so sor ri rgya klung rgya la sogs pa dge ba'i sa bon bskrun par mdzad cing*/ gtam myog tu grong la phyag nas gnang ba khyim phal mo che'i nang du sleb pa byung*/ klu sha nas sngon rje bla ma mchog gis yun du bsten par mdzad pa'i gnas ri bo gser gling yang zhabs kyis bcags/

de skabs mchog sprul dam par rje chos grags rgya mtsho'i bka' 'bum thor bu ba'i ljags lung nar mar mdzad/ rtswa nang gi gnas gzigs la phebs nas bzhugs sgar du phyir phebs thog dpon mdzod pas mtshur phu nas rten sgam gyis gtsos pa'i sku chas rnams drangs pa 'byor pas rgyal ba nyid yol sgor zhabs bskyod pa'i spos bsu bcas rten sgam gzim gur du spyan drangs/ de nas rtse sgang zhol thang du bzhugs sgar gdan phebs/ rim pas lo mjug dus gtor dang*/ rta lo'i lo sar zla ba gnyis par gnang zhing*/ gzim gur du gandho la'i rten shoms rgyas pa mdzad nas/ yang zur cog grwa/ zur ru gdong pa/ lkog 'phrang grwa tshang sogs gzhi byes kyi dge 'dun stong dang brgya phrag kha yar gyis smon lam 'dzugs pa gnang ba'i bco lngar gso sbyong dang bcu drug la rten mjal gnang ba bcu bdun la gnas brtan bcu drug dang rgyal srid sna bdun gyi zlos gar dang bcas pa'i ser sbreng shis brjod mdzad/ smon lam thog zing po ba sogs kyis 'bul chen mang du bgyis/ gzhan yang dpon chos phun mchod yon/ 'or shod o rong ba sogs kong stod pa'i drag mgo rnams dang*/ spo bo g.yu ri ba sogs pa'i rta 'bul pa rnams dang*/ karma stod smad dang*/ bu chu ba rnams kyis 'bul chen rnams rim par bgyis/ lho brag nas bla ma dhwi sprul pas 'bul chen dang*/ de dang rtse sgang nang sos gtsos pa'i dge 'dun nyis brgya tsam la rab byung bsnyen rdzogs gnang*/ yar stod nas dpon sa 'das pa'i bsngo zhus pa sleb pas tshogs dbur byang bu phyag bzhus dang bsngo smon gnang*/ phyogs kyis 'bul skyel ba rnams kyis thog drangs pa so sor bka' chos dang sman bla'i mdo chog ljags lung sogs kyang gnang*/ dge 'dun yang zur cog grwa gsum gyis gtsos pa'i tshogs chen la rgyal ba nyid kyis mdzad pa'i phyag chen khrid lung dang dmigs rim yun ring du gnang*/

lnga pa'i tshes bcu nas gandho la'i rten sgam gzim gur du bzhugs par yol sgor nang nas zhabs skor 'bum ther gnang ba'i dbu tshugs shing*/ de mtshungs skor lam chen mo nas 'bum ther bsags pa'ang mang du byung*/ de skabs rin po che dpa' bo dang*/ yar stod pa gtsang pa mched mchod yon sogs dbus gtsang gi bla ma sde dpon grwa tshang sogs che 'gos kun gyis spyan 'dren zhu nan pa mang rnams 'byor zhing*/ rgyal tshab sprul sku'i ma yum 'das pa'i bsngo rten kyang 'byor bas tshogs dbur byang bu phyag bzhus dang bsngo smon gnang*/ de skabs rnams su/ mchog sprul dam par phyag rdor tshe dbang la sogs pa'i bka' dbang*/ rje bdun pa'i bka' 'bum las phar phyin dang tshad 'grel sogs kyi ljags lung yang gnang*/ spo bo phe thang du kar sde gsar 'dzugs kyi don la yang ri nas dge slong bcu gnyis rdzongs gnang zhing*/ dgon par karma bstan 'phel rab brtan gling gi ming dang*/ tshogs khro sogs kyi dgon thes kyang gnang*/ 'ba' stag mgo'i bla ma dang*/ kha dkar ba'i 'gron tshan 'byor bas 'bul chen bgyis/ rje mchog sprul dpon slob kong smad du skor tsam phebs/ rgyal ba nyid gdan chags pas stag mgo bla ma sogs don gnyer can rnams la dwags po bka' 'bum gyi ljags lung dang*/ lkog 'phrang grwa tshang ba rnams la dus 'khor gyi dbang bka' rgyas par gnang*/ dbus su tshogs dge 'dun sgang pa'i mkhan chen kun blo ba khrir phebs kyi legs ja gnang skyes bstsal/ ri che'i chos rje khri thog pa dang*/ rta rna ba sogs kyis 'bul chen bcas sleb/ de ltar zla ba dgu tsam gyi bar bzhugs pas der 'dus kyi skye bo yongs la skal pa dang 'tshams pa'i phrin las kyi sgo brgya brgyas 'phral dang gtan du phan bder mdzad nas/ phrag mi kun gyis snga phyir zhu nan ngor phebs te/ tshal za yul du phebs par/ de dag gi yul dgon rnams kyis zhabs bsnyen dang*/

klu shod pas spyan drangs te 'bul zhabs dang*/ de nas sgrub brgyud gling pa rnams lho tshang rag gi dgon 'dzin sogs la bka' bkod gnang cha dang bcas te rdzongs pa gnang zhing*/ 'phyong rgyas nas sa skyong mi dbang gshegs pa'i bsngo zhus pa sleb/ bsho kha chos sde dang bam steng ba so sos spyan drangs nas 'bul mchod kyis bsnyen bkur/ zing po khyim gsum gyi ja zhus 'bul nod kyang 'byor/ slar bsho kha nas brgyud phrag mi yul dgon rnams kyis bsu ba'i bkod chen bcas pas phrag sgrub sder gdan phebs par gzhi len gyi bsnyen bkur zhus/ de mtshungs rje mchog sprul dpon slob kyang kong smad nas yar phebs par gzhi byes kyi chibs bsu ser sbreng sogs kyi bkod pa gzabs rgyas kyis mdun bsus te yab sras zhal rgyas/ sog zam nas 'brong bu gu shri sogs par stod kyi 'bul skyel ba rnams 'byor/ der lo mjug sku rim dang shing mo bya lo'i lo gsar gnang ste/ dbus gtsang*/ dwags kong sogs kyi lo sar gyi skyes dang spyan 'dren du sbrags pa'i mi sna mang rnams 'byor/ mchog sprul dam pa dga' ldan ma mor phebs shing*/ rgyal ba nyid cho 'phrul gyi dus chen dang bstun pa'i khog nas yang ri'i tshogs gur du gandho la'i rten shoms bgyid du bstsal nas/ yang zur cog grwa zur gdong pa sogs gzhi byes kyi dge 'dun rnams kyi smon lam btsugs/ slar sku mtshams grol nas tshogs dbur phebs/ bco lngar rten mjal gnang ste bcu drug gi nyin ser sbreng shis brjod mdzad/ de skabs stag bla sogs rab byung bsnyen rdzogs sgrub pa yang mang du byung*/ nyer bdun la mchog sprul dpon slob phebs te yab sras zhal rgyas kyi chibs rags phrag mi chu gong 'og kun gyis rim pas spyan drangs te 'bul bsnyen rnams bgyis shing*/ zur ru gdong grwa tshang gis kyang de nyid du spyan drangs nas mchod 'bul bstod/

der yab sras bka' bgros nas rje mchog sprul dpon slob dwags po'i dus gzings kyi dum la phebs pa dang lhan cig a mi grong du bzhugs thog sgrub sde nas chibs rags spyan drangs te bsnyen bkur/ slar sgrub sder phebs nas zla ba bcu gcig pa'i bar du slar yang phrag mi rnams sogs pas 'bul bsnyen rim par zhus te/ skabs su sku mtshams gyi bcad rgya/ skabs su gzhi byes kyi chos don gnyer mang po rnams la/ byang chub lam sgron dang*/ dwags po'i thar rgyan sogs pa'i ljags bshad dang*/ phyag chen chos drug sogs pa'i khrid ci rigs pa'ang stsal/ ras chung phug sku skye legs gling du slob dpon du bsko bzhag las dgongs grol zhus par rgya bya dbon rab 'byams pa bsko ba gnang zhing*/ sku skyes gsol btab bzhin nyid mdzad kyi khrid yig chen mo'i steng nas phyag chen nyams khrid gnang*/ skabs 'gar gnas gzigs sogs par yang phebs/ rje chos grags rgya mtsho'i thugs bzhugs yul gyi mchod rten nang tsan dan dang*/ phyi mu tig las grub pa bzhengs pa dang*/ gandho la'i mchod rdzas su gser gyi maṇḍal sum tshar brdung ba dang*/ byes su rgyun bsnams kyi rten gtor gser zangs las grub pa 'dzugs pa rnams kyang rim pas gnang ba de skabs su 'or shod nas sde pa khag gsum gyis ja zhus spyan 'dren dang*/ khams nas si tu sprul sku chos kyi rgyal mtshan zhabs drung du 'byon pa'i ja zhus snga 'bul la be ri rab 'byams pa mngags pa yang 'byor zhing*/ bar lam khog gi 'bul skyel gzhan yang mang du sleb/ sum mkhar nas dbon bstan pa mchod yon rnams kyis lo sar smon lam dga' ma mor phog pa dgos pa'i zhu ba phul bzhin gdan bteg ngos smad du si tu rin po che dpon slob phyags phebs pas mjal 'dzom mdzad/ sum mkhar ba dang ba yor dgon rnams kyi thab bsu ser sbreng sogs pa'i bkod pas dga' ma mor gdan phebs te lha chen dang gser 'bum rin po che rnam gnyis la phyag mchod mdzad gtsug lag khang gsar mar bzhugs yul gnang*/

si tu rin po che dpon slob kyis/ gser dngul/ ja gos/ rta drel mdzo sogs sna grangs re rer yang brgya brgyar bsgrigs pa'i brgya 'bul dgu'i 'bul chen dang*/ gzhan yang sgom sde nang chen pa dang be ri rab 'byams pa sogs drung de'i zhabs phyir yod pa kun gyis kyang ja gos rta drel mdzo sogs brgya 'bul grangs mang phul te/ der 'dus kyi skye bo khri phrag tsam la zhwa mthon mthing gi cod pan bzhes pa'i zhal mjal thugs rje chen po'i sgom lung dang bcas pa gnang zhing yig drug dung phyur la sogs pa dge ba'i khas len byed pa yang mang du byung*/ de bzhin du ri che nas mkhan po dang*/ bla ma mkhas grub pa/ 'ja' mo sku skye/ 'brong pa dpon dang*/ zur mang ba dge legs la sogs pa'i 'bul skyel dang*/ dbon gu shri bstan 'dzin pas gtsos pa'i gzhi pa dpon slob rnams kyis 'bul chen bla lhag pa rnams rim par bgyis shing*/ 'brong pa dang sgom sde'i chos 'bri bar gser dngul sogs pa'i gnang cha'ang mdzad/ 'jang rgyal blon mchod yon gyi 'bul skyel gtos che ba'ang 'byor/ dga' ma mo ba dpon slob rnams kyis rje bla ma de nyid dang rgyal ba nyid kyi sku brnyan bzhengs par 'khor lo sdom pa'i cho gas rab gnas mdzad cing*/ a ne dam tshig sgrol mas rgyal ba nyid tshogs dbur bzhugs pa'i tshes bcu'i sbyin bdag bgyis te tshogs gtor rgya chen po bshams/ de nas lo dus kyi sku rim chen mo dang mo pho spre'u lo sar gnang bar gtsang dbus dwags po yan gyi bla ma sde dpon thams cad spyan 'dren dang bstun pa'i lo sar 'bul mi sleb/ gsar ma'i 'du khang du rten gtso gandho la dang*/ jo bo'i thugs dam lung bstan sgrol ma sogs rten shoms mdzad de yang zur sogs/ dge 'dun stong dang nye bas smon lam tshugs pa'i tshogs dbur skabs su phebs shing si tu rin po che dpon slob kyis gtsos pa'i gzhi byes kun la rten mjal rags rim yang gnang nas bco lngar gso sbyong dang bcu bdun smon lam grol ba'i shis brjod du gtsug lag khang gsar rnying la phyags skor gyi ser sbreng rgyas pa mdzad/

de skabs dga' ma mo ba spyi bla brang dpon tshang gong 'og rdzar sgrub sde rnams kyis bsnyen bkur zhing*/ dpon tshang gong 'og yul mi dang bcas pas 'bul chen yang bgyis/ khams kong ba mang po'i dge 'dun la rab byung bsnyen rdzogs gnang*/ de nas rim pas drung si tu rin po che dpon slob kyis thog drangs pa mang dag zhig la rje nyid kyi bka' 'bum gyi ljags lung la sogs pa'i bka' chos kyang rgyun mar stsal zhing*/ slar gtsug lag khang rnying mar rje bla ma'i gzim chung chos dbyings pho brang du sku mtshams su bzhugs pa grol nas re dga' grwa tshang khams su bsod snyoms la byon pa 'khor ba dang si tu rin po che dpon slob dbus su 'byon pa'i zhal ta bslab ston dang*/ rdzongs skyes kyi gnang cha mdzad/ sog yul nas rgyal po a dpal gyi gser yig pa 'byor bas zhu phrin dang 'bul ba phul te rgyal po'i gam tu phebs dgos pa'i gsol ba 'debs pa dang*/ de bzhin sog po bal dur rgyal po'i gser yig pa 'byor bas zhu 'phrin dngul gyi tham ka dang bcas phul/ rdza ra sgrub sder dbyar gzigs dang bstun spyan drangs bzhin phebs par mchod dang bsnyen bkur zhing khong rnams la bka' chos dang zhal ta gnang cha bcas mdzad der bzhugs khri'i rgyab yol gyi pha wang ngos la sku rjes ches gsal po yang byon/ gtsug lag khang du phebs par/ dwags po rin po che rnam rgyal ba gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs 'bul mi 'byor par mchod bsngo dang phyag nas kyang sgar chos sde kun la mang ja 'gyed bcas gnang*/ dpon dpal 'byor pas spyan 'dren nan zhu'i ngor dga' ldan ma mo nas bteg /nags dgon par phebs shing 'bul bsnyen bgyis/ spe thang gru nas zur gdong dang*/ phrag sgrub sder yang phebs/

de nas bkra shis ljongs kyi gnas gzigs la dgongs pa gtad nas phebs pa'i ba yor drung rol pa'i rdo rje'i sku 'drar phyag mchod snyan dar 'bul ba mdzad/ gnas nang du phebs par bkra shis ljongs pa rnams kyis thab bsu ser sbreng dang tshogs 'khor zhus shing phyag chen pas gnas bshad rgyas par phul/ de nas rgyab skor la phebs nas de'i gnas mjal rnams rim par mdzad cing shar phyogs dpal phug na ston pa sangs rgyas/ rje dus mkhyen/ grub chen pakshi'i sku byin rlabs can du grags pa bzhugs pa rnams la snyan dar la sogs pa'i mchod pa mdzad nas slar gnas nang nyid du phebs pa de dag gi tshe rje rang byung ba nas mi bskyod rje'i bar na rim gong ma rnams kyi gzigs snang kun zhib tu mjal ba dang*/ rgyal ba nyid kyi gzigs snang sku gzugs mchod rten yig 'bru'i rnam pa mang po yang phyag chen pa karma yon tan sogs par ngo sprod mdzad/ gnas nang du sku mtshams zhag bdun ba zhig gnang ba grol nas nang skor gyi gnas gzigs rnams kyang zhib tu mdzad cing sgrub pa ba rnams la bka' chos kyi 'brel pa zab rgyas dang mang ja dang rten la sogs pa'i gnang cha mdzad/ de nas byin legs su phebs par bla ma gdan zur grwa yon kun gyis bkur zhabs ches cher bgyis nas byin legs gong 'og gi gnas gzigs rnams gnang tshe gzigs snang gi rnam grangs du ma phyag chen par ngo sprod gnang zhing phyag zhabs kyi rjes kyang byon/ sgrub pa ba rnams la bka' chos kyi 'brel pa dang mang ja dang rten sogs kyi gnang cha mdzad de slar ba yor phebs nas sog steng du bzhugs yul gnang bar sog steng pas 'bul bsnyen dang*/ nal pa bu mda' ba kun gyis 'bul zhabs yang dag bgyis shing ru mdo dgon pa dang brtul mi mtsho dkar so sos spyan drangs te zhabs bsnyen pa dang*/ skyen pa dang o rong pa sogs 'bul bar sleb/ rje don ldan zhabs yun ring bzhugs gnas dgon sar rgya mtsho sgang zhabs kyis bcags/

re zhig sku mtshams bzhugs khog rje tre chen pas bshad sgrub gling du dpal dus mkhyen dang grub chen pakshi'i sku bzhengs par phyag nas dang*/ dgon sar rgya mtsho sgang gi rten rnams zhig gsos gnang*/ sku mtshams grol nas rim gyis rnam thos kyi ri bor phebs par/ ling tse dpon gyis gser dngul ja gos rgya zog du ma'i 'bul skyel dang*/ gzhan yang spo 'bor ba sogs pa'i 'bul skyel mang du sleb/ rtse sgang nas so sgrub sde ba rgya 'og dang bcas pa kun gyis kyang gzhi len gyi bsnyen bkur dang 'bul ba bsgrubs shing*/ khams phyogs 'bul skyel ba rnams kyis gtsos kun la dbang chos dang dge tshul slong gi bslab pa ci rigs bstsal/ rim par lo dus kyi dgu gtor dang shing mo bya lo'i lo sar gnang skabs dbus gtsang sogs sa phyogs tha dad pa'i lo sar dang brtan bzhugs 'bul mi spyan 'dren pa bcas mang du 'byor/ kong smad du chibs bsgyur skabs rin spungs sa skyong 'jig dbang pa gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs kyi bsngo rten 'bul mi sleb/ chab nag dri la'i 'dab yul gsum par phebs te bzhugs skabs ma yum sku gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs su kong stod smad kyi chos sde kun la mang ja 'gyed rnam dang bcas bstsal zhing*/ rim gyis tshal gung du phebs pa'i bar de dag tu spo bo stod smad kyi 'bul tshogs zhu mi chab dkar nag gi yul dgon rnams kyis 'bul zhabs mtha' yas pa bsgrubs par zhal mjal phyag dbang chos 'brel sogs pas 'phral yun du dge bar mdzad/ de mo la khab dpon slob rnams kyis kyang mjal shing gus 'byor cher bsgrubs/ tshal gung du ma yum gyi dgongs rdzogs su yang zur sogs dge 'dun tshogs cher chog mang 'dzugs pa dang*/ dwags po yan nas ngam ring man gyi dgon sde ris su ma chad par mang bskol/ rje mchog sprul dam pa/ dpa' bo/ 'bri stag sogs pa'i chos rje rnams la bsngo rten 'bul mi gnang*/

yum gyi sku gdung rtse sgang sgrub sder zhugs la phul tshe nam mkha' 'ja' 'od kyis gang ba la sogs pa'i ltas ngo mtshar ba du ma byung zer zhing*/ mtshan byang phyag bzhus kyang gnang nas cho ga ba rnams la yon rdzongs dpangs bstod pa dang sgar mang la mang ja 'gyed rnam bcas gnang ste chog mang grol/ lkog 'phrang du phebs nas mgon sku dang gnas brtan bcu drug gi zhal thang sogs bris 'bur gyi rten gsar bzhengs mang dag la rab gnas rgyas par gnang*/ slar tshal gung du phebs/ 'brog lam pas thog drangs pa mang por skyes bu gsum gyi lam rim dang*/ g.yu ri ba sogs par lhan cig skyes sbyor gyi bka' chos gnang*/ rtse sgang sgrub sder phebs pa na'u 'ju shan nas gu shri mchog grub pas mngags pa'i rta 'bul ba gong ma'i zhu 'phrin 'bul skyel dang bcas pa 'byor zhing*/ gzhan yang stag lung chos rje'i zhu 'phrin 'bul chas dang sog po bla ma zhig kyang 'byor ba rnams kyis 'bul chen rim pas spros shing*/ so sor zhu lan dang rdzongs da gnang*/ de nas rim pas sgrub sde'i grwa tshang pho brang du spos nas slob dpon du spo 'bor rab 'byams pa bsko ba dang bu chu'i rten mjal du phebs pa sogs gnang skabs si tu rin po che dpon slob dbus phyogs nas 'khor te zhabs drung du byon pa 'byor zhing*/ khams nas mtshungs med sku skye dang bya btang brag dkar ba sogs 'byor bas 'bul chen bgyis/ karma stod smad bu chu ba dang bcas pa kun gyis kyang ston gyi nas phud la sogs pa'i 'bul zhabs rim par bsgrubs/ rtse sgang pas grub chen pakshi dang rje nyid kyi sku sogs gsar bzhengs 'ga' zhig dang*/ yum gyi dgongs rdzogs rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku gsar bzhengs gdung 'bum dang bcas par rab gnas gnang zhing*/ bzhag bla sku skye dang 'dang gi 'bul skyel spo 'bor ba'i 'gron tshan mang du 'byor/ chab nag tu spyan drangs te sgo zho la sogs pa'i 'bul zhabs yang dag pa bgyis nas slar rtse sgang du phebs thog byang bdag po bkra shis stobs rgyas pa dpon slob khams phyogs nas 'khor ba zhabs drung du byon pas 'bul chen mdzad/
