bdag po'i sras phyags phyir bzhugs rgyu sogs gzhi byes kyi rab byung sgrub mi sum brgya tsam dang bsnyen rdzogs zhu ba yang mang du byung*/ zla ba de nyid kyi tshes bcu bdun la si tu rin po che bsnyen par rdzogs pa mdzad cing*/ dbang bka' chos lung gi rim pa'ang mang du bstsal/ yar lung nas rtse zhabs drung gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs 'bul mi sleb par bsngo smon mdzad/ de nas rim pas lo mjug dus gtor dang sa pho khyi lo'i lo sar gnang bar/ rje mchog sprul rin po ches dbu mdzad dbus gtsang dwags po yan gyi bla dpon 'gos che ba kun gyis spyan 'dren dang bstun pa'i lo gsar 'bul mi 'byor ba rnams kyis lo sar dang spyan 'dren gyi zhu 'bul bgyis/ de nas cho 'phrul gyi dus chen ring phal cher sku mtshams la bzhugs ring lcags mo'i dpon slar 'khor bar gnang cha dang bcas te khams su rdzongs pa gnang*/ sku'i rim gro pa dpon karma bzang ldan tshe'i 'phen pa rdzogs pa'i don du/ rje mchog sprul dam pas gtsos pa'i dbus gtsang yongs kyi bla slob la bsngo rten/ chos sde la mang skol 'gyed bcas/ tsheg mang 'dzugs pa sogs dgongs rdzogs rgya cher bsgrubs/ slar yang zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes brgyad nas bdun pa'i bcu drug gi bar sku mtshams bzhugs pa grol thog kong stod nas sangs rgyas gling pa'i dbon karma sngags 'chang dang spyad ku grong pa/ 'or shod chu skor ba/ brtul mi mtsho dkar/ zum mkhar dpon tshang gong 'og sogs mjal du 'ongs pas so sos 'bul zhabs bgyis shing*/ sku rab sa skyong dmag dpon pa spyan 'dren du 'byor/ seng gtam gyi sgrub pa ba rnams la nyid mdzad kyi bla ma mchod pa'i ljags lung dang sgrub pa'i zhal bkod mdzad/ de nas si tu rin po che dpon slob khams su 'byon pa'i rdzongs skyes kyi gnang cha bzang po dang 'phral yun gyi zhal ta bslab ston zhib par gnang ste/

rtse sgang nas gdan bteg rim gyis ba yo'i sog steng du phebs pa'i bar kong por lo bo brgyad tsam du bzhugs pas yul phyogs de dag gi skye bo'i tshogs kun la skal pa dang 'tsham pa'i phrin las kyi 'jug pa mtha' yas pas dag pa'i lam gyi snang ba sbyin par mdzad de/ dwags kong mtshams dang kong po nang khul gyi dus 'khrugs rnams kyang byams brtse'i stobs kyis rim pas mkhon zlos med par mdzad pa dang*/ 'gro ba'i bsod nams kyi zhing gyur gtsug lag khang rten brten pa dang bcas pa kun la zhig gsos dang*/ gsar bzhengs bcas bkur sti phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ der bzhugs kyi dge 'dun rnams la bslab pa rin po che rnam pa gsum gyi sgrub pa'i yon tan la sbyor ba sogs bstan pa dang sems can gyi phan bde nyin mor mdzad de/ der sku rab nas sa skyong dmag dpon pa sogs gtsang dbus dwags po yan gyi lo mang nas spyan 'dren pa rnams la chibs bsgyur ba'i bka' stsal bas/ kong stod smad zho kha tshun gyi skya ser drag 'gos ji snyed pa zhal mjal phyag 'bul du 'ong bas 'bul bsnyen dang bcas phyag 'bul zhus shing*/ der stod klung ngos nas dbon gu shri dang sde pa kar phrin pa sogs kyang zhabs phyir bcar slad 'byor/ de nas sog steng nas bteg ste bkra shis ljongs kyi gnas mjal du phebs nas gsar ma yang mdzod du bde gshegs mchod rten brgyad kyi gnas sgo yang 'byed par mdzad cing*/ byin legs su phebs pa na 'od skor gyi nang du dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs zhal gzigs/ rin phug gi gnas gzigs su phebs pa las slar bin thang du phebs thog rje dpa' bo sprul sku phebs pa dang dbus gtsang gi spyan 'dren pa rnams 'byor/ stong shod pas bsnyen bkur/ gnas rang du zhol mo che nas rje bla ma'i dbon a bo dbang phyug gis 'bul zhabs cher bgyis shing*/ dung dkar brag tu phebs bar so so nas 'bul dpangs bstod/

la bar nang na yar phebs par la thog zur mkhar dang*/ dpal 'byor rab brtan du 'bul ba dang bsnyen bkur zhus te/ khra 'bag gi la nas sde pa sku rab pa dang*/ rtse le ba mchod yon gyis thab bsu ser sbreng dang bcas gong lar phebs/ der sde pas gzhi len gyi bsnyen bkur dang rje dpa' bo'i sprul skus spyan 'dren gsol 'debs kyi 'bul nod gser zho phyed dang sum brgya dang lnga bcu rtsa bdun gzim gur yol bskor dang bcas pas thog drangs pa'i 'bul chen mdzad cing*/ 'brum mda' ba nang so dang lho brag grwa tshang gi slob dpon rnams kyi mjal 'bul sogs kyang zhus/ de nas mtsho dkar du re zhig bzhugs pa'i dgongs pas bebs par rdor 'dzin la sogs pa rnams kyis phebs bsu gzhi len zhus te bzhugs yul khyung rdzong du gnang nas phal cher sku mtshams su bzhugs shing skabs su ston mchod kyi tshogs dbur phebs pa dang*/ byang nas dbu ma'i drung nas dpon slob mjal du 'ong pa sogs la bka' chos kyang gnang*/ de nas lo dus kyi dgu gtor dang sa mo phag lo'i lo sar gnang bar/ gtsang dbus kyi sde pa sogs rnams kyi spyan 'dren dang sbrags pa'i lo sar 'bul mi rnams la sogs pa'i gzhi byes tshang mar zhal mjal gsung thos gnang*/ de nas kyang phal cher sku mtshams dang skabs skabs su mtsho skor gyi zhabs 'chag la yang phebs pa'i zhar la sku 'khor rnams dang phyag chen par gzigs snang 'ga' shas kyi ngo sprod kyang gnang*/ zla gcig tsam la mtsho dkar gyi sgrub pa ba phyags phyir yod pa'i sgar pa rnams dang bcas par nyid mdzad khrid yig chen mo'i steng nas lhan cig skyes sbyor gyi dmigs rim rgyas pa la sogs pa'i khrid lung ci rigs pa stsal te/ slar sku mtshams la zla shas bzhugs pa grol nas chu bo ri tshe chu sbug gi sgrub sde rnams la sogs pa gnas mjal dang zhal mjal du 'ongs pa kun la mjal ka gnang*/ bde chen nas dbon gu shri kar bstan pa 'byor ba bsnyen par rdzogs/

de nas rim gyis gnas gsar mar yang phebs nas gzigs snang du ma phyag chen pa rnams la ngo sprod mdzad/ slar mtsho dkar du phebs par dpon mdzod pa sogs gnas phyir yod pa'i drung 'khor drag rim rnams dang bshad gling nas chos rje tre chen po sogs spyan 'dren du byon pa dang*/ gzhan yang rgyal tshab sprul sku dang dbus gtsang gi mi sde che dgu kun spyan 'dren par gnas mtshams su byon pa rnams la 'gyang min phebs pa'i bka' shog dang 'khris su yod pa rnams la'ang bka' bzhes stsal/ nam bkras pas zung 'jug brgyud pa'i zhal thang rnams grub pa phyag tu phul/ de nas mtsho dkar nas bteg rim pas tsā ri ma chen gyi gnas mjal rnams zhib tu gnang*/ bya yul nas 'bul zhabs ches 'byor/ sngags grwa rgyal byed tshal gyi mgon khang dang pho brang sne'u gdong rtse'i gser 'bum la phyag nas gnang ste/ gong la'i gzim khang du phebs skabs/ rgyal tshab sprul sku dang*/ rje mchog sprul sku tshab gtsang dbus kyi spyan 'dren pa'i mi sna/ rgya ston pa'i 'bul skyel ba sogs sleb/ der re zhig sku mtshams la bzhugs khog nas sgar gyi bsgrig bcar cung zad thugs ma rangs pa'i bka' stsal dang*/ slar yang bca' yig bskyar bsdam la sogs pa'i bslab ston zhib tu gnang ste sku mtshams grol nas zla ba bcu gnyis par sku rab bkra shis sgang gi bzhugs sgar du phebs nas lo mjug sku rim dang*/ lcags pho byi ba'i lo gsar gnang*/ skyid shod nas rgyal bu dge ba don gnyer du zhabs phyir byon pa dpon g.yog 'ga' shas kyi gtsug phud bzhes shing*/ lo sar gyi thog gtso bor rje mchog sprul bzhugs sgar nas spyan 'dren lo sar 'bul mi dang*/ gzhan yang dbus kyi bla ma sde dpon dgon sde kun gyis lo sar 'bul ba dang bstun spyan 'dren zhabs bskul ba sleb/ sku rab gnas gzhi'i tshoms chen du gandho la'i rten shoms yang zur la sogs pa'i dge 'dun rnams kyis smon lam tshugs pa'i mthar rten mjal ser sbreng shis brjod bcas gnang*/

mchod yon stabs gcig pas bshad sgrub gling du bzhugs rgyu'i bka' 'gyur gsar bzhengs la rab gnas dang*/ dgon sar du rin po che rnam grags pa'i phyi rten gyi rab gnas rim par gnang zhing*/ slar sde pas 'bul chen sogs pas bsnyen bkur/ sku rab nas bteg lam gyi sde dgon rnams kyi 'bul zhabs kyis bsnyen bkur zhing*/ de nas dge 'dun rnams kyis bsu ba'i bkod chen bcas pas bshad sgrub gling du gdan phebs/ sde pa dang dpon yul sde kun gyis rim bzhin 'bul bsnyen bgyis/ shun zhabs drung dang mtshur phu rin po che yang phebs pa 'byor ba spyan 'dren gyi 'bul nod dang*/ bsnyung gnas ras pas dge 'dun grwa tshang zhig gsar 'dzugs bgyis pa zham ring du phul/ bya pa dmag dpon pas 'bul chen dang*/ dge 'dun padmo bkod pa rnams kyang 'bul chen dang mgon 'chams sogs pa'i phyag len gzigs phul/ sgam po spyan snga bkras rnam sprul sku rab byung sgrub tu byon bzhin bka' drin bstsal/ bshad sgrub gling pa rnams dbyar gnas mdzad pa'i dge 'dun tshogs cher lhan cig skyes sbyor gyi dmigs rim rgyas pa'i bka' chos dang*/ gzhan yang rab byung bsnyen rdzogs ci rigs pa'i bka' drin stsal/ dbyar gnas grol nas dge 'dun rnams kyis dus 'khor sgrub mchod sbyin sreg dang bcas pa'i phyag len dang dkyil 'khor spyan lam du bstar bas dgyes pa bskyed/ bshad gling pa sogs dwags po'i sde dgon che phra gra yon kun gyis 'bul zhabs grangs mang dang*/ slar yang dbus gtsang yongs kyi spyan 'dren zhu bskyar ba mang rnams 'byor bas zhal bzhes/

de nas bshad sgrub gling pa'i dge 'dun rnams la bca' yig sgrog pa dang sgo gsum sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i don bslab gsum la nan gyis sbyor dgos pa'i bka' khyab spyi rdzas kyi gnang cha gya nom pa bstsal zhing*/ gling mthar lcags ri dang gtsang khang rgya phibs la gser thog gnang ba'i dgongs pas de dag gi sa yul la phyag nas dang lcags ri'i sa thig bre ba mdzad nas sde pa khu dbon rnams la de bzhin gyi 'bad grogs dgos tshul dang*/ sgyer chos 'khor gling gi gtsug lag khang gsar 'debs dang 'thus btsun sogs kyi rtsol ba yang ma dor ba dgos pa'i bka' stsal yang gnang ste/ bshad sgrub gling nas gdan bteg pa'i phebs lam du lcang ra pa'i ja 'dren dang*/ sgo ba'i yang thab bsu ser sbreng sogs pas rab brtan gling du phebs par rje bla ma'i sku'i rim gro pa nang so mched dang sde dgon kun nas rab tu bsnyen bkur/ de nas bteg lam skyil skyes dgon pa rnams dang*/ mtsho mo dgon sogs pas 'bul zhabs dang*/ yar stod nas sde pa khri pa yang phebs bsur byon pas ja 'dren bzhes spro zhus nas go ra chos rdzong du phebs/ bsam bder sa skyong srong btsan pa khu dbon dpon g.yog rnams kyis rtsi ma gser ga la sogs pa'i bkod pa gzabs rgyas kyis chibs bsu dang*/ g.yam bzang dga' tshal sogs dgon che phra kun gyi ser sbreng dang bcas yar stod khrom sar gdan phebs par/ kong po'i ja pa rnams dang rab 'byams pa 'ba' lug /bla ma gcod pa'i 'bul skyel ba bcas 'byor bas ja 'bul mang du brtsegs pa dang*/ de nas lhun sgang dang dga' tshal ba rnams kyis rim par gzhi len bsnyen bkur dang 'jang gi 'bul skyel/ spo 'bor ba'i mgron tshan gtsang dang lho stod la sogs pa'i spyan 'dren pa rnams mang du 'byor zhing*/ sa dbang srong btsan pas rnam rgyal sgang du sger gyi zhabs tog dang 'bul chen zhu ba dang*/ byang sding pa dang*/

spel dmar ba dang dga' tshal ba sogs kun gyis spyan drangs te mchod dang bsnyen bkur ba dpag med bgyis shing*/ ngas chung sbug nas sku skye dpon slob mjal phyag tu byon nas 'bul chen btegs/ bya yul nas dpon sa gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs pa'ang 'byor bas bsngo smon mdzad/ de nas lo mjug sku rim dang lcags mo glang gi lo sar gnang bar dbus gtsang gi bla sde yongs kyi dga' ston gyi skyes 'bul zhus/ sde pa khri pas sger gyi 'bul bsnyen rgya chen po mdzad nas slar khrom sar phebs/ rtse nas zhabs drung gdung brgyud rin po che gtsug phud phul bar 'bul chen dang bcas phebs pa'i gtsung phud bzhes te mtshan gsol/ tshogs dge 'dun sgang nas mkhan chen ston 'khor mjal phyag tu byon/ de nas lhun sgang tshoms chen du gzhi byes kyi chos sde rnams kyis smon lam tshugs shing*/ bcu bdun la sde pas 'bul chen mdzad/ zhal ngo rnams la bka' dbang ci rigs pa'ang stsal/ de skabs rnams su 'bog mdong gi sde pa dang*/ mdar rgyal ba dang*/ gzhan bar lam khog gi 'bul skyel ba rnams dang*/ shel brag pa dang dung la bas kyang 'bul chen rnams bgyis shing*/ rab byung bsnyen rdzogs dang bka' chos mang du gnang*/ 'phyong rgyas pas e waṃ dgon du spyan drangs nas 'bul chen dang bsnyen bkur zhus shing tshe dbang la sogs pa'i bka' drin nod/ slar khrom sar phebs pa na byang bdag po bkra shis stobs rgyas pa yab sras mjal du byon cing 'bul dpangs bstod/ zla ba gnyis pa'i bcu gsum mchod pa dang bstun g.yam bzang pas spyan drangs nas 'bul zhabs bsgrubs shing lha mgon gyi 'chams sku spyan 'dren pa la gzigs rtog dang phyag nas gnang*/ phyir phebs nas dga' tshal ba dpon slob rnams la dge 'dun gyi bca' bsgrigs bslab pa'i bka' bkod gnang*/ de nas khrom sa nas bteg ste gtsang phyogs su chibs bsgyur lam yar 'brog brgyud/

gri gu gsang sngags chos gling du phebs par gri gu ba'i dpon sa spun gyis phebs bsu zhabs tog 'bul chen bgyis shing*/ der sa skyong srong btsan pas gtsug phud phul te sku rten bsgyur bar dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa stsal/ der mtshungs spel dmar ba nang sos kyang gtsug phud phul bar dge bsnyen gyi bslab pa gnang*/ dkar mo gling kha nas brang mdar phebs thog yar rgyab nas sa skyong bdud 'dul zhal ngo rnams byon pas sger gzhung so so nas 'bul zhabs gzabs rgyas sogs zhus shing*/ dge 'dun sngags gra ba rnams kyang de bzhin 'byor/ bkra shis sgar du gzhis ka gong dkar nas zhabs drung mi'i dbang po khu dbon las tshan gzabs rgyas gus 'dud du phebs shing gdung brgyud rin po che'i gtsug phud 'bul ba dang bsnyen bkur 'bul zhabs mtha' yas pa zhus nas bka' dbang bka' chos kyi 'grel pa ci rigs pa'ang gsan zhing*/ 'brug pa'i chos rje lha rtse ba yang mjal phyag tu phebs nas bka' 'brel zhus/ de nas rim pas dpal deb dang sna dkar rtse nas khri dpon khu dbon phebs pa sogs kyis 'bul chen bteg cing dbang chos kyi bka' drin nod/ gtsang nas sde pa mthu stobs pa'ang ja 'dren du byon/ rim bzhin ngur smrig rje btsun sgrol ma'i drung du phyag mchod gnang nas phebs par/ dge 'dun 'og min gling pa mchod yon gyis thab bsu ser sbreng kyi bkod pas spyan drangs te gtsug lag khang gsar bzhengs su bzhugs yul gnang nas gzigs rtog dang bde mchog gi sgo nas rab gnas rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg bcas gnang*/ gzhi ba mchod yon gyis bsnyen bkur 'bul chen dang*/ sde pa gtsug rab pa mi ngo rnams dad 'dun chen pos 'bul chen bcas rnams 'byor bas sgar ston dang 'bul chen rnams bgyis/ bdag po bkra shis stobs rgyas pa'i sras phyags phyir bzhugs rgyu yang 'byor/ bde skyid gling du rin spungs nas mi'i dbang po mched kyi chibs bsu thab 'dzin dang byams chen pas 'bul bsnyen bteg cing*/

rje btsun byams pa'i drung du phyag mchod mdzad nas/ dgon che phra kun gyis ser sbreng sogs pa'i bsu bkod bcas mkha' ru klu sdings su gdan phab/ der mi bdag ngag dbang nor bu bzang po ring mo nas sku mnyel bas 'das la thug par rgyal ba nyid kyi zhal mjal byin rlabs ma thob par thugs ma rdzogs pa lta bu'i mtshams su pho brang du spyan drangs te phyag dbang dang zhabs dbang*/ gshegs nas dgongs rdzogs snga mgyogs kyi sgar chos sder 'bul chog dang*/ mgyogs bsngo'i rten thugs rje chen po'i zhal thang spras thags dang*/ mu tig gi do shal rin thang bral ba/ ma na hu'i chibs sga khyad mtshar sogs phul bar rdzogs byang thob 'gyur gyi bsngo smon stsal/ chos rje tre sprul dpon slob khams phyogs nas 'khor bas phyag 'bul dang 'bul chen zhus/ de nas rin spungs nas rim gyis bteg pa dang rje mchog sprul dpon slob kyi bzhugs sgar gtsang phyogs su snga 'gros kyis phebs nas chibs rag yangs can nas slar phebs pa dred gshongs su sgar pa rtse 'dzom gyi mjal spro'i zhal rgyas/ de nas yab sras lhan rgyas su bya bzang nas chibs gzhol dang*/ smug po tshal du thob rgyal bas bsnyen bkur gzabs rgyas zhus shing*/ gong 'dzin du sde pa lha dbang rdo rje mched rgyal bu dang bcas dpon g.yog rnams kyis rtsi ma gser ga la sogs pa'i rgyan sprod gzabs rgyas kyis chibs bsu thab 'dzin dang*/ dpal 'khor chos sde ba dang zhwa lu ba sga gdong pa sogs dge 'dun dpag tu med pa'i ser sbreng gi bsu ba dang bcas pas/ klu sdings su gdan phebs par zha lu ba dang dpal 'khor chos sde ba rnams kyis yo ga'i gar dang gur gar gzigs lam phul zhing*/ sde pas nar ma'i zhabs tog dang gzhi len gyi dkar dro gzabs rgyas zhus/ sga gdong gi gzims khang la yang gzigs rtog phyag nas gnang*/ der rin spungs nas dgongs rdzogs dngos gzhir spyan 'dren nan zhu'i ngor/

rje mchog sprul dang dpa' bo sprul sku dpon slob sgar chos sde dang bcas gzhir bzhugs shing*/ rgyal ba nyid chibs bsgyur te gzhis ka rin spungs su phebs par dgongs rdzogs kyi nar ma'i zhabs tog sgar ston dkar dro gzabs shoms kyi thog /bye ru'i mgul shal/ 'gro mgon 'phags pa'i zhal dkar ma na hu'i dkar gzugs 'brug brkos ma stegs bcas la sogs pa dpag tu med pa'i 'bul chen mdzad de bsngo ba smon lam dang mtshan byang phyag bzhus kyang mdzad/ de nas g.yung du phebs pa na mon pa'i mjal mi mang du sleb pas 'bul chen bgyis shing*/ gong dkar nas dpon sa bdag mo chos don gnyer gyis byon pa'i gtsug phud bzhes/ der gser res kyi gser sogs tshon dang gang ci'i cha rkyen sbyar ba'i sman thang ba dpon slob rnams kyis 'du khang gi shing rtsi dang 'khrungs brgya'i logs bris bgyis shing*/ g.ye pa kun shes sogs pas glo 'bur phan tshun du mgon khang dang rnam sras khang gi 'bur dod rnams rim bzhengs skabs dpon slob gzhir bzhugs dang sde pa mched rnams kyis spyan drangs nas de dag la gzigs rtog dang zhal bkod phyag nas ma mgon gyi sku sogs la phyag bzo'ang ci rigs pa gnang ste g.yung nas bteg phyir lam rin spungs su zhal ngo sras yum rnams la dbang dang chos bka' mang du bstsal zhing*/ mi dbang 'jam dbyangs grags pa che 'don dang shis brjod mdzad/ de nas phebs lam nas phung po ri bo che'i gnas gzigs kyang mdzad/ de nas gzhir bzhugs mchod yon rnams kyis bsu bkod rgya cher bcas te pa rnam du phebs/ rim pas/ rje mchog sprul dang*/ rje dpa' bos dbu mdzad pa'i dge 'dun mang dag la grub chen pakshi'i bka' 'bum ljags lung tshugs/ mchog sprul dam par bde mgon gyi bka' dbang yang 'bul ba mdzad/ g.yung gi lha chen gyi sku rgyu byin rlabs dang bal po rnams la bka' bkod mdzad/ de nas kong po'i rta 'bul dang khams phyogs kyi 'bul skyel ba mang du sleb pa rnams kyis 'bul chen rim par bgyis/

pho brang nas gser yig pa sleb pas gong ma'i zhu 'phrin/ gos dar la sogs pa'i 'bul nod rgya che ba dang bcas phul zhing*/ rim pas dga' gdong grwa tshang bla brang rnams dang zur mang nas padma gar dbang sku skye 'byor ba sogs pas 'bul chen bgyis/ de nas lo mjug sku rim chen mo'i gtor rgyag sogs gzabs rgyas ngang chu pho stag lo'i lo sar thog dbus gtsang yongs kyi lo sar skyes 'bul zhus/ gzim gur chen mor gandho la'i rten shoms gnang nas gzhi byes kyi dge 'dun tshogs shin tu che bas smon lam tshugs/ tshes drug gi snga cha gza' skar 'phrod sbyor shis pa la jo bo gandho la'i drung du rgyal ba nyid kyis mkhan por gsol te/ rgyal tshab sprul skus las slob/ dpa' bo sprul skus gsang ston/ las kyi kha skong dang grib tshod pa yang zur gyi bla ma bsod bzang dang karma dad grol te lnga'i tshogs las rje mchog sprul rin po che'i zhal snga nas chig rdzogs su rab byung dang bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i bslab pa bzhes par mkhan po rgyal ba nyid kyi phyag nas legs ja'i gnang skyes dpag med bstsal zhing*/ rje mchog sprul zhal snga nas kyang mkhan po'i yon dang las gral ba bcas rnams la bka' drin gyi 'bul nod bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstsal zhing tshogs mang la ja 'gyed sogs dpangs bstod pa gnang*/ la stod byang pa'i ja zhus pa 'byor zhing*/ smon lam grol nyin mtshur phu nas ston pa gtso 'khor gyi sku 'bag spyan drangs pa'i 'khor gnas bcu rgyal srid sna bdun gyi zlos gar dang bcas yab sras kyang zhabs bskyod pa'i dge 'dun gyi ser sbreng dang shis brjod rgyas par mdzad cing*/ rim pas sde pa zhal ngo sogs par rten mjal rags rim kyang gnang*/ zla ba gsum par rje mchog sprul rin po che dang sde pa lha dbang rdo rje mchod yon la rngog dkyil bdun dang sbyong dkyil bcu gnyis/ lnga tshan lnga'i bka' dbang bstsal/

sde pa karma bstan srung gis sger gzhis nor bu khyung rtser spyan drangs nas 'bul zhabs phun sum tshogs pa sgrub skabs/ mchog sprul dam par mkha' spyod bka' 'bum gyis ljags lung tshugs shing*/ sde pa zhal ngo rnams la bka' dbang ci rigs pa'ang bstsal/ sman thang pa dpon slob kyis g.yung gi shing rtsi logs bris sogs pa grub ste zhabs drung du 'byor zhing*/ byang ngos nas sog po kha dan gyi spyan 'dren pa thog ma yang sleb/ g.yam bzang du spyan snga kun spangs pas sgar chos sde dang bcas kun la bsnyen bkur dang 'bul chen bgyis shing*/ mchog sprul rin po cher rgyud 'bum pusti kha shas kyi ljags lung tshugs/ zla ba drug par se brag g.ya' lung gi rgyab ri'i rtser ri gzigs la phebs/ phyir lam dga' gdong gzim khang du zhag shas bzhugs/ klu sdings su phebs thog nas a bo spun zla kar phrin pa bshad sgrub gling gtsang khang gser thog gi cha rkyen 'bul bskul khams phyogs su 'gro rdzongs bka' khyab shis brjod gnang*/ sde pa gtsang pa mched kyis lho brag rgyal mkhar pa'i rten gtso rje mar pas rgya gar nas spyan drangs pa'i byang chen mchod rten rang byon du grags pas thog drangs dngos po gnang che ba grangs mang gi 'bul chen zhus/ de la zangs spyad kyi rigs kun bshad sgrub gling gi gser thog rgyur gnang zhing*/ mchod rten rin po che dpa' bo'i phyag tu gnang nas sras mkhar gyi nang rten du bzhugs pa'i bka' khyab bstsal/ sog po kha dan gyi spyan 'dren bskyar nan sleb pa la gya ba'i dgon rnying gi bar du phebs nas rgyal po'i ru sgar yang der yongs rgyu byas nas byang ngos su chibs bsgyur/ stag gru khar dbu ma sku skye dpon slob rnams sleb/ rim gyis 'o yug gong sngon du dam can la gsol ka spyan gzigs dang sdings ma'i sgrub chu yang mjal ba mdzad nas phebs pa'i me tog lhas su hor stod pa dang sog po'i ja 'dren pa mang du sleb/

rim pas phebs pa'i rkyang du sum mdor/ rgyal po kha dan rgyal mo blon 'bangs hor stod dpon tshang mi ngo sde tshan drag mgos rnams dang bcas rta pa stong dang nye ba'i chibs bsu thab 'dzin gyi thog rgyal pos thog ma'i mjal skyes dpag tu med pa phul te/ de nas 'brong bu dgon rnying gi ngogs su bzhugs sgar mdzad de bzhugs par rgyal pos dkar dro'i bsnyen bkur gzabs rgyas dang*/ gos dar gser dngul rta khrab gnag phyugs la sogs pa grangs mang gi 'bul chen rnams bgyis shing*/ srog gcod spong ba dang btson brgyad cu tsam yod pa kun nyes med du gtong ba'i khas len phul bar zhwa mthon mthing gi cod pan bzhes te yig drug gi bzlas lung gi khrom chos gnang*/ de nas thal ci sogs sog po drag 'gos rnams dang*/ dpon tshang a chos kyis gtsos pa'i hor gyi sde mtshan kun gyis so so nas 'bul zhabs rgya che grangs mang rim pas bsgrubs/ de dag gi skabs su rgyal po mi ngo rnams la 'dod chos kyi bka' ci rigs pa'ang bstsal/ stod klungs bde chen nas dbon kar bstan pa gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs pa sleb pas bsngo smon bstsal zhing*/ yab sras bka' bgros thog de'i 'dren don du rje mchog sprul dpon slob chibs bsgyur/ rgyal ba nyid re zhig gdan chags pas jo mo gangs kyi gnas gzigs la phebs nas/ slar dgon rnying du gser 'bum la snyan dar bka' srung rdo rje'i rdzing btsan la spyan gzigs/ grwa tshang par spyi rdzas la phan pa'i gnang cha yang dag pa bstsal te dgon rnying nas bteg /mchil phu'i dben gnas dang nye tshal brag skor nas thab 'dzin zhus/ gling dkar du phebs thog nas byams chen pa gshegs pa'i bsngo zhus pa dang*/ sde pa gtsang pas rdzong nas gzhi len gyi gdugs tshod bshams/ thob rgyal bas spyan 'dren nan zhu'i ngor chibs bsgyur bar/ dpon g.yog rnams kyis bsu bkod dang*/ dgon khag rnams kyi ser sbreng sogs bkod pas kham bu tshal du gdan phab/

thob rgyal rtser spyan drangs te/ dkar dro gzabs rgyas dang*/ dge bshes pu to ba'i thugs sras kyi dgon gnas snye mo drel lhas kyi rten gtso li dmar gyi rdo rje 'bebs pa'i sku dbus lha khyad can gyis thog drangs pa'i 'bul nod rgya cher bgyis shing*/ rdzong la phyag nas dang zhal ngor dbang bka' sogs gnang*/

de nas rim pas 'dul grwa gling pa dang*/ khri skor/ khri brtan/ brag nag pa rnams kyis so sor spyan drangs nas 'bul zhabs bsgrubs/ de skabs su g.yung gi lha chen yang grub pas de'i gzungs bzhugs dang rab gnas su thob rgyal ba mchod yon gyi phebs skyel bcas chibs bsgyur nas rin spungs su phebs pas/ mi dbang 'jam dbyangs grags pa mched sogs kyis phebs bsu sogs sngar bzhin gyi bsnyen bkur chen pos btegs cing*/ byams chen du'ang phebs/ gos sku'i mjal ka dang rje btsun byams pa'i drung du phyag mchod gnang nas/ g.yung dar rgyas kyi gtsug lag khang du gdan phebs te rim pas steng shod kyi rten bzhengs bris 'bur grub pa rnams la gzigs rtog gnang*/ de nas gtsang khang gi rten chen yul dbus rdo rje gdan gyi ma hā bo dhi'i dbyibs dang tshad du grub pa dang bla ma lha khang gi zung 'jug brgyud pa'i sku brnyan rnams kyi gzungs bzhugs rim pas gnang zhing*/ legs par grub nas dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga'i sgo nas phyag len rgyas pas rab tu gnas par mdzad pa'i dngos gzhi'i nyin/ gtsang nas sde pa lha dbang rdo rje dpon g.yog dang*/ rin spungs nas mi dbang mched sogs byon nas legs ja'i dga' ston gyi skyes 'bul rgya cher mdzad cing*/ bla ma gser sdings pa'i 'bul skyel dang*/ zur gdong pa'i rta 'bul ba sogs 'byor bas 'bul chen bgyis/ de ltar gtsug lag khang rten brten pa dang bcas pa'i rab tu gnas pa legs par grub nas/ g.yung nas gdan bteg /rim gyis nyang stod du phebs/ rgyal mkhar rtse nas bdag po sku mched dang dpal 'khor chos sde ba mchod yon rnams kyis chibs bsu thab 'dzin ser sbreng sogs phebs bsu'i bkod pa gzabs rgyas kyis spyan drangs te/ dpal 'khor chos sde'i nye logs su bzhugs sgar gnang*/ rgyal rtse pho brang du spyan 'dren zhus nas 'bul bsnyen rgya chen pos bteg cing*/

ston pa'i 'phel gdung dang theg chen dbu zhwa la sogs pa'i rten mjal phul/ der sa skya bdag chen khri rin po che'i ja zhus pa'ang 'byor/ de nas dpal 'khor chos sder yang spyan drangs te bla brang dkar por bur ston gyi thog mkhan po dang grwa tshang rnams so sos 'bul nod bgyis/ de'i gtsug lag khang mchod rten dang bcas pa'i rten mjal mchod zhib tu gnang zhing*/ rtse dang chos sder bzhugs pa'i gos sku rnams kyang mjal ba mdzad/ dpal 'khor chos sde bar phyag nas mang ja rnam gzhag rta bzhi bcus gtsos pa'i spyi 'gyed dpangs bstod pa dang*/ bdag po zhal ngo rnams la yang bka' dbang dang gnang cha bzang po bstsal/ de bzhin du rtse chen pa dang 'brong rtse bas kyang bsnyen bkur/ de nas sna sar rgyal khang gi gtsug lag khang rnams mjal ba mdzad de nor bu khyung rtse nas pa rnam klu sdings su phebs pa na/ rje btsun sprul sku tā ra nā tha dpon slob phebs par thugs 'dun ltar rgyal ba rgya mtsho bde gshegs bzhi bsgril gyi dbang sogs dang*/ sku gsum ngo sprod kyi khrid sogs dbang khrid zab dgus thugs rab tu smin par mdzad nas/ slar phebs khar rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i sba lcag gis ka ṭor 'brus gang bar yang yang dkrugs pa gnang nas/ sngar o ḍyan par grub chen pakshis bstan pa gtad dus kyang 'di ltar yin gsungs shing*/ sba lcag rje btsun sprul sku'i dbur yun ring por bkod de/ 'u cag thugs rgyud gcig pa yin pas snying po don gyi bstan pa gtad pa yin zhes stsal to// de nas tshogs chos lung gi mkhan chen dpon slob rnams 'bul phyag tu phebs/ nyer gsum mchod pa la pa rnam rtser phebs/ de nas rim bzhin phebs par nyug rgyal khang du spyan drangs te 'bul bsnyen dang bka' 'gyur gsar bzhengs la rab gnas zhus shing*/ shangs nas chibs bsgyur lam phan tshun kun gyis so so nas 'bul zhabs dang*/ 'bras spungs dgon pa bas kyang bsnyen bkur 'bul nod bgyis te/

de nas rgyal tshab sprul sku dang gtsang pa'i zhal ngo mchod yon rnams kyis chibs bsu/ grwa tshang yan phyin kun gyis ser sbreng gzabs rgyas kyis rnam gling klu sdings su phebs/ bla ma khro phu ba dang tre nag gi 'brog pa rnams kyis 'bul chen mang po dang*/ gsung rab gling du spyan drangs te gzhi len gyi dkar dro zhus/ rtse sgang pa'i rta 'bul dang spo bo'i 'bul skyel rnams sleb/ zab phu lung gi gnas gzigs su phebs pa'i lam du tre ho dpon slob kyis stag rna chos rdzong du spyan drangs te/ 'bul mchod dang gtsug lag khang la phyag nas zhus/ lha phu ba dang dpal lho pa sde dgon gyis kyang bsnyen bkur bsgrubs/ gnas nang du phebs nas tshes bcu'i mchod pa dang gnas mjal rnams gnang ste/ phyir phebs lam du yang lha phu ba sogs pas sngar bzhin bsnyen bkur dbang dang bka' chos ci rigs pa'ang bstsal/ slar yang stag rna dgon dang*/ de nas rnam gling klu sdings su phebs te lo mjug dgu gtor dang chu mo yos lo'i lo sar gnang bar phyogs mtha'i lo sar 'bul mi dang 'jang gi 'bul skyel dang spo 'bor pa'i 'gron tshan sogs 'byor bas/ skyes 'bul dang 'bul chen rnams bgyis/ gzhan yang gsung gling sogs nye skor sde dgon mang pos 'bul bsnyen ci rigs pa bsgrubs/ gsung rab gling du gan dho la'i rten bsham gnang ste gzhi byes dge 'dun rnams kyis smon lam tshugs/ tshes bcu bdun la smon lam grol ba'i ser sbreng shis brjod mdzad cing*/ gzhi byes kyi 'dus pa tha ma lta bu'i rab byung bsnyen rdzogs sgrub dgos pa ches mang du byung bas bka' drin bstsal/ de dag gi skabs su sku 'khris pa gzhan su yis yang thos rigs su ma gyur pa'i rje sprul pa'i sku rin po che dbu ru stod du bzhugs pa la myur stabs kyis khams phyogs su phebs pa'i thugs 'dun yod tshul la sogs pa'i bka' shog zhig phebs pa sku'i bkod pa de nyid yun ring du mi bzhugs pa'i dgongs pa ste/

de nas ring por ma lon par sku khams ma bde ba rim pas mnyel bab lci bar gyur pa la/ sku rim zhabs brtan gyi gsol 'debs lhod med bgyis kyang*/ rnam 'phrul de nyid kyis gang gdul bar bya ba de snyed gcig dbugs dbyung mdzad nas skye bo rtag 'dzin can dag de las bzlog slad/ dgung lo zhe brgyad pa chu mo yos lo zla ba dang po'i nyer brgyad kyi tho rangs kha dgongs pa chos kyi dbyings su snyoms par bzhugs te yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul bstan pa re zhig gsang khog nas sku gdung rin po che mtshur phur spyan 'dren zhus/ zla ba gnyis pa'i nang du gsang brtol bgyis nas sgar chos sde kun la sprul sku myur 'byon gyi gsol 'debs btsugs/ de ltar dgung lo de snyed la bstan 'gro'i don du mdzad phrin rmad du byung ba las gang gi slob ma sras kyi thu bo brgyud pa'i srol 'dzin rje mchog gi sprul pa'i sku rin po che zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin pa drug pa dpal gar dbang chos kyi dbang phyug gi zhal snga nas gtso bor gyur pa'i bu slob sgam po spyan snga bkra shis rnam rgyal ba'i sku skye dang*/ rje btsun glo bo'i sprul sku/ snying po don gyi bstan pa gtad pa rje btsun sprul sku tā ra nā tha sogs rgyal ba nyid las bka' drin thob pa dang*/ rje bla ma dam pa dang dpon slob thun mong las bka' drin thob pa si tu rin po che chos kyi rgyal mtshan dge legs dpal bzang po dang*/ rje dpa' bo sprul sku dpal gtsug lag rgya mtsho/ 'bri khung chos rje rin chen rnam rgyal dang*/ stag lung chos rje kun dga' bkra shis sogs khri gdan zur rnams dang*/ ri bo che'i chos rje mtsho skyes rdo rje dang sku skye karma grags pa rnam rgyal/ bla ma tre ho'i sku skye karma bslab gsum rgya mtsho dang*/ zur mang chos rje karma legs bshad sgra dbyangs sogs lung rtogs yon tan du mas phyug cing rang gzhan don gnyis phun tshogs sgrub nus pa mang du byung zhing*/

bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa rin po che'i gzhi dang 'gro ba'i bsod nams kyi zhing dam pa dge 'dun sbong ba pa dang*/ klog pa'i sde rnying pa gso ba dang gsar du 'dzugs par mdzad pa yang bod dang bod chen po'i rgyal khams gang ba tsam du dar bar gyur la/ gzhan 'grel dang rang gzhung du mdzad pa'i bstan bcos kyi rnam grangs kyang*/ zab chos phyag rgya chen po lhan cig skyes sbyor gyi khrid yig /dpal zla ba'i dbu ma la 'jug pa zab mo'i 'grel pa/ bstan bcos mngon mdzod kyi 'grel pa sogs glegs bam bcu skor tsam bzhugs la/ de nas sgar mang chos sde dang bcas pa rim pas mtshur phur bteg pa 'byor ba dang*/ rje mchog sprul rin po che phebs pa rtse 'dzom dang bcas zla ba gsum pa nas dge 'dun yang zur cog grwa /mtshur phu ri gling*/ gnas nang ba/ yangs can pa/ 'og min gling pa/ nyin byed gling pa la sogs pa'i 'dus pa tshogs che bas mchod 'bul gyi chog mang dang gsol 'debs smon lam 'dzugs pa mdzad pa'i nar ma'i zhabs tog gi khur len phyag mdzod nas dang gtsang nas sde pa mched rnams kyis kyang mdzad de/ rje mchog sprul rin po ches dbu mdzad pa'i dpon slob khag so so nas kyang tshogs pa rnams la mang bskol spyi 'gyed rnam gzhag gser dngul la sogs pa'i/ gdung 'bul gser gdung gi sku rgyur dmigs pa dang bcas pa dpangs bstod de mdzad/ yar stod nas sde pa srong btsan pa khu dbon dang*/ gtsang nas sku tshab tu spyan snga kun spangs pa byon pa sogs kyis gdung 'bul gyi dngos spyad gnang che ba rlabs cher phul ba sogs phyogs mtha'i gdung 'bul gyi dngos spyad rnams dang*/ rje nyid kyi sku chas mchod sprin du 'os pa ji snyed pa dag mchod yon rnams rtse rgyas kyi thog nas ngam ring man dang spo bo yan gyi grub pa'i mtha' phyogs dang ris su ma chad pa'i dgon sde che phra kun la mang ja 'gyed chen so so'i bla slob dpon rnams la mchod bsngo'i rten dang bcas pa rgyal ba mi bskyod zhabs dang rje bla ma zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin pa lnga pa'i dgongs rdzogs kyi deb bstun mdzad cing*/

jo bo shākya mu ne'i drung du gser zho sum brgya las grub pa'i maṇḍal che legs/ jo bo mi bskyod rdo rje dang yangs can gyi rje bla ma'i dngul gdung rin po che'i drung du dngul gyi maṇḍal re re/ rdo rje gdan gyi ma hā bo dhi'i drung du snyan dar dang mchod me'i cha rkyen gser la sogs pa rgya bod kyi rten gsum grags che ba kun la mchod sprin rgya cher 'bul ba mdzad/ zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes gcig la rin po che dpa' bos rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i cho ga'i sgo nas sku gdung rin po che bzhugs la bzhen par mdzad cing*/ zla ba de nyid kyi mjug tu gdung chog rnams grol te phyag mdzod nas bla g.ye nub ma'i bzhugs khri'i mdun du sgar mang chos sde rnams dang bcas pa'i tshogs dbur rje mchog sprul dam pa spyan drangs par mchod bsngo'i rten gyi 'bul chen bla lhag pa/ tshogs pa kun la mang ja spyi 'gyed/ bla slob dpon rnams la rnam gzhag sogs rgya cher bsgrubs te mchod bsngo gnang*/ de nas rim pas rgyal tshab sprul pa'i sku dang dbus gtsang gi bla sde drag mgos rnams dang*/ sgar chos sde'i gros dpang dang bcas pa kun blo gros bstun pa las sngon gyi rgyun lam bzang po bzhin rje mchog gi sprul pa'i sku rin po che rgyal tshab tu mnga' gsol te bzhugs sgar bsdoms nas dod mkhur len gyi phyag g.yog rje dpon mdzod pa karma rig 'dzin gyis mdzad cing*/ mgo lung pa gsol dpon karma bzang dang yang zur gyi dge slong sbrel po/ bzo bkod pa g.ye pa sprul sku dkon phan pas bgyis te gzhu'i dge legs rdzong du gser gdung gi bzo grwa btsugs shing*/ 'brug lo'i nang du gser gdung bzhugs yul 'bras spungs mchod rten gyi gtsug lag khang rgya bskyed pa rnams sbrul lo zla ba bcu gcig pa phan la gser gdung rten dang*/ brten pa gzims mal sku 'dra dang bcas pa legs par grub pa la rgyal tshab sprul pa'i sku rin po ches gzungs 'bul rnams mdzad cing*/

rje mchog sprul rin po ches rdo rje slob dpon dang*/ yang zur cog gra'i dge 'dun rnams kyi zham ring dang bcas pas dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga'i sgo nas rab tu gnas par mdzad par/ phyogs mtha'i sde dpon rigs phal mo che dang*/ bla dgon kun gyis snyan dar la sogs pa'i mchod sprin/ legs ja'i 'bul nod dang bcas pa phul zhing*/ bzo bo mgo lung pa dang bcas pa rnams bzo yon gyi gnang cha gya nom pas mgu zhing rangs par mdzad pa dang*/ de mtshungs mdo khams su si tu rin po ches dbu mdzad pa'i gdan sa bar pa sogs dgon sde rnams kyis dgongs rdzogs kyi ser 'du chen mo yang mdzad cing*/ a bo kar phrin kyang rje nyid kyi dgongs pa ji ltar gtad pa bzhin dang bas phul ba'i rnyed pa chen po'i rta lo'i nang du 'khor bas/ zangs rtse khal drug brgya dang so bdun/ gser zho stong phrag gnyis dang dgu brgya/ dngul chu zho chig khri brgyad stong bdun brgya/ dngul srang drug cu dang ti tsha khal nyer drug rnams las bshad sgrub gling gi lha khang gi gser thog rgyu bzang bkod legs mthar phyin par bsgrubs te bzo bo rnams la gser zho stong dang nyis brgya sum cu'i rtsis kyi dngos po bzang dgu'i yon sbyar bas/ rgyal mchog de nyid kyi dgongs pa yongs su rdzogs par byas so// de ltar dgung lo nyer brgyad phan gyi rnam thar rje bla ma dkon mchog 'bangs kyi zhal snga nas bstsal ba dang*/ de phyin nyid rang gi zhabs pad yun du bsnyen cing mjal ba'i rnam thar dang phyag tho'i mchan bur btab pa rnams gung bsgrigs te zhib mor spros pa yin gsungs pa'i thun mong gi rnam thar rgyal tshab sprul pa'i sku grags pa don grags pa don grub pa'i zhal snga nas kyis rgyas bkod gnang 'dug pa'i tshig tshogs kyi spros pa tsam bskyung ba las skabs don ji lta bar bris pa'o// ༈¿¿rje dpa' bo gtsug lag rgya mtsho ni/

stod lung mtshur phu'i gnas kyi sgo khar yul ban de lung zhes bya ba na yab bsod nams rgya mtsho dang yum nor 'dzin dbang mo gnyis kyi sras su sa pho 'brug gi lo hor zla brgyad pa'i dmar phyogs kyi dga' ba gnyis pa la sku bltams/ dgung lo gnyis na gong ma'i zhal chems su mtshur phu'i nye skor du yong zhes gsung bar brten/ rje dgu pa'i zhabs dang rje zhwa dmar lnga pas ngos 'dzin mdzad de gtsug phud bzhes/ rje zhwa dmar nag bgros te dpal gtsug lag rgya mtsho zhes mtshan gsol/ sbrul lo hor zla bdun pa'i yar tshes bzang por gdan sa chen po lho gro bo lung du khrid 'don mdzad/ rje dkon mchog yan lag zhabs kyis thog mar grub rgyal ma'i tshe dbang dang*/ dpal ldan lha mo dud sol ma'i rjes gnang stsal/ rgyal tshab grags pa don grub drung nas tshe dpag med kyi dbang bzhi zhus/ rje dgu pas tshe mdo dang*/ rje gtsug lag phreng ba'i bka' 'bum po ti gcig gi ljags lug stsal/ de nas rje zhwa dmar lnga pa'i drung nas dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs zhus/

dgung lo gsum na rim pas zab mo nang don/ byams chos sde lnga/ dbu ma 'jug pa/ mngon pa mdzod/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod 'jug /rtsis kun bsdus pa/ snyan ngag me long*/ dam tshig rgya mtsho/ kun rig cho ga sogs blo 'dzin gyis sbyangs pa mdzad/ dgung lo brgyad par gar dbang lnga pa'i drung nas yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen zhus/ mtshan gtsug lag rgya mtsho dga' ba'i dbyangs zhes stsal/ rje gtsug lag phreng ba'i bka' 'bum po ti bcu drug dang*/ rje zhwa dmar ba rang gi bka' 'bum rnams kyi ljags lung gnang*/ si tu sprul pa'i sku sogs brgya phrag du ma dang lhan cig tu zhwa dmar ba'i drung nas a bha ya'i dkyil chog rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang bskur mdzad pa thob/ dgung lo dgu pa la rje zhwa dmar pa las mtshan brjod/ dus 'khor rtsa rgyud rtsa 'grel/ dbang mdor bstan/ don dam bsnyen pa sogs dang*/ rgyud 'bum yongs rdzogs kyi ljags lung zhus/ dgung lo bcu gcig la skyes rabs dpag bsam 'khri shing dang*/ rje mi la'i rnam mgur dang*/ rgyal sras thog med pa'i bka' 'bum rnams dang mdo sdud pa'i 'grel pa dang rgyal ba rgod tshang pa'i bka' 'bum yongs rdzogs kyi lung dang*/ sgrol dkar dang seng gdong ma'i rjes gnang bcas gnang*/ rje mi bskyod zhabs kyi 'dul ṭīka chen mo dang*/ rje zhwa dmar nag na rim gong ma rnams kyi bka' 'bum dang 'dul ba'i lung rnams kyang zhus/ rgyal tshab rin po che'i drung nas mdo mang gi 'phro rnams dang phal po che'i mdo rnams kyi ljags lung zhus/ yang zhwa dmar ba'i drung nas yum rgyas pa sogs sher phyogs rnams kyi ljags lung stsal/ yangs can du phebs nas rngog pa'i phyag dreg ma dang*/ sems khrid yid bzhin nor bu dang*/ dbus smyon pa'i dam tshig glegs bam gyi steng nas ras chung snyan brgyud rnams zhus/ dgung lo bcu gsum bzhes pa 'brug lo'i nang zhwa dmar nag gi zhabs phyi nang ma'i las ka zhus/

de skabs mgon po ber nag can zhal gzigs/ rgyal tshab rin po che'i drung nas rngog dkyil bdun pa'i bka' dbang zhus/ de nas mar pa dbu legs kyi gdan sa rdza thel sogs dang*/ 'ba' rong sogs su phebs bskyod mdzad skabs zhwa dmar drung nas nyin re bzhin bka' chos ljags lung ma chag par gnang*/ dgung lo bcu bzhi la rje zhwa dmar ba'i drung nas sbyong rgyud dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis kyi dbang dang mdo sde dkon mchog brtsegs pa'i ljags lung gnang*/ sgrub thabs rgya mtsho'i rjes gnang dang*/ ma gcig nas brgyud pa'i gcod yul gyi khrid rnams stsal/ zhang rin po che'i bka' 'bum pod bzhi dang rdzogs chen snying thig dang*/ mi tra'i khrid drug gi khrid dang lung*/ phreng ba skor gsum/ rje mi bskyod zhabs kyi phar phyin ṭīka'i ljags lung rnams zhus/ dgung lo bco lnga la rje zhwa dmar ba'i drung nas mi tra brgya rtsa'i dbang dang*/ rgyal ba yang dgon pa'i bka' 'bum gyi lung dang*/ a ma na si ka'i chos skor rnams dang*/ dpal rang byung zhabs dang rje phrin las pa'i brtag gnyis kyi 'grel pa dang*/ rje sa skya pa'i sdom rig / rje grags rgyal gyi 'grel pa dag ldan dang mngon rtogs ljon shing*/ zhwa dmar bzhi pa'i phyag chen/ chos drug lung sbyor chen mo rnams zhus/ zhor du zhang gi bka' rgya'i lung rgyab chos dang bcas pa gnang*/ 'di skabs yab sras lhan rgyas rin po che lho brag tu spyan drangs nas 'bul zhabs rgya cher zhus/ dgung lo bcu drug la rje zhwa dmar pa'i drung nas bka' gdams kyi be'u bum sngon po zhus/ lug lo 'di'i zla ba bdun pa'i tshes nyer gsum la zhwa dmar lnga pa gzugs sku chos dbyings su gshegs/ rje dgu pa'i zhabs kyis rje mi bskyod zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i dgongs gcig gi 'grel pa po ti bzhi'i ljags lung stsal/ rgyal tshab rin po che'i drung nas grub chen pakshi'i bka' 'bum phyed tsam zhig gi lung gnang*/

lhun po sgang du phebs nas sa skyong srong btsan pa yab yum la tshe dbang brgya rtsa gnang*/ yangs can du phebs sku gdung rin po che mjal zhing mchod 'bul zhus/ rgyal ba'i dbang po'i zhabs pad du sgrol dkar gyi dbang zhig zhus/ rgyal ba'i dbang po mtshur phur bzhugs skabs su mi bskyod zhabs kyi bka' 'bum nas khrid kyi skor dang tshogs 'don la nyer mkho'i dkyil chog gi skor dang*/ dwags po'i bka' 'bum sogs mang zhig dang bka' chos 'ga' re zhus/ rgyal tshab rin po cher dus mkhyen gyi thugs dam lnga tshon lnga'i dbang dang*/ rje rang byung ba'i dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang rnams zhus/ bya lor lho brag tu phebs te yar 'brog rtse stag gling rom po dgon btsan rnams su gzhan don gyi phrin las dpag med mdzad/ phyogs phyogs nas 'bul zhabs kyang rgya cher byung*/ khyi lor zla ba dang po'i mgo nas yul mi gzhi bdag gnyis kas dad gus kyis zhabs tog dang 'bul zhabs bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung*/ zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes bco lnga la yangs pa can gyi dgon gnas su mkhan po rje rgyal ba'i dbang po/ las kyi slob dpon rje grags pa don grub/ gsang ston mkhan chen legs pa don grub dang*/ dge 'dun mang po'i dbus su bsnyen par rdzogs par mdzad/ de nas rgyal ba'i dbang po'i drung nas rje mi bskyod zhabs kyi sku gsum ngo sprod dang rlung sems gnyis med kyi khrid yig chen mo zhus/ rje grags pa don grub kyi drung nas rdo rje 'jigs byed dang rdor dbyings dang*/ gshin rje gshed dmar nag /rta mgrin dregs pa khams gsum yongs sgrol dang*/ shangs lugs kyi rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi dbang dang*/ ber nag can dang lha mo rang byung ma 'khor lnga bcas pa dang*/ mgon po phyag bzhi pa dang*/ tshe ring mched lnga sogs kyi rjes gnang zhus/ gzhan yang bde mchog nag po'i dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs/ rta mgrin nag po dpa' bo lha bzhi'i gtor dbang*/

tshe dpag med lha dgu'i dbang rnams zhus/ rgyal ba'i dbang po yab sras dang rgyal tshab rin po che rnams kyi zhabs pad spyi bor bsnyen zhing gsan bsam mthar phyin par mdzad/ gdan sa sras mkhar du lo gcig lhag tsam sku mtshams su bzhugs/ mnal lam du chos skyong sogs zhal gzigs/ rin spungs/ yar rgyal/ bum thang sogs su rgyal po dang sde pa zhal ngo mang pos gus pas mchod cing chos dbang mang du zhus/ sde pa gsang bdag rdo rje sogs la mi bskyod zhabs kyi bka' 'bum po ti bcu bdun gyi ljags lung gnang*/ dpal khang lo tsā ba phrin las gnyis pa'i sprul sku karma mkhas mchog dpon slob rnams la dpal gtsug lag phreng ba'i bka' 'bum las chos 'byung yongs rdzogs dang*/ bka' brgyud gser phreng sogs gnang*/ tsā ri sogs su phebs te gnas gzigs dang gnas sgo phye ba sogs mdzad/ rje zhwa dmar mchog gi sprul sku gar dbang chos kyi dbang phyug 'bri khung du sku 'khrungs pa'i gtam snyan dang rgyal ba'i dbang pos bka' phebs te spyan 'dren dang 'bul chen zhus/ dgung lo nyer gsum nas nyer drug gi bar sku mtshams dam par mdzad cing de'i skabs su zhal gzigs mang po byung*/ dgung lo so lnga la rgyal ba'i dbang po'i zhabs kyis mkhan po dang*/ rje grags pa don grub kyis las kyi slob dpon/ rje 'di nyid kyis gsang ston gyi slob dpon mdzad de stag lor gar dbang drug pa bsnyen rdzogs mdzad/ de'i dus su rgyal ba'i dbang pos mkhan po dang rje 'dis las kyi slob dpon mdzad de/ dge 'dun stong phrag lhag tsam rab byung dang bsnyen rdzogs sgrub par mdzad/ yos lor 'gro rnams rtag 'dzin bzlog phyir du rje dgu pa chos kyi dbyings su gshegs/ gdung rin po che zhugs la phul rje 'di nyid kyis rdo rje slob dpon mdzad/ gdung 'bul du gser zho lnga brgya dang bcu gcig /dngul srang chen brgya dang bdun cu don grangs kyis gtsos pa'i gos dar shel spyad sil snyan la sogs pa mtha' yas pa phul bar mdzad/

de ma thag tu gser gdung rin po che skye 'gro'i dpal du dka' tshegs med par grub/ yos lo zla ba bdun pa'i tshes nyi shu la thams cad mkhyen pa gar dbang drug pa rgyal tshab tu seng ge'i khri la spyan drangs te mnga' gsol mdzad/ dgung lo so dgu la rje zhwa dmar drug pas bka' chos dang bka' dbang gsan dgos tshul phebs pas/ mi tra brgya rtsa'i dkyil 'khor chen po brgya dang brgyad/ khrid drug dang lha drug gi dbang la spyan ras gzigs gsang sgrub kyi dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs/ 'jam dbyangs/ phyag rdor/ tshe dpag med/ sgrol ma/ dzam bha la/ brag lha mgon po rnams kyi rjes gnang*/ ye shes mgon po phyag drug gi gtor dbang bar chad kun sel/ dud sol lho mo'i rjes gnang sogs phul bar mdzad/ zhang rin po che'i bka' rgya yongs rdzogs dang*/ bka' 'bum po ti dang po'i lung phul/ de nas brab mkhar gyi pho brang bzhengs te mdo khyams chen mo'i logs bris rnams su 'bur dod shin tu spus gtsang bar bka' bkod mdzad/ rten bzhengs grub rjes rab gnas mdzad bstun sku mtshams dam par bzhugs/ yar rgyab rgyal po sogs dpon khag rnams la bka' lung dang tshe dbang sogs mdzad/ sprel lor rje dgu pa'i bka' 'bum po ti dgu po ma phyi zhus te bzhengs/ tsā ri mtsho dkar la phebs/ slob dpon padma zhal gzigs pas gu ru mtshan brgyad la bstod pa mdzad/ zla ba bcu gcig pa'i nang rje gar dbang thams cad mkhyen pas rgyal ba bcu pa spyan 'dren la mdo khams su phebs par zhabs skyel zhag po bco lnga'i ring la grub rgyal ma'i tshe dbang brgya rtsa/ gshed dmar gyi dbang*/ mgon po phyag drug pa'i gtor dbang*/ lha mo dud sol ma'i dbang rnams phul/ khyi lor rje grags pa don grub sku gshegs la nye bar bsnyun skabs zhabs brtan phul bas snyun gzhi dngas/ de skabs rgyal tshab rin po che'i bka' 'bum po ti lnga pa zhig bzhengs par mdzad/

snar thang gtsug lag khang du zla ba gcig gi bar sde pa rnams bka' chos mang du gnang*/ phag lor rnam rgyal rab brtan du zhal ngo rnams la tshe dbang brgya rtsa sogs dbang chos du ma gnang*/ 'di skabs rgyal ba chos dbyings rdo rje khri phebs sogs grub pa'i gtam snyan thos pas dung 'bud sogs dga' ston mdzad/ chu byi'i lo dgung lo zhe lnga bzhes skabs rtse lha sgang dang sgrub sde sogs kyi dge 'dun bzhi brgya tsam rab byung dang bsnyen rdzogs gnang*/ glang lor rgyal tshab rin po che zhing khams la gshegs pas mchod bsngo dang dgongs rdzogs kyi gral dbur myur phebs dgos tshul sogs bsngo zhus 'bul mi dang spyan 'dren pa yang 'byor/ de skabs rtse le'i sprul sku dpon slob nas dbang chos mang du zhus shing bsnyen rdzogs kyang bsgrubs par mdzad/ stag lo zla ba lnga pa'i tshes bcu gsum la mtshur phur phebs te rgyal tshab rin po che'i gdung 'bul du/ gser zho brgya dang don gsum dngul ka ṭo ra che ba brgyad sogs dang phyag mdzod la gnang cha rgya cher mdzad/ dgongs rdzogs kyi slad du dge 'dun rnams kyi dbus su mchod bsngo rgyas par mdzad/ skabs 'dir sog po bzlog pa'i phyir du mgon po phyag drug pa'i sgo nas drag po'i sbyin sreg mdzad/ sngags grwa dang karma gung rgyal gling gi dge 'dun phyed nyis brgya tsam rab byung dang bsnyen rdzogs gnang*/ yos lor gar dbang thams cad mkhyen pas rje chos dbyings rdo rje khri 'don dang rten 'brel gyi dbang 'ga' re phul grub ste rje dpa' bo la'ang zhu yig gnas tshul phul ba gnang*/ de dus bstan pa'i gegs chag gis lcags mo sku mdun dang yang ri drung pa dang yab sogs kyis phan lan gnod skyel lta bus rje zhwa dmar rin po che dang thugs mi mthun zhing dgongs khrel gyi rgyu kho nar skur zhus byung 'dug pas rje zhwa dmar drug pa ni 'jang phyogs la phebs/

rje bcu pa ni mtshur phur phebs te rje dpa' bo la dbang lung sogs dgos tshul bka' phebs par brten/ thog mar spyan 'dren zhus te 'bul chen dang phyag dbang sogs thugs dgongs dgyes rdzogs zhus/ gtsug phud bzhes te yongs rdzogs kyi dge bsnyen du bsgrubs par mdzad/ re zhig rgyal ba'i dbang po'i sku tshe'i rten 'brel la sgrol dkar gyi ljags bsnyen sku mtshams gnang*/ de nas dang po phyag rdor gyi dbang dang grub chen pakshi'i bka' 'bum po ti bcu rnams dang*/ dus mkhyen gyi bka' 'bum po ti gcig dang bcas lung phul/ tshe dbang grub rgyal ma/ phag mo'i dbang*/ ber nag can/ dpal ldan lha mo/ dam can/ zhing skyong*/ rnam sras/ srin mgon/ sngags bdag sogs 'khor lnga'i rjes gnang*/ phyag bzhi pa'i dbang*/ tshe ring mched lnga'i rjes gnang*/ phyag drug pa'i rjes gnang*/ dud sol ma'i rjes gnang*/ dus mkhyen gyi thugs dam lnga tshan lnga'i dbang rnams phul bar mdzad/ 'di skabs sde srid lha phu ba la rje rang byung zhabs kyi bka' 'bum rnams kyi lung gnang*/ 'brug lo'i lo gsar nas rje mi bskyod zhabs kyi bka' 'bum rnams kyi lung rje chos dbyings rdo rje la phul ba dang*/ zla ba bdun pa nas bka' 'gyur ro cog gi lung rnams phul ba'i dbu btsugs/ sbrul lo'i nang du sgrub thabs rgya mtsho/ mi tra brgya rtsa/ rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang*/ sbyong dkyil bcu gnyis pa/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang rnams phul bar mdzad/ lo 'di'i nang bka' 'gyur yongs rdzogs kyi lung rnams phul grub/ phag mo sprul sku dang kre bo sprul pa'i sku sogs rnams la 'bri khung dgongs gcig gi lung dang*/ dwags po bka' 'bum/ spyod 'jug ṭīka sogs lung chos mtha' yas pa gnang*/ rta lor yang ri drung pa dang lcags mo sku mdun gnyis kyis gtsos pa'i dge 'dun sum brgya tsam rab byung dang bsnyen par rdzogs par mdzad/

phag mo sprul sku kre bo sprul sku gnyis dge tshul bsgrubs shing bka' gdams glegs bam dang rje gtsug lag phreng ba'i bka' 'bum rnams kyi lung gnang*/ sa mo lug lor rje bcu par rngog pa'i zab chos phyag dreg ma'i skor dang*/ chos drug sras mkhar ma/ mi tra rdor phreng gnyis kyi dbang cho ga sgrub thabs sogs kyi lung rnams dang*/ dgyes rdor lha dgu /bdag med ma lha mo bco lnga/ dgyes rdor rigs bsdus/ gdan gzhi yab bka' dang yum bka'/ sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i dkyil 'khor/ 'jam dpal gsang ldan rnams kyi dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs/ 'jam dbyangs/ spyan ras gzigs/ phyag rdor/ tshe dpag med/ dzam bha la rnams kyi rjes gnang*/ mi tra khrid drug gi khrid/ rdo rje 'jigs byed/ gshed dmar/ rta mchog khams gsum yongs sgrol/ rta mgrin dpa' bo lha bzhi/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho lha dgu'i dbang*/ tshe dpag med lha dgu /bde mchog nag po pa/ shangs lugs kyi rta mgrin gsang sgrub rnams kyi dbang rnams dang*/ zhang gi bka' 'bum po ti lnga/ dwags po bka' 'bum/ rje rgod tshang pa'i bka' 'bum yongs rdzogs/ rgyal ba yang dgon pa'i bka' 'bum yongs rdzogs/ mkhas grub o rgyan pa'i bka' 'bum yongs rdzogs rnams kyi lung phul bar mdzad/ skabs de rnams su lhan rgyas su bzhugs pa la lo lnga tsam song ba de'i tshe rje zhwa dmar thams cad mkhyen pa chos kyi dbang phyug ni ri bo che dang 'bri khung sogs su bka' dbang zab chos sogs stsal skabs yin la/ rje chos dbyings rdo rje ni zhwa dmar thams cad mkhyen pa dang mjal 'dod dgongs bzhed thun mong ma yin pa mnga' bas/ gtsang skur gyi sde pa dag gros mthun gyis/ lcags mo sku mdun dang yang ri drung pa sogs sgar pa las zur du bzhugs par byas/

'di skabs rje dpa' bos rgyal ba'i dbang por bka' gdams glegs bam/ bka' gdams lam rim khro phu brgya rtsa/ bka' brgyud gser phreng*/ shangs lugs rin chen bdun brgyud kyi rnam thar rgyas pa/ do ha skor gsum/ gtor ma 'bul ba'i rim pa/ ma ṇi bka' 'bum/ rje btsun grags rgyal gyi brtag gnyis 'grel pa dag ldan/ grags rgyal gyi gsung la zin bris mngon rtogs ljon shing*/ sdom gsum rab dbye/ sdom pa nyi shu pa/ bla ma lnga bcu pa/ kā ri ka lnga bcu pa/ byams chos sde lnga/ spyod 'jug gi gzhung*/ dus 'khor 'grel chen/ phyag rdor stod 'grel/ rdo rje snying 'grel/ 'dul ba mdo rtsa/ me tog phreng rgyud/ dbu ma rtsa shes 'jug pa/ dbu ma bden gnyis/ bshes spring*/ mngon rtogs rgyan gyi 'grel pa don gsal/ rig pa drug cu pa/ zhib mo rnam 'thag /stong nyid bdun cu pa/ rtsod zlog /nā ro 'grel chen/ mngon pa mdzod/ mngon pa kun btus/ dbu ma bzhi brgya pa/ bslab btus/ 'jug pa'i rang 'grel rnams phul/ sngon rgyal ba yab sras zhwa dmar nag gtsang phyogs su gza' skar brtsis nas mjal 'phrad mdzad kyang rje dpa' bo rin po che'i sku ngor ma bsgrigs rang 'grigs kyis yab sras gsum mjal 'phrad dang thugs dgyes tshor mnyes par mdzad/ rje chos dbyings rdo rje dang rje dpa' bo lhan rgyas yar stod khrom sar bzhugs skabs rje zhwa dmar chos kyi dbang phyug kyang der phebs nas gzim chung du rje dpa' bo spyan drangs te/ zhu don ni/ kong po'i skor zhu don gcig dang*/ nged rang gi cha 'di rgyal ba'i dbang po gong mas brtse bas dgongs thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog yan lag gi sku skye ba yin gsungs don la yin min ma shes rang la tig gtad med kyang mchog dman thams cad la bka' bkod bdag rkyen gnang ba'i rgyur brten/ phyags phyi zhu lo tsam bstan pa 'dzin lo tsam 'di byed dgos byung ba yin zhing*/

da ni lo yang re mang lon mi lcog pa la thug pa dang gangs nas blo sna thung zhing skyo ba skye ba byung bas rgyal ba'i dbang po'i zhabs drung du zhib gsed zhus yod cing*/ 'di nas dpon slob drung gis kyang thugs yul du bzhugs ngos/ zhu ngo ngo chen mdzad nas nga rang gi lus longs spyod dang dgon gnas gzhis ma lag sgar chos sde dang bcas pa 'di thams cad rgyal ba'i dbang por phul dgos tshul zhus nas/ lcags bya'i lo nang rje zhwa dmar rin po ches lhun po sgang du lus longs spyod thams cad ltos pa med par 'bul yig btab ste phul nas khong rang zos bde mdzad chog pa zhig nan zhus mdzad pa na/ rgyal ba'i dbang pos 'bul rten rnams zhwa dmar pa'i phyag tu phar slog ste bstan 'gro'i don du bzhugs sgar dang phrin las skyong tshul sngar gyi 'di ga mdzad par zhu zhes gsungs so// 'di skabs gdan sa karma nas si tu drung pa rje chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpon slob rnams rgyal ba'i dbang po mjal zhing re zhig gi bar zhabs phyi zhu bar mdzad/ khyi lor rje dpa' bos sras mkhar gyi gtsug lag khang zhig gsos mdzad cing der rgyal ba'i dbang po gnas gzigs su pheb/ shing byi lor rgyal ba'i dbang po dgung lo nyer gcig la phebs par zhwa dmar mchog sprul rin po ches mkhan po dang*/ rje 'dis las slob dang drung si tu rin po ches gsang ston mdzad pa sogs kyis bsnyen rdzogs kyi bslab pa phul/ slar rje zhwa dmar rin po che gtsang la phebs khar rje 'di par sku skal gyi 'bul ba phyag 'bul du byon zhing*/ phyag nas sku ber bzhes 'phro sogs gnang bar mdzad cing sku'i gegs sel mgon po'i dbang gang rung zhig dgos zhes zhus par mgon po phyag drug pa'i gtor dbang bar chad kun sel zhig 'bul bar mdzad/ de nas rgyal tshab mchog gi sprul pa'i sku la phyag drug pa dang dud sol ma'i rjes gnang phul zhing*/ rjes su rgyal tshab rin po che gong ma la gsan pa'i rjes gnang byings bo thams cad mchog gi sprul pa'i skur 'bul ba mdzad do/

/skabs 'gar rgyal ba'i dbang po'i bka' gnang bzhin dbang bka' rjes gnang mang zhig 'bul bar mdzad/ bshad sgrub gling gi dge 'dun lnga bcu tsam la bsnyen rdzogs gnang*/ glang lor ri bo che pa khri gdan zur dang*/ zur mang sprul sku sogs zur mang ba sogs la rje gtsug lag phreng ba'i bka' 'bum par ma rnams kyi lung gnang*/ ltag lor rgyal ba'i dbang po'i bka' bzhin tshe dbang brgya rtsa stsal/ rgyal tshab sprul sku ba mi tra rdor phreng*/ sgrub thabs rgya mtsho/ phag mo'i dbang*/ sgrol dkar gyi dbang*/ tshe sgrub rin chen nyi 'od kyi dbang*/ 'jigs byed lha dgu'i dbang*/ seng gdong ma'i rjes gnang rnams 'bul bar mdzad/ rgyal ba'i dbang pos sras mkhar zhig gso gnang ba dang bstun zhabs bskor mdzad pas snyun bab lci tsam byung bar sgrol dkar gyi dbang brgya rtsa/ rnam 'joms byabs khrus sogs phul bas sku khams dngas/ me yos lor yab sras lhan rgyas nas tshe dbang 'ga' zhig gsan par mdzad/ sa 'brug lor dge 'dun gra tshang la dpal gtsug lag phreng ba mdzad pa'i khrid skor sogs nyer mkho dang*/ 'khrungs rabs brgya rtsa/ bslab btus/ theg chen bstan snying rtsa 'grel sogs kyi lung gnang*/ sa rta lo'i zla ba brgyad pa'i nang du rje zhwa dmar thams cad mkhyen pa sku snyun pa la sku rim sgrub dgos tshul phebs byung bar zhi drag gi sbyin sreg bdun phrag re mdzad/ de skabs rgyal ba'i dbang pos rje dpa' bo la phebs dgos tshul bka' shog byung bas phebs lam yar lung gi mdar gtsang po'i gru khar/ 'brug pa ngag dbang rnam rgyal dpon slob phebs pa'i phyags phyi dang phan tshun nang 'dzing gis dpa' bo'i gra rigs zhig rkyen lam du shor bas 'brug pa dpon slob lho mon du bros byon pa'i 'brug bstan lho ru dang bar gyur pa ni spyi ldog nas karma pa'i thugs bskyed yin par lho 'brug pa rnams gsungs zhes so// slar sku bgres gcong che ba dang gsar du yang mnyel bar gyur pa la/

de skabs kyi 'phrod brten dang bsnyun g.yog thams cad rgyal ba'i dbang po rang gis mdzad/ dgung lo drug cu re gsum bzhes pa sa rta zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i nyi shu brgyad la chos kyi dbyings su gzims/ sku gdung zhugs 'bul sogs thugs khur thams cad rgyal ba'i dbang po nyid kyis mdzad pa yin no/ /sngon rgyal ba'i dbang po dgung lo bcu gnyis bzhes skabs rje dpa' bo la nyid sku tshe ji tsam bzhugs zhes gsungs pa la/ bdag la mngon shes dang yi dam lha'i lung bstan med pas mi shes lags zhus pas/ rgyal ba'i dbang pos nyid dgung lo drug cu re gnyis re gsum gyi bar du bzhugs pa ngas khag theg par khyed e dgongs gsungs pa la 'di lor phebs dgos tshul bka' nan phebs pa 'di la dgongs par snang ngo*// ༈¿¿si tu chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar ni/ thog mar dpal 'og min karma'i gdan rabs gleng bar bya ste/ de yang rje dus gsum mkhyen pa'i rjes su/ 'gro mgon ras chen gyis gdan sa lha khang sogs bzhengs/ de rjes rje spom brag pas gdan sa mdzad nas/ de rjes rje dus mkhyen gyi slob ma mkhas pa dbang gyi rdo rje gdan sar bskos/ de rjes rgya blo gros kyis gdan sa mdzad/ de rjes mkhas grub dbang dang*/ de rjes dbas ston bya mo mgos gdan sa mdzad kyang dar rgyas cher ma byung bas bla chen dar ma grags gdan sar phebs nas dar rgyas mdzad/ dus der grub chen karma pakshi hor yul du phebs/ rje'i dbon chos rgyal gyi sras brgyud spyan snga rta shod pa dang dben skyabs a thar gsum bzhugs pa'i spyan snga rta shod pas gdan sa mdzad skabs karma pakshi phebs byams chen sogs bzhengs/ dben skyabs kyi sras 'jam dbyangs blo gros seṅge gdan sar bskos/ gong ma se chen nas shel tham dang 'ja' sa sogs phebs/ de rjes a thar gyi sras dar ma bsod nams gdan sar phebs/ hor rgyal ci ching gis shel tham sogs gnang*/

de rjes si tu blo gros rgyal mtshan gyis gdan sa mdzad/ de rjes a thar gyi sras li thar dang de'i sras si tu tshul khrims rgyal mtshan pa gdan sar phebs skabs rje rang byung zhabs thog mar phebs/ de rjes tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyi mched ya si tu kun dga' rin chen gyis gdan sa mdzad/ slar yang si tu tshul khrims rgyal mtshan bskyar bzhugs gnang hor rin chen dpal gyis shel tham dang srung cha gnang*/ de rjes a thar gyi sras a bdud gyi sras si tu dge 'dun ye shes pas gdan sa mdzad/ de rjes a bdud kyi sras si tu ārya pa'am tshul khrims rgyal mtshan pas gdan sa'i khur bzhes 'di la sprul pa'i ā tsa ra bdun gyis rten gandho la phul/ rje rol pa'i rdo rje phebs/ dpon stag 'phen gyi sras mi chos rgyal bzang de'i sras si tu shes rab me lce zhes pas gdan sa mdzad pa la dbon po ru bzhis dkrongs/ mched ya thugs rje rgya hob yab sras rnams phud de nas dbu thugs rje rgya hob kyi sras si tu chos kyi rgyal mtshan gdan sar phebs/ tā min g.yun los 'ja' sa shel tham las zhwa sogs gnang*/ rje de bzhin gshegs pa phebs/ chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi mched yang dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyi sras si tu shākya bzang po gdan sar bkos/ de rjes dpon dbang drag gi sras si tu bkra shis rnam rgyal gyis gdan sa mdzad/ de rjes mtshur phu sku skye bsod nams mchog ldan gdan sar bzhugs kyang gdung rabs ni min no/ /de rjes si tu bkra shis rnam rgyal gyi dbon po bu sar gyi sras si tu dpal ldan bkra shis gdan sar phebs/ de rjes de'i dbon si tu bkra shis dpal 'byor gyis gdan sa mdzad skabs/ rje chos grags rgya mtshos lha chen bzhengs/ de rjes dpon a dar gyi sras gcod 'bum gyi sras si tu bsod nams rnam rgyal bas gdan sa mdzad/ 'di nas gdung rabs rdzogs/ si tu rin po che chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi sprul pa'i sku si tu bkra shis rnam rgyal dang*/

de'i sprul pa'i zlos gar si tu bkra shis dpal 'byor dang*/ de'i sprul sku mi 'khrugs chos kyi go cha dang*/ de'i phyi ma si tu nor bu bsam 'phel/ de'i sgyu 'phrul rol pa si tu chos kyi rgyal mtshan phyi ma 'di pa me khyir sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo bco lnga pas byi khrums zla'i yar ngo la rje dgu pa'i drung nas rab tu byung*/ mtshan chos kyi rgyal mtshan dge legs dpal bzang por gsol/ sa glang lor gdan sar bsko bzhag mdzad/ de nas gsan bsam rgya cher mdzad/ dbus su phebs rje dgu pa mkhan po dang*/ rgyal tshab grags pa don grub kyis las slob mdzad de bsnyen par rdzogs par mdzad/ kwan ting gu shrī'i las ka dang shel tham gnang*/ zhwa dmar gyi cod pan dbu la bcings te ston 'khor tha mi dad par zhal gyis bzhes/ rgyal ba nyid kyi phrin las par dbang bskur/ rgyal ba'i bka' ltar sa smad du phebs te kaṃ po gnas la zhig gso sogs mdzad/ sa tham rgyal pos spyan drangs te bsnyen bkur rgya chen bstabs/ gdan sar phebs/ dbus nas bzo rig rnams pos/ g.yen mo che ka ba brgya dang lnga bcu'i khyon/ sgo khang ka ba brgyad gtso khang rnams thog so re re spar ba'i mkhar las lo dgur mdzad/ shing rtsi ldebs bris sogs sprul sku pa phan bde dang tshe 'bum brtan rnams kyis/ 'du khang gi ldebs ris la mdzad brgya sogs rje chos kyi dbang phyug gis bkod yig mdzad de bris/ rje dgu pa'i dngul sku 'dra zhal dang*/ rol pa'i rdo rje'i gser sku/ don ldan zhabs kyi dngul sku ste na rim dgu'i sku brnyan tshang bar mdzad/ rje dgu pa gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs rgya cher bsgrubs/ dngul srang nyis stong las gzim mal sku 'dra sku tshad kyi gnyis 'gyur las che ba'i byon legs sogs phyi nang gi rten gsum bgrangs kyis mi lang pa bzhengs/ chu sprel la lho brag gur khyim du zhi bar gzims/
